/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Hom.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Basic

/-!
# Finite left- and right-generating tuples

Pure algebraic carrier and characteristic laws used by numeric topological
stable rank.  The two orientations remain distinct over a noncommutative
semiring.  This module has no topology dependency.
-/

public section

open scoped BigOperators

universe uR uS uI

/-- A tuple generates the unit as a left ideal: coefficients multiply its
entries on the left.  This is Rieffel's `Lg_n` orientation. -/
@[expose] def IsLeftGeneratingTuple
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → R) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ι → R, ∑ i, b i * a i = 1

/-- A tuple generates the unit as a right ideal: coefficients multiply its
entries on the right. -/
@[expose] def IsRightGeneratingTuple
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → R) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ι → R, ∑ i, a i * b i = 1

namespace IsLeftGeneratingTuple

/-- A coefficient ring homomorphism carries a left-generating tuple to a
left-generating tuple. -/
theorem map
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
    {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    {a : ι → R} (ha : IsLeftGeneratingTuple a) (f : R →+* S) :
    IsLeftGeneratingTuple (fun i => f (a i)) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨fun i => f (b i), ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_one] using congrArg f hb

/-- Taking stars sends a left-generating tuple to a right-generating tuple;
the coefficient order is reversed exactly once. -/
theorem star
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] [StarRing R]
    {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    {a : ι → R} (ha : IsLeftGeneratingTuple a) :
    IsRightGeneratingTuple (fun i => Star.star (a i)) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨fun i => Star.star (b i), ?_⟩
  have hstarSum (x : ι → R) :
      Star.star (∑ i, x i) = ∑ i, Star.star (x i) :=
    map_sum (starAddEquiv : R ≃+ R) _ _
  calc
    (∑ i, Star.star (a i) * Star.star (b i)) =
        ∑ i, Star.star (b i * a i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [star_mul]
    _ = Star.star (∑ i, b i * a i) := (hstarSum fun i => b i * a i).symm
    _ = Star.star (1 : R) := congrArg Star.star hb
    _ = 1 := star_one R

end IsLeftGeneratingTuple

namespace IsRightGeneratingTuple

/-- A coefficient ring homomorphism carries a right-generating tuple to a
right-generating tuple. -/
theorem map
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
    {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    {a : ι → R} (ha : IsRightGeneratingTuple a) (f : R →+* S) :
    IsRightGeneratingTuple (fun i => f (a i)) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨fun i => f (b i), ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, map_one] using congrArg f hb

/-- Taking stars sends a right-generating tuple to a left-generating tuple. -/
theorem star
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] [StarRing R]
    {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι]
    {a : ι → R} (ha : IsRightGeneratingTuple a) :
    IsLeftGeneratingTuple (fun i => Star.star (a i)) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨fun i => Star.star (b i), ?_⟩
  have hstarSum (x : ι → R) :
      Star.star (∑ i, x i) = ∑ i, Star.star (x i) :=
    map_sum (starAddEquiv : R ≃+ R) _ _
  calc
    (∑ i, Star.star (b i) * Star.star (a i)) =
        ∑ i, Star.star (a i * b i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [star_mul]
    _ = Star.star (∑ i, a i * b i) := (hstarSum fun i => a i * b i).symm
    _ = Star.star (1 : R) := congrArg Star.star hb
    _ = 1 := star_one R

end IsRightGeneratingTuple

/-- Over a commutative semiring the left and right generator predicates
coincide. -/
theorem isLeftGeneratingTuple_iff_isRightGeneratingTuple
    {R : Type uR} [CommSemiring R]
    {ι : Type uI} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → R) :
    IsLeftGeneratingTuple a ↔ IsRightGeneratingTuple a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    calc
      (∑ i, a i * b i) = ∑ i, b i * a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact mul_comm _ _
      _ = 1 := hb
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    calc
      (∑ i, b i * a i) = ∑ i, a i * b i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact mul_comm _ _
      _ = 1 := hb

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.PNat.Basic

/-!
# Finite Cuntz families from a binary family

The singleton family is `1`. Each step splits only the last leaf `u` into
`u * v₀, u * v₁`, retaining every earlier leaf. Both Cuntz laws are proved
over a unital star semiring, including its zero case. No norm, completion,
representation, finite-family outcome assumption or global instance is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace CuntzFamily

universe u

variable {R : Type u}

/-- The actual binary leaf-splitting family, with positive size `n+1`. -/
def ofBinary [Mul R] [One R] (v : Fin 2 → R) : (n : ℕ) → Fin (n + 1) → R
  | 0 => fun _ => 1
  | n + 1 =>
      let f := ofBinary v n
      let u := f (Fin.last n)
      Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin n => f i.castSucc) (u * v 0)) (u * v 1)

/-- The same computed family on an explicitly positive finite index. -/
def ofBinaryPositive [Mul R] [One R] (v : Fin 2 → R) (N : ℕ+) : Fin N → R :=
  ofBinary v N.natPred ∘ (finCongr N.natPred_add_one).symm

/-- Positive size one is the literal singleton family `1`. -/
theorem ofBinaryPositive_one [Mul R] [One R] (v : Fin 2 → R) (i : Fin 1) :
    ofBinaryPositive v 1 i = 1 :=
  rfl

/-- The first split recovers the supplied binary family in its original order. -/
theorem ofBinary_one [MulOneClass R] (v : Fin 2 → R) (i : Fin 2) :
    ofBinary v 1 i = v i := by
  cases i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      change (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin 0 => (1 : R)) (1 * v 0) : Fin 1 → R)
        (1 * v 1) : Fin 2 → R) (Fin.last 1) = v (Fin.last 1)
      rw [Fin.snoc_last, one_mul]
      rfl
  | cast i =>
      have hi : i = Fin.last 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      change (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin 0 => (1 : R)) (1 * v 0) : Fin 1 → R)
        (1 * v 1) : Fin 2 → R) ((Fin.last 0).castSucc) = v ((Fin.last 0).castSucc)
      rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, one_mul]
      rfl

/-- Positive size two recovers the supplied binary family. -/
theorem ofBinaryPositive_two [MulOneClass R] (v : Fin 2 → R) (i : Fin 2) :
    ofBinaryPositive v 2 i = v i := by
  change ofBinary v 1 i = v i
  exact ofBinary_one v i

/-- Both finite Cuntz laws are preserved by the constructive last-leaf split. -/
theorem ofBinary_relations [Semiring R] [StarRing R] (v : Fin 2 → R)
    (hOrth : ∀ i j : Fin 2, star (v i) * v j = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hPartition : v 0 * star (v 0) + v 1 * star (v 1) = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i j : Fin (n + 1),
      star (ofBinary v n i) * ofBinary v n j = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), ofBinary v n i * star (ofBinary v n i)) = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · intro i j
        have hij : i = j := by
          have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
          have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
          exact hi.trans hj.symm
        simp [ofBinary, hij]
      · simp [ofBinary]
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨hGram, hSum⟩
      let f : Fin (n + 1) → R := ofBinary v n
      let u : R := f (Fin.last n)
      let g : Fin (n + 2) → R :=
        Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin n => f i.castSucc) (u * v 0)) (u * v 1)
      have hUU : star u * u = 1 := by
        simpa [f, u] using hGram (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n)
      have hOldLast (i : Fin n) : star (f i.castSucc) * u = 0 := by
        simpa [f, u] using hGram i.castSucc (Fin.last n)
      have hLastOld (i : Fin n) : star u * f i.castSucc = 0 := by
        simpa [f, u, Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last i)] using
          hGram (Fin.last n) i.castSucc
      have hOldSplit (i : Fin n) (ε : Fin 2) :
          star (f i.castSucc) * (u * v ε) = 0 := by
        calc
          _ = (star (f i.castSucc) * u) * v ε := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [hOldLast, zero_mul]
      have hSplitOld (ε : Fin 2) (i : Fin n) :
          star (u * v ε) * f i.castSucc = 0 := by
        rw [star_mul, mul_assoc, hLastOld, mul_zero]
      have hSplitGram (ε δ : Fin 2) :
          star (u * v ε) * (u * v δ) = if ε = δ then 1 else 0 := by
        calc
          _ = star (v ε) * (star u * u) * v δ := by
            simp only [star_mul, mul_assoc]
          _ = star (v ε) * v δ := by rw [hUU, mul_one]
          _ = if ε = δ then 1 else 0 := hOrth ε δ
      have hSplitSum :
          (u * v 0) * star (u * v 0) + (u * v 1) * star (u * v 1) =
            u * star u := by
        calc
          _ = u * (v 0 * star (v 0) + v 1 * star (v 1)) * star u := by
            simp only [star_mul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc]
          _ = u * star u := by rw [hPartition, mul_one]
      have hPrefix :
          (∑ i : Fin n, f i.castSucc * star (f i.castSucc)) + u * star u = 1 := by
        simpa only [f, u, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] using hSum
      change (∀ i j : Fin (n + 2), star (g i) * g j = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (n + 2), g i * star (g i)) = 1
      constructor
      · intro i j
        cases i using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            cases j using Fin.lastCases with
            | last => simpa [g] using hSplitGram 1 1
            | cast j =>
                cases j using Fin.lastCases with
                | last =>
                    simpa [g, Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last (Fin.last n))] using hSplitGram 1 0
                | cast j =>
                    simpa [g, Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last j.castSucc)] using
                      hSplitOld 1 j
        | cast i =>
            cases i using Fin.lastCases with
            | last =>
                cases j using Fin.lastCases with
                | last => simpa [g] using hSplitGram 0 1
                | cast j =>
                    cases j using Fin.lastCases with
                    | last => simpa [g] using hSplitGram 0 0
                    | cast j =>
                        simpa [g, Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last j)] using hSplitOld 0 j
            | cast i =>
                cases j using Fin.lastCases with
                | last => simpa [g] using hOldSplit i 1
                | cast j =>
                    cases j using Fin.lastCases with
                    | last => simpa [g] using hOldSplit i 0
                    | cast j => simpa [g] using hGram i.castSucc j.castSucc
      · calc
          (∑ i : Fin (n + 2), g i * star (g i)) =
              ((∑ i : Fin n, f i.castSucc * star (f i.castSucc)) +
                (u * v 0) * star (u * v 0)) + (u * v 1) * star (u * v 1) := by
            simp only [g, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
          _ = (∑ i : Fin n, f i.castSucc * star (f i.castSucc)) + u * star u := by
            rw [add_assoc, hSplitSum]
          _ = 1 := hPrefix

/-- The actual positive-size family has both Cuntz laws, without any output
family assumption. -/
theorem ofBinaryPositive_relations [Semiring R] [StarRing R] (v : Fin 2 → R)
    (hOrth : ∀ i j : Fin 2, star (v i) * v j = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hPartition : v 0 * star (v 0) + v 1 * star (v 1) = 1) (N : ℕ+) :
    (∀ i j : Fin N,
      star (ofBinaryPositive v N i) * ofBinaryPositive v N j = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∑ i : Fin N, ofBinaryPositive v N i * star (ofBinaryPositive v N i)) = 1 := by
  have h := ofBinary_relations v hOrth hPartition N.natPred
  let e : Fin N ≃ Fin (N.natPred + 1) := (finCongr N.natPred_add_one).symm
  constructor
  · intro i j
    change star (ofBinary v N.natPred (e i)) * ofBinary v N.natPred (e j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
    rw [h.1]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · have heij : e i ≠ e j := fun he => hij (e.injective he)
      simp [hij, heij]
  · change (∑ i : Fin N,
      ofBinary v N.natPred (e i) * star (ofBinary v N.natPred (e i))) = 1
    exact (e.sum_comp (fun j => ofBinary v N.natPred j * star (ofBinary v N.natPred j))).trans
      h.2

end CuntzFamily

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarProjection
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset

/-!
# Finite sums of orthogonal star projections

A finite family of star projections with pairwise zero products has a
star-projection sum. This constructs the actual finite projection cutoffs
used with finite localizations; no projection-sum certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

namespace IsStarProjection

universe u v

variable {R : Type u} [NonUnitalSemiring R] [StarRing R] {I : Type v}

/-- A literal finite sum of pairwise orthogonal star projections is a star projection. -/
theorem finset_sum_of_pairwise_mul_eq_zero (s : Finset I) (p : I → R)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (p i))
    (horthogonal : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → p i * p j = 0) :
    IsStarProjection (∑ i ∈ s, p i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using IsStarProjection.zero R
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hrest : IsStarProjection (∑ i ∈ s, p i) := ih
        (fun i hi => hp i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
        (fun i hi j hj hij => horthogonal i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
          j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij)
      have hsum : (∑ i ∈ s, p i) * p a = 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        exact horthogonal i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
          (fun h => ha (h ▸ hi))
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      simpa only [add_comm] using hrest.add (hp a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) hsum

end IsStarProjection

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Distribution.TestFunction

/-!
# Affine changes of variables for finite-order test functions

Precomposition by an invertible continuous affine map preserves compact support
and the order of differentiability. It is continuous for the canonical LF topology,
because every derivative seminorm on a fixed support is bounded by the corresponding
input seminorm times a power of the norm of the linear part.

Multiplying this map by a scalar gives normalized translations and anisotropic
rescalings, with no extra smoothness or finite-dimensionality assumption.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology Distributions

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞}

namespace TestFunction

/-- The homeomorphism with value `L x + b`. -/
def affineHomeomorph (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) : E ≃ₜ E where
  toFun x := L x + b
  invFun x := L.symm (x - b)
  left_inv x := by simp
  right_inv x := by simp
  continuous_toFun := L.continuous.add continuous_const
  continuous_invFun := L.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)

@[simp]
theorem affineHomeomorph_apply (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b x : E) :
    affineHomeomorph L b x = L x + b := rfl

@[simp]
theorem affineHomeomorph_symm_apply (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b x : E) :
    (affineHomeomorph L b).symm x = L.symm (x - b) := rfl

/-- A support compact pulled back through `x ↦ L x + b`. -/
def affinePullbackCompact (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (K : Compacts E) : Compacts E :=
  ⟨(affineHomeomorph L b).symm '' (K : Set E),
    K.isCompact.image (affineHomeomorph L b).symm.continuous⟩

@[simp]
theorem mem_affinePullbackCompact (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (K : Compacts E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ affinePullbackCompact L b K ↔ L x + b ∈ K := by
  change x ∈ (affineHomeomorph L b).symm '' (K : Set E) ↔ L x + b ∈ K
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa using hy
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨L x + b, hx, by simp⟩

/-- Affine precomposition on the underlying finite-order test functions. -/
def affinePrecomp (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n where
  toFun x := f (L x + b)
  contDiff' := f.contDiff.comp (L.contDiff.add contDiff_const)
  hasCompactSupport' := f.hasCompactSupport.comp_homeomorph (affineHomeomorph L b)
  tsupport_subset' := by intro x hx; trivial

@[simp]
theorem affinePrecomp_apply (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b x : E) (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    affinePrecomp L b f x = f (L x + b) := rfl

end TestFunction

namespace ContDiffMapSupportedIn

/-- The derivative bound for affine precomposition on a fixed compact support. -/
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_affinePrecomp_le (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) {K : Compacts E}
    (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) (x : E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => f (L y + b)) x‖ ≤
      ‖(L : E →L[ℝ] E)‖ ^ i * ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E F n K i f := by
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ n (fun y => f (y + b)) := f.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
  change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i ((fun y => f (y + b)) ∘ (L : E →L[ℝ] E)) x‖ ≤ _
  rw [(L : E →L[ℝ] E).iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hg x (mod_cast hi)]
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := (f : E → F)) i b
    ((L : E →L[ℝ] E) x)]
  calc
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f (L x + b)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => (L : E →L[ℝ] E))‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f (L x + b)‖ * ‖(L : E →L[ℝ] E)‖ ^ i := by
          simpa using (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f (L x + b)).norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
            (fun _ : Fin i => (L : E →L[ℝ] E))
    _ ≤ ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E F n K i f * ‖(L : E →L[ℝ] E)‖ ^ i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_iteratedFDeriv_apply_le_seminorm ℝ hi)
        (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    _ = _ := mul_comm _ _

/-- Affine precomposition as a continuous linear map between fixed-support spaces. -/
noncomputable def affinePrecompCLM (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (K : Compacts E) :
    ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K →L[ℝ]
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n (TestFunction.affinePullbackCompact L b K) :=
  ContDiffMapSupportedIn.mkCLM ℝ (fun f x => f (L x + b))
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    (fun f => f.contDiff.comp (L.contDiff.add contDiff_const))
    (fun f x hx => f.zero_on_compl (by
      change L x + b ∉ K
      exact (TestFunction.mem_affinePullbackCompact L b K x).not.mp hx))
    (fun i hi => ⟨{i}, ‖(L : E →L[ℝ] E)‖ ^ i, pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _,
      fun f x _ => by simpa using norm_iteratedFDeriv_affinePrecomp_le L b f i hi x⟩)

@[simp]
theorem affinePrecompCLM_apply (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (K : Compacts E)
    (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (x : E) :
    affinePrecompCLM L b K f x = f (L x + b) := rfl

end ContDiffMapSupportedIn

namespace TestFunction

/-- Affine precomposition is continuous for the canonical finite-order LF topology. -/
noncomputable def affinePrecompCLM (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) :
    TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n →L[ℝ] TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n :=
  TestFunction.limitCLM ℝ (affinePrecomp L b)
    (fun K _ => TestFunction.ofSupportedInCLM ℝ (by intro x hx; trivial) ∘L
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn.affinePrecompCLM L b K)
    (by intro K hK f; rfl)

@[simp]
theorem affinePrecompCLM_apply (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b x : E) (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    affinePrecompCLM L b f x = f (L x + b) := rfl

/-- The support moves by the inverse affine map, with equality. -/
theorem tsupport_affinePrecompCLM (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    tsupport (affinePrecompCLM L b f) = (affineHomeomorph L b) ⁻¹' tsupport f := by
  exact tsupport_comp_eq_preimage f (affineHomeomorph L b)

/-- A scalar normalization of affine precomposition, still continuous on finite-order tests. -/
noncomputable def affineScaleCLM (c : ℝ) (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) :
    TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n →L[ℝ] TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n :=
  c • affinePrecompCLM L b

@[simp]
theorem affineScaleCLM_apply (c : ℝ) (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b x : E)
    (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    affineScaleCLM c L b f x = c • f (L x + b) := rfl

/-- Scalar normalization cannot enlarge the pulled-back support, including when `c = 0`. -/
theorem tsupport_affineScaleCLM_subset (c : ℝ) (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E)
    (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    tsupport (affineScaleCLM c L b f) ⊆ (affineHomeomorph L b) ⁻¹' tsupport f := by
  exact (tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun _ : E => c) (affinePrecompCLM L b f)).trans_eq
    (tsupport_affinePrecompCLM L b f)

@[simp]
theorem affinePrecompCLM_refl (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    affinePrecompCLM (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E) 0 f = f := by
  ext x
  simp

/-- Pulling a test back through the inverse affine map undoes affine precomposition. -/
theorem affinePrecompCLM_inverse (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E)
    (f : TestFunction (⊤ : Opens E) F n) :
    affinePrecompCLM L.symm (-L.symm b) (affinePrecompCLM L b f) = f := by
  ext x
  simp

end TestFunction

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.AddCircle
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Integral
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.Unique
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Norm

/-!
# Actual normalized-circle Fejer kernel

This stock-only prerequisite supplies a genuine positive normalized kernel
for the Fourier polynomial approximation needed to construct the original
Hardy predual forward map. The kernel is the literal normalized squared
Dirichlet sum. No Hardy, predual, weak-star or desired approximation output is
an input. Source-specific Fourier Hardy carriers stay in the source modules.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open Filter MeasureTheory Set Topology
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

/-- The Dirichlet polynomial with nonnegative frequencies on the normalized additive unit circle. -/
def circleDirichletPolynomial (N : ℕ) : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), fourier (n : ℤ)

/-- Literal pointwise finite Fourier sum of the actual Dirichlet polynomial. -/
theorem circleDirichletPolynomial_apply (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    circleDirichletPolynomial N x = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), fourier (n : ℤ) x := by
  simp only [circleDirichletPolynomial, ContinuousMap.sum_apply]

/-- The actual Fejer kernel is the normalized squared absolute Dirichlet polynomial. -/
def circleFejerKernel (N : ℕ) : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) :=
  ((N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N) * circleDirichletPolynomial N)

/-- Literal positive real density represented by the actual complex Fejer kernel. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_apply (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    circleFejerKernel N x = ((‖circleDirichletPolynomial N x‖ ^ 2 / (N + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) := by
  change (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) *
    circleDirichletPolynomial N x) = _
  have hc : Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) * circleDirichletPolynomial N x =
      ((‖circleDirichletPolynomial N x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [RCLike.star_def, Complex.ofReal_pow] using
      Complex.conj_mul' (circleDirichletPolynomial N x)
  rw [hc, Complex.ofReal_div]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_natCast, Complex.ofReal_one,
    div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_comm _ _

/-- Positivity of the actual kernel does not require any desired norm-bound certificate. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_re_nonneg (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) : 0 ≤ (circleFejerKernel N x).re := by
  rw [circleFejerKernel_apply]
  change 0 ≤ ‖circleDirichletPolynomial N x‖ ^ 2 / (N + 1 : ℝ)
  exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)

/-- The actual kernel is real-valued. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_im (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) : (circleFejerKernel N x).im = 0 := by
  rw [circleFejerKernel_apply]
  rfl

/-- The norm of the genuine complex kernel equals its nonnegative real density. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_norm (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    ‖circleFejerKernel N x‖ = (circleFejerKernel N x).re := by
  have hn : 0 ≤ ‖circleDirichletPolynomial N x‖ ^ 2 / (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  rw [circleFejerKernel_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg hn, Complex.ofReal_re]

/-- The genuine finite Dirichlet L-two vector has its literal squared norm. -/
theorem circleDirichletPolynomial_inner (N : ℕ) :
    ⟪(circleDirichletPolynomial N).toLp 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle ℂ,
      (circleDirichletPolynomial N).toLp 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle ℂ⟫_ℂ = (N + 1 : ℂ) := by
  have hOrthonormal :
      Orthonormal ℂ (fun n : ℕ =>
        (fourierLp (T := (1 : ℝ)) 2 (n : ℤ) :
          Lp ℂ 2 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle))) := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    have h := (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (orthonormal_fourier (T := (1 : ℝ)))) (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ)
    simpa only [Int.ofNat_inj] using h
  have h := hOrthonormal.inner_sum
    (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℂ)) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℂ)) (Finset.range (N + 1))
  simpa only [circleDirichletPolynomial, map_sum, fourierLp, one_smul, map_one, one_mul,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] using h

/-- The actual positive normalized kernel has integral exactly one. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_integral (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, circleFejerKernel N x ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) = 1 := by
  have hi := ContinuousMap.inner_toLp (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)
    (circleDirichletPolynomial N) (circleDirichletPolynomial N)
  have hj : (∫ x, Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) * circleDirichletPolynomial N x
      ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) = (N + 1 : ℂ) := by
    have he : (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleDirichletPolynomial N x *
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (circleDirichletPolynomial N x)) =
        fun x => Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) * circleDirichletPolynomial N x := by
      funext x
      rw [starRingEnd_apply, mul_comm]
    rw [he] at hi
    exact hi.symm.trans (circleDirichletPolynomial_inner N)
  change (∫ x, (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
    (Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) * circleDirichletPolynomial N x)
    ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) = 1
  rw [integral_smul, hj, smul_eq_mul]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero N)

/-- Haar invariance gives the actual unit mass for every translated/inverted kernel. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_integral_sub (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    (∫ t, circleFejerKernel N (x - t) ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) = 1 := by
  rw [integral_sub_left_eq_self (circleFejerKernel N)
    (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) x]
  exact circleFejerKernel_integral N

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier.CircleFejerPolynomial
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic

/-!
# Actual Fejer Fourier coefficients

Finite difference counts compute the genuine Fourier coefficients of the
actual bounded Fejer polynomial. Their normalized multiplicities tend to
one at every fixed integer frequency. These facts are needed to descend the
actual Hardy integral pairing to its source quotient; no desired weak-star
approximation or duality output is an assumption.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open Filter MeasureTheory Set Topology
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

/-- Actual finite double difference sum, retaining every integer frequency. -/
def circleDifferenceSum (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (c : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if k = (i : ℤ) - j then c else 0

/-- Actual inner difference sum at a nonnegative source frequency. -/
theorem circleDifferenceSum_row (N k i : ℕ) (hi : i < N + 1) (c : ℂ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if (k : ℤ) = (i : ℤ) - j then c else 0) =
      if k ≤ i then c else 0 := by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ i
  · rw [ite_eq_left hk]
    have hm : i - k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (i - k)]
    · have he : (k : ℤ) = (i : ℤ) - ((i - k : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [ite_eq_left he]
    · intro j hj hne
      exact ite_eq_right (by omega)
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot hm)
  · rw [ite_eq_right hk]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => ite_eq_right (by omega))

/-- Literal finite count of every nonnegative difference, with zero count beyond the finite range. -/
theorem circleDifferenceSum_nat (N k : ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    circleDifferenceSum N (k : ℤ) c = (N + 1 - k : ℕ) • c := by
  unfold circleDifferenceSum
  have hrow : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      if (k : ℤ) = (i : ℤ) - j then c else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if k ≤ i then c else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact circleDifferenceSum_row N k i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) c
  rw [hrow]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ N
  · have hn : N + 1 = k + (N + 1 - k) := by omega
    rw [hn, Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hleft : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, if k ≤ i then c else 0) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => ite_eq_right (by have h := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega))
    have hright : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 - k), if k ≤ k + i then c else 0) =
        (N + 1 - k : ℕ) • c := by
      simp only [Nat.le_add_right, ite_true, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
    rw [hleft, hright, zero_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  · have hn : N + 1 - k = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (by omega)
    rw [hn, zero_nsmul]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    exact ite_eq_right (by have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega)

/-- The actual difference count is symmetric under reversal of the frequency. -/
theorem circleDifferenceSum_neg (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    circleDifferenceSum N (-k) c = circleDifferenceSum N k c := by
  unfold circleDifferenceSum
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have he : (-k = (j : ℤ) - i) ↔ (k = (i : ℤ) - j) := by omega
  exact if_congr he rfl rfl

/-- Literal normalized multiplicity, using natural subtraction to give zero outside the finite support. -/
def circleFejerWeight (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (N + 1 - k.natAbs : ℕ)

/-- Actual finite difference count for either sign of any integer frequency. -/
theorem circleDifferenceSum_eq (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * circleDifferenceSum N k c = circleFejerWeight N k * c := by
  have he : circleDifferenceSum N k c = (N + 1 - k.natAbs : ℕ) • c := by
    by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ k
    · have hnat : ((k.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) = k := by omega
      rw [← hnat]
      exact circleDifferenceSum_nat N k.natAbs c
    · have hneg : k = -((k.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [hneg, circleDifferenceSum_neg]
      simpa only [Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast] using circleDifferenceSum_nat N k.natAbs c
  rw [he]
  simp only [circleFejerWeight, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

/-- Full actual Fourier coefficient of the finite normalized Fejer polynomial. -/
theorem circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff_sum
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleFejerPolynomial f N x) k =
      (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * circleDifferenceSum N k (fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k) := by
  have hterm : ∀ i j : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun x : UnitAddCircle =>
        fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) *
          fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x) AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
    intro i j
    have hm := ContinuousMap.memLp (p := (1 : ℝ≥0∞))
      (μ := (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) ℂ
      (fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)))
    exact (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hm).const_mul _
  have hfun : (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleFejerPolynomial f N x) =
      (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          (fun x : UnitAddCircle =>
            fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) *
              fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [circleFejerPolynomial, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMap.sum_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hfun, fourierCoeff.const_smul]
  change (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * _ = _
  congr 1
  have hout := fourierCoeff.sum (Finset.range (N + 1))
    (fun (i : ℕ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (fun x : UnitAddCircle =>
        fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) *
          fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x))
    (fun (i : ℕ) hi =>
      integrable_finsetSum' (Finset.range (N + 1)) (fun (j : ℕ) hj => hterm i j))
  rw [congrFun hout k]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  unfold circleDifferenceSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hin := fourierCoeff.sum (Finset.range (N + 1))
    (fun (j : ℕ) => fun x : UnitAddCircle =>
      fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) *
        fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x)
    (fun (j : ℕ) hj => hterm i j)
  rw [congrFun hin k]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [fourierCoeff.const_mul]
  have he := congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := (1 : ℝ)) ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ))) k
  rw [he, Pi.single_apply]
  by_cases hk : k = (i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hk, mul_one]
    exact congrArg (fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ)) hk.symm
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hk, mul_zero]

/-- Actual Fourier coefficient at every integer frequency, including zero outside the finite support. -/
theorem circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleFejerPolynomial f N x) k =
      circleFejerWeight N k * fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k := by
  rw [circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff_sum]
  exact circleDifferenceSum_eq N k _

/-- The actual finite normalized Fourier weights tend to one at every fixed source frequency. -/
theorem circleFejerWeight_tendsto (k : ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => circleFejerWeight N k) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (k.natAbs : ℂ) / ((N : ℂ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (k.natAbs : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (k.natAbs : ℂ)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_zero] using
      hconst.mul (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℂ))
  have ht : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => 1 - (k.natAbs : ℂ) / ((N : ℂ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hone : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (1 : ℂ)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hone.sub hzero
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop k.natAbs] with N hN
  have he : ((N + 1 - k.natAbs : ℕ) : ℂ) = (N : ℂ) + 1 - (k.natAbs : ℂ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hn : ((N : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero N
  unfold circleFejerWeight
  rw [he]
  field_simp [hn]

/-- Actual convergence of every Fourier coefficient of the bounded Fejer polynomial. -/
theorem circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff_tendsto
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (k : ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => fourierCoeff (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleFejerPolynomial f N x) k)
      atTop (𝓝 (fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k)) := by
  have ht := (circleFejerWeight_tendsto k).mul_const (fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k)
  apply (show Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => circleFejerWeight N k * fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k)
    atTop (𝓝 (fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) k)) from by simpa only [one_mul] using ht).congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun N => (circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff f N k).symm)

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier.CircleFejerCoefficients
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.Holder
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Equicontinuity

/-!
# Actual Fejer convergence against every original L-one test function

Actual L-infinity/L-one Holder pairings have their computed uniform operator
norm bound. The normalized Fourier polynomial has the proved Fourier
coefficient limits; its pairings therefore converge on every Fourier
monomial in L-one. Stock dense Fourier span and closed convergence for an
equicontinuous family extend this to every actual L-one class. This is a
necessary proof for the source Hardy predual quotient map, not an assumed
weak-star approximation or chosen duality model.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open Filter MeasureTheory Set Topology
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

/-- Actual Holder norm bound for the original circle pairing. -/
theorem circleLpPairing_norm_apply_le
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (h : Lp ℂ 1 AddCircle.haarAddCircle) :
    ‖((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖h‖ := by
  let B := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ
  have hI : ‖((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h‖ ≤ ‖B.holder 1 f h‖ := by
    change ‖L1.integralCLM' ℂ (B.holder 1 f h)‖ ≤ ‖B.holder 1 f h‖
    rw [← L1.integral_eq']
    exact L1.norm_integral_le _
  have hB := B.norm_holder_apply_apply_le (r := 1) f h
  have hm : ‖B‖ * ‖f‖ * ‖h‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖h‖ := by
    have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mul_le ℂ ℂ)
      (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg f) (norm_nonneg h))
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using he
  exact hI.trans (hB.trans hm)

/-- Actual normalized-circle pairing has its computed operator-norm bound. -/
theorem circleLpPairing_norm_le (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) :
    ‖((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ :=
  (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg f)
      (circleLpPairing_norm_apply_le f)

/-- The actual finite Fejer polynomial as a genuine L-infinity boundary class. -/
def circleFejerLp (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle))
    (N : ℕ) : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) :=
  (circleFejerPolynomial f N).toLp ∞ AddCircle.haarAddCircle ℂ

/-- Literal boundary representative of the actual Fejer L-infinity class. -/
theorem circleFejerLp_coeFn
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) :
    (circleFejerLp f N : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) =ᵐ[AddCircle.haarAddCircle] circleFejerPolynomial f N :=
  ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp AddCircle.haarAddCircle _

/-- Actual Fejer L-infinity norm bound follows from the actual finite polynomial and stock toLp bound. -/
theorem circleFejerLp_norm_le
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖circleFejerLp f N‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
  have hC : ‖ContinuousMap.toLp (E := ℂ) ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) ℂ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_top, inv_zero, Real.rpow_zero] using
      ContinuousMap.toLp_norm_le (E := ℂ)
        (μ := (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (p := ∞) (𝕜 := ℂ)
  have hL := (ContinuousMap.toLp (E := ℂ) ∞
    (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) ℂ).le_opNorm (circleFejerPolynomial f N)
  exact hL.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (norm_nonneg _)).trans
    (by rw [one_mul]; exact circleFejerPolynomial_norm_le f N))

/-- Actual normalized Fejer pairings with each source L-one Fourier monomial. -/
theorem circleLpPairing_fourier
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (n : ℤ) :
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f (fourierLp 1 n) = fourierCoeff (f :
        UnitAddCircle → ℂ) (-n) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lpPairing_eq_integral]
  change (∫ x, f x * fourierLp 1 n x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
    ∫ x, fourier (-(-n)) x • f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [coeFn_fourierLp 1 n] with x hx
  rw [hx, neg_neg, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

/-- Actual Fejer pairings converge on each source L-one Fourier monomial. -/
theorem circleFejerLp_pairing_fourier_tendsto
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (n : ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N)
        (fourierLp 1 n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f (fourierLp 1 n))) := by
  have he : ∀ N : ℕ,
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) (fourierLp 1 n) =
        fourierCoeff (fun x : UnitAddCircle => circleFejerPolynomial f N x) (-n) := by
    intro N
    rw [circleLpPairing_fourier]
    exact congrFun (fourierCoeff_congr_ae (circleFejerLp_coeFn f N)) (-n)
  simp_rw [he, circleLpPairing_fourier]
  exact circleFejerPolynomial_fourierCoeff_tendsto f (-n)

/-- Computed uniform norm bound makes the actual Fejer functional family equicontinuous. -/
theorem circleFejerPairing_equicontinuous
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) :
    Equicontinuous (fun N : ℕ => (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
        (circleFejerLp f N) : Lp ℂ 1 AddCircle.haarAddCircle → ℂ)) := by
  intro h₀
  apply Metric.equicontinuousAt_iff.mpr
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  refine ⟨epsilon / (‖f‖ + 1), div_pos hepsilon (by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro h hh N
  have hN : ‖((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N)‖ ≤ ‖f‖ :=
    (circleLpPairing_norm_le _).trans (circleFejerLp_norm_le f N)
  have hd : dist (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) h₀)
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) h) ≤
      ‖f‖ * dist h h₀ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, dist_eq_norm']
    exact ((((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N)).le_opNorm
        _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (norm_nonneg _))
  calc
    dist (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) h₀)
        (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) h)
        ≤ (‖f‖ + 1) * dist h h₀ :=
      hd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 from zero_le_one))
        (dist_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist h h₀))
    _ < (‖f‖ + 1) * (epsilon / (‖f‖ + 1)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh (by positivity)
    _ = epsilon := by field_simp

/-- Actual pointwise convergence of Fejer pairings on every L-one boundary class. -/
theorem circleFejerLp_pairing_tendsto
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (h : Lp ℂ 1 AddCircle.haarAddCircle) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N)
        h) atTop (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h)) := by
  let M : Submodule ℂ (Lp ℂ 1 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) :=
    { carrier := {h | Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
        (circleFejerLp f N) h) atTop
        (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h))}
      zero_mem' := by
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) 0) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f 0))
        simpa only [map_zero] using
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)))
      add_mem' := by
        intro h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) h₁) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h₁)) at hh₁
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) h₂) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h₂)) at hh₂
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) (h₁ + h₂)) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f (h₁ + h₂)))
        simpa only [map_add] using hh₁.add hh₂
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c h hh
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) h) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h)) at hh
        change Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
            (circleFejerLp f N) (c • h)) atTop
          (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f (c • h)))
        simpa only [map_smul] using hh.const_smul c }
  have hclosed : IsClosed (M : Set (Lp ℂ 1 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle))) := by
    change IsClosed {h : Lp ℂ 1 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) |
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
        (circleFejerLp f N) h) atTop
        (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f h))}
    exact Equicontinuous.isClosed_setOfPred_tendsto
      (l := (atTop : Filter ℕ))
      (F := fun N : ℕ =>
        (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) (circleFejerLp f N) :
          Lp ℂ 1 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) → ℂ))
      (f := (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f :
        Lp ℂ 1 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) → ℂ))
      (circleFejerPairing_equicontinuous f)
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f).continuous
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fourierLp 1 (T := (1 : ℝ)))) ≤ M := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    change Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1)
        (circleFejerLp f N) (fourierLp 1 n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing AddCircle.haarAddCircle ∞ 1) f (fourierLp 1 n)))
    exact circleFejerLp_pairing_fourier_tendsto f n
  have hclosure :
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fourierLp 1 (T := (1 : ℝ))))).topologicalClosure ≤ M :=
    Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hclosed
  have hdense := span_fourierLp_closure_eq_top (T := (1 : ℝ)) (p := 1) (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞)
  rw [hdense] at hclosure
  change h ∈ M
  exact hclosure Submodule.mem_top

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier.CircleFejer
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSeminorm.CompareExp
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSeminorm.LpNorm

/-!
# Actual finite Fourier Fejer polynomial and its norm bound

The polynomial is the literal normalized double Fourier sum. The same value
is the integral of the actual positive normalized kernel against the actual
L-infinity boundary class. The kernel therefore gives the genuine uniform
norm bound needed for the Hardy predual annihilation proof. This module uses
only stock Lp and circle APIs, without a source Hardy or duality model.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open Filter MeasureTheory Set Topology
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

/-- Actual finite Fourier polynomial of a normalized-circle L-infinity function. -/
def circleFejerPolynomial (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle))
    (N : ℕ) : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) :=
  (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
    fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) ((i : ℤ) - j) • fourier ((i : ℤ) - j)

/-- The actual circle Fourier character converts argument subtraction to its literal product formula. -/
theorem circleFourier_apply_sub (n : ℤ) (x t : UnitAddCircle) :
    fourier n (x - t) = fourier n x * fourier (-n) t := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, fourier_apply, zsmul_add, AddCircle.toCircle_add, _root_.Circle.coe_mul]
  have hn : n • (-t) = (-n) • t := by rw [smul_neg, neg_smul]
  rw [hn]
  rfl

/-- Literal finite Fourier expansion of the actual positive normalized Fejer kernel. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_fourier (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    circleFejerKernel N x = (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), fourier ((i : ℤ) - j) x := by
  change (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    (Star.star (circleDirichletPolynomial N x) * circleDirichletPolynomial N x) = _
  rw [circleDirichletPolynomial_apply]
  have hs : Star.star (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), fourier (j : ℤ) x) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), Star.star (fourier (j : ℤ) x) := by
    simpa only [starRingEnd_apply] using
      map_sum (starRingEnd ℂ) (fun j : ℕ => fourier (j : ℤ) x) (Finset.range (N + 1))
  rw [hs, Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1
  funext i
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * z)
  have hjstar : Star.star (fourier (j : ℤ) x) = fourier (-(j : ℤ)) x := by
    simpa only [RCLike.star_def] using (fourier_neg (n := (j : ℤ)) (x := x)).symm
  rw [hjstar, mul_comm, ← fourier_add, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Each literal kernel-Fourier term has the actual boundary integral coefficient. -/
theorem circleFourier_integral_translate
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (n : ℤ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    (∫ t, f t * fourier n (x - t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
      fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) n * fourier n x := by
  have he : (fun t : UnitAddCircle => f t * fourier n (x - t)) =
      fun t => (fourier n x) * (fourier (-n) t • f t) := by
    funext t
    rw [circleFourier_apply_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [he, integral_const_mul]
  change fourier n x * fourierCoeff (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) n = _
  exact mul_comm _ _

/-- The literal Fourier kernel terms are integrable for the actual boundary function. -/
theorem circleFourier_translate_integrable
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (n : ℤ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    Integrable (fun t => f t * fourier n (x - t)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
  have hf : Integrable (f : UnitAddCircle → ℂ) AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp ((Lp.memLp f).mono_exponent (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ∞))
  have h := (hf.fourier_smul (-n)).const_mul (fourier n x)
  apply h.congr
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => by
    change fourier n x * (fourier (-n) t • f t) = f t * fourier n (x - t)
    rw [circleFourier_apply_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    ring)

/-- The actual finite Fourier polynomial equals convolution with the genuine normalized positive kernel. -/
theorem circleFejerPolynomial_eq_integral
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    circleFejerPolynomial f N x =
      ∫ t, f t * circleFejerKernel N (x - t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
  have he : (fun t : UnitAddCircle => f t * circleFejerKernel N (x - t)) =
      (fun t : UnitAddCircle => (N + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          f t * fourier ((i : ℤ) - j) (x - t))) := by
    funext t
    rw [circleFejerKernel_fourier]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  rw [he, integral_smul]
  rw [integral_finsetSum (Finset.range (N + 1)) (fun (i : ℕ) hi =>
    integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range (N + 1))
      (fun (j : ℕ) hj => circleFourier_translate_integrable f ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x))]
  have hInner (i : ℕ) :
      (∫ t : UnitAddCircle, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        f t * fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) (x - t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          ∫ t : UnitAddCircle, f t * fourier ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) (x - t)
            ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
    exact integral_finsetSum (Finset.range (N + 1))
      (fun (j : ℕ) hj => circleFourier_translate_integrable f ((i : ℤ) - (j : ℤ)) x)
  simp_rw [hInner, circleFourier_integral_translate]
  simp only [circleFejerPolynomial, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMap.sum_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]

/-- The actual translated kernel has real unit mass, with its genuine continuity/integrability proof. -/
theorem circleFejerKernel_integral_re_sub (N : ℕ) (x : UnitAddCircle) :
    (∫ t, (circleFejerKernel N (x - t)).re ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) = 1 := by
  have hI : Integrable (fun t => circleFejerKernel N (x - t))
      (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (ContinuousMap.memLp (p := (1 : ℝ≥0∞))
      (μ := (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) ℂ
      (⟨fun t => circleFejerKernel N (x - t),
        (circleFejerKernel N).continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)⟩ : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)))
  have hRe := (Complex.reCLM : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ).integral_comp_comm hI
  simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply] at hRe
  rw [hRe, circleFejerKernel_integral_sub]
  rfl

/-- Genuine uniform Fejer norm bound on every actual normalized-circle L-infinity class. -/
theorem circleFejerPolynomial_norm_le
    (f : Lp ℂ ∞ (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖circleFejerPolynomial f N‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le (f := circleFejerPolynomial f N) (norm_nonneg f)).mpr
  intro x
  rw [circleFejerPolynomial_eq_integral]
  have hI : Integrable (fun t => ‖f‖ * (circleFejerKernel N (x - t)).re)
      (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) :=
    (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (ContinuousMap.memLp (p := (1 : ℝ≥0∞))
      (μ := (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle)) ℝ
      (⟨fun t => (circleFejerKernel N (x - t)).re,
        Complex.continuous_re.comp
          ((circleFejerKernel N).continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))⟩ : C(UnitAddCircle,
    ℝ)))).const_mul _
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle,
      ‖f t * circleFejerKernel N (x - t)‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * (circleFejerKernel N (x - t)).re := by
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_le_lpNorm_exponent_top (Lp.memLp f)] with t ht
    have htf : ‖f t‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
      simpa only [← toReal_eLpNorm, Lp.norm_def] using ht
    rw [norm_mul, circleFejerKernel_norm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htf (circleFejerKernel_re_nonneg _ _)
  have he := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hI hbound
  rw [integral_const_mul, circleFejerKernel_integral_re_sub, mul_one] at he
  exact he

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Fourier

module

public import Mathlib.Basic.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Log

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.GeomSum
