module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space

import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-!
# The bilateral shift on `ℓ²`

This file defines the forward bilateral shift on the canonical Mathlib carrier
`lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2`.  It moves each coordinate one place to the right:
the value at `n` after shifting is the old value at `n - 1`.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace lp

universe u v

variable {𝕜 : Type u} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable {G : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
  [hG : CompleteSpace G]

/-! ## Reindexing on the canonical `lp` carrier -/

/-- Reindex an `ℓ²(ℤ, G)` vector along an equivalence of `ℤ`. -/
def bilateralReindexSeq (e : ℤ ≃ ℤ)
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) : ℤ → G :=
  fun n ↦ x (e n)

omit hG in
theorem bilateralReindexSeq_mem (e : ℤ ≃ ℤ)
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) :
    Memℓp (bilateralReindexSeq e x) 2 := by
  have hp : 0 < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have hx : Summable (fun n : ℤ ↦ ‖x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) :=
    (memℓp_gen_iff hp).mp (lp.memℓp x)
  have hreindex :
      Summable (fun n : ℤ ↦ ‖x (e n)‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) :=
    e.summable_iff.mpr hx
  exact memℓp_gen hreindex

omit hG in
/-- Reindexing by an equivalence preserves the `ℓ²` norm. -/
theorem bilateralReindexSeq_norm (e : ℤ ≃ ℤ)
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) :
    ‖(⟨bilateralReindexSeq e x, bilateralReindexSeq_mem e x⟩ :
        lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2)‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  have hp : 0 < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have hsum :
      (∑' n : ℤ, ‖bilateralReindexSeq e x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) =
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by
    change (∑' n : ℤ, ‖x (e n)‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) = _
    exact e.tsum_eq (fun n : ℤ ↦ ‖x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal)
  have hnormReindex :
      ‖(⟨bilateralReindexSeq e x, bilateralReindexSeq_mem e x⟩ :
          lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2)‖ =
        ((∑' n : ℤ,
            ‖bilateralReindexSeq e x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) ^
          ((1 : ℝ) / (2 : ENNReal).toReal)) := by
    rw [lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow hp]
  have hnormInput :
      ‖x‖ = ((∑' n : ℤ, ‖x n‖ ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal) ^
        ((1 : ℝ) / (2 : ENNReal).toReal)) := by
    rw [lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow hp]
  rw [hnormReindex, hnormInput, hsum]

/-- The linear reindexing map induced by an equivalence of `ℤ`. -/
def bilateralReindexLinear (e : ℤ ≃ ℤ) :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →ₗ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 where
  toFun x := ⟨bilateralReindexSeq e x, bilateralReindexSeq_mem e x⟩
  map_add' x y := by
    apply lp.ext
    funext n
    simp only [bilateralReindexSeq, lp.coeFn_add, Pi.add_apply]
  map_smul' c x := by
    apply lp.ext
    funext n
    simp only [bilateralReindexSeq, lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]

omit hG in
theorem bilateralReindexLinear_norm (e : ℤ ≃ ℤ)
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) :
    ‖bilateralReindexLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) e x‖ = ‖x‖ :=
  bilateralReindexSeq_norm e x

/-! ## Forward and inverse translations -/

/-- The forward/right translation before it is bundled continuously. -/
def bilateralShiftLinear :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →ₗ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 :=
  bilateralReindexLinear (Equiv.subRight (1 : ℤ))

/-- The inverse/left translation before it is bundled continuously. -/
def bilateralShiftInverseLinear :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →ₗ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 :=
  bilateralReindexLinear (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ))

omit hG in
@[simp]
private theorem bilateralShiftLinear_apply
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) (n : ℤ) :
    bilateralShiftLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x n = x (n - 1) :=
  rfl

omit hG in
@[simp]
private theorem bilateralShiftInverseLinear_apply
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) (n : ℤ) :
    bilateralShiftInverseLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x n = x (n + 1) :=
  rfl

omit hG in
theorem bilateralShiftLinear_norm
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) :
    ‖bilateralShiftLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x‖ = ‖x‖ :=
  bilateralReindexLinear_norm (Equiv.subRight (1 : ℤ)) x

omit hG in
private theorem bilateralShiftLinear_comp_inverse :
    (bilateralShiftLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)).comp
        bilateralShiftInverseLinear = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change x ((n - 1) + 1) = x n
  rw [sub_add_cancel]

omit hG in
private theorem bilateralShiftInverse_comp_linear :
    (bilateralShiftInverseLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)).comp
        bilateralShiftLinear = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change x ((n + 1) - 1) = x n
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right]

private def bilateralShiftLinearIsometry :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →ₗᵢ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 where
  toLinearMap := bilateralShiftLinear
  norm_map' := bilateralShiftLinear_norm

/-- The linearly isometric equivalence underlying the bilateral shift. -/
private noncomputable def bilateralShiftEquiv :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofLinearIsometry
    bilateralShiftLinearIsometry bilateralShiftInverseLinear
    bilateralShiftLinear_comp_inverse bilateralShiftInverse_comp_linear

/-! ## Public bilateral-shift API -/

/-- The forward/right bilateral shift on `ℓ²(ℤ, G)`. -/
noncomputable def bilateralShift :
    lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →L[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 :=
  bilateralShiftLinear.mkContinuous 1 fun x ↦ by
    rw [bilateralShiftLinear_norm, one_mul]

omit hG in
/-- Coordinate formula for the forward/right bilateral shift. -/
@[simp]
theorem bilateralShift_apply
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) (n : ℤ) :
    bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) x n = x (n - 1) := by
  change bilateralShiftLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x n = x (n - 1)
  rfl

omit hG in
/-- The bilateral shift moves the `n`-th single to the `(n+1)`-st. -/
@[simp]
theorem bilateralShift_single (n : ℤ) (g : G) :
    bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜)
        (lp.single (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 n g) =
      lp.single (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 (n + 1) g := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext j
  rw [bilateralShift_apply]
  by_cases h : j - 1 = n
  · have hj : j = n + 1 := by linarith
    rw [h, hj]
    rw [lp.single_apply_self]
    rw [lp.single_apply_self]
  · have hj : j ≠ n + 1 := by
      intro hj
      apply h
      linarith
    rw [lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 n g h]
    rw [lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 (n + 1) g hj]

omit hG in
/-- The bilateral shift preserves the `ℓ²` norm. -/
theorem bilateralShift_norm (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) :
    ‖bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  change ‖bilateralShiftLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x‖ = ‖x‖
  exact bilateralShiftLinear_norm x

omit hG in
/-- The bilateral shift is an isometry. -/
theorem bilateralShift_isometry :
    Isometry (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) :=
  (AddMonoidHomClass.isometry_iff_norm _).mpr bilateralShift_norm

private theorem adjoint_bilateralShift_eq_inverse :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) =
      ((bilateralShiftEquiv (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)).symm :
        lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →L[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) := by
  have hshift : bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G) =
      (bilateralShiftEquiv (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G) :
        lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →L[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  rw [hshift]
  exact (bilateralShiftEquiv (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)).adjoint_eq_symm

/-- The adjoint is the inverse translation, with value `x (n+1)` at `n`. -/
@[simp]
theorem adjoint_bilateralShift_apply
    (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) (n : ℤ) :
    star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) x n = x (n + 1) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, adjoint_bilateralShift_eq_inverse]
  change bilateralShiftInverseLinear (𝕜 := 𝕜) x n = x (n + 1)
  rfl

/-- The adjoint moves the `n`-th single to the `(n-1)`-st. -/
@[simp]
theorem adjoint_bilateralShift_single (n : ℤ) (g : G) :
    star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G))
        (lp.single (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 n g) =
      lp.single (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 (n - 1) g := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext j
  rw [adjoint_bilateralShift_apply]
  by_cases h : j + 1 = n
  · have hj : j = n - 1 := by linarith
    rw [h, hj]
    rw [lp.single_apply_self]
    rw [lp.single_apply_self]
  · have hj : j ≠ n - 1 := by
      intro hj
      apply h
      linarith
    rw [lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 n g h]
    rw [lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 (n - 1) g hj]

/-- The adjoint followed by the bilateral shift is the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem adjoint_bilateralShift_comp_bilateralShift :
    star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) ∘L
        bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G) = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change (star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G))
      (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) x)) n = x n
  rw [adjoint_bilateralShift_apply, bilateralShift_apply]
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right]

/-- The bilateral shift followed by its adjoint is the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem bilateralShift_comp_adjoint_bilateralShift :
    bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G) ∘L
        star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜)
      (star (bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G)) x)) n = x n
  rw [bilateralShift_apply, adjoint_bilateralShift_apply]
  rw [sub_add_cancel]

/-- The bilateral shift is a unitary continuous linear endomorphism. -/
theorem bilateralShift_mem_unitary :
    bilateralShift (𝕜 := 𝕜) (G := G) ∈
      unitary (lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2 →L[𝕜]
        lp (fun _ : ℤ ↦ G) 2) := by
  rw [Unitary.mem_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]
    exact adjoint_bilateralShift_comp_bilateralShift
  · rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]
    exact bilateralShift_comp_adjoint_bilateralShift

end lp

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Submodule

/-!
# The canonical closed-range projection of a Hilbert-space operator

The orthogonal projection is computed on the actual closure of the original
operator range. No closed-range, positivity, algebra-membership or projection
certificate is an input. Textbook and concrete von Neumann consumers share
this single generic construction and its literal stock range contracts.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The orthogonal projection onto the actual closure of the operator's range. -/
def closedRangeProjection (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  T.range.topologicalClosure.starProjection

/-- The canonical closed-range projection is the original stock star projection. -/
theorem closedRangeProjection_eq_starProjection (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    closedRangeProjection T = T.range.topologicalClosure.starProjection :=
  rfl

/-- The constructed closed-range operator is a genuine star projection. -/
theorem isStarProjection_closedRangeProjection (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsStarProjection (closedRangeProjection T) :=
  isStarProjection_starProjection

/-- Its actual operator range equals the closure of the original range. -/
theorem range_closedRangeProjection (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (closedRangeProjection T).range = T.range.topologicalClosure :=
  Submodule.range_starProjection _

/-- Each projected vector lies in the original closed range. -/
theorem closedRangeProjection_apply_mem (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (x : H) :
    closedRangeProjection T x ∈ T.range.topologicalClosure :=
  Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem _ _

/-- The actual closed-range projection fixes every value of the original operator. -/
theorem closedRangeProjection_mul_self (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    closedRangeProjection T * T = T := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change T.range.topologicalClosure.starProjection (T x) = T x
  apply Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr
  exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ ⟨x, rfl⟩

variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℂ K]

/-- A continuous linear map annihilating T also annihilates its closed-range projection. -/
theorem comp_closedRangeProjection_eq_zero (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (B : H →L[ℂ] K)
    (hBT : B.comp T = 0) : B.comp (closedRangeProjection T) = 0 := by
  let N : Submodule ℂ H := LinearMap.ker B.toLinearMap
  have hNclosed : IsClosed (N : Set H) := by
    change IsClosed (B ⁻¹' ({0} : Set K))
    exact isClosed_singleton.preimage B.continuous
  have hrange : T.range ≤ N := by
    rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change B (T y) = 0
    have h := congrArg (fun C : H →L[ℂ] K => C y) hBT
    simpa only [comp_apply, zero_apply] using h
  have hclosure : T.range.topologicalClosure ≤ N :=
    Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hrange hNclosed
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change B (closedRangeProjection T x) = 0
  exact hclosure (closedRangeProjection_apply_mem T x)

end

end ContinuousLinearMap

module

public import Mathlib.Basic.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Basic

/-!
# Finite complex unit vectors

This module defines finite-dimensional normalized complex vectors in the
natural complex inner-product domain. A unit vector is indexed by a finite
type and satisfies the normalization condition `∑ i, star (coord i) * coord i = 1`,
corresponding to unit norm in the standard complex inner product on `d → ℂ`.

## Main definitions

* `Complex.UnitVector d` – unit vector on index type `d` with complex coordinates.

## Main results

* `UnitVector.ext` – extensionality by coordinates.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators
open Complex

namespace Complex

/-- A finite-dimensional normalized complex vector in the natural complex
    inner-product space, indexed by a finite type `d`. Normalization is
    expressed as `∑ i, star (coord i) * coord i = 1`, i.e. unit norm for the
    standard Hermitian inner product on `d → ℂ`. -/
structure UnitVector (d : Type*) [Fintype d] where
  /-- The complex coordinates of the vector, indexed by `d`. -/
  coord : d → ℂ
  normalized' : ∑ i, star (coord i) * coord i = 1

instance {d : Type*} [Fintype d] :
    CoeFun (UnitVector d) (fun _ => d → ℂ) where
  coe := UnitVector.coord

@[ext]
theorem UnitVector.ext {d : Type*} [Fintype d]
    {u v : UnitVector d} (h : ∀ i, u.coord i = v.coord i) : u = v := by
  have hfun : u.coord = v.coord := funext h
  cases u with
  | mk coord₁ norm₁ =>
    cases v with
    | mk coord₂ norm₂ =>
      simp_all

end Complex

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic

/-!
# One-step gradient descent identities

For a real inner product space, the squared distance after one gradient-descent
step expands into a cross term plus a squared gradient term. A projected step
whose projection inequality holds for every comparator in a feasible set `K`
(Hazan Thm 2.1 / Eq 3.2 shape) satisfies the same expansion as an upper bound
against comparators in `K`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped InnerProductSpace

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- One-step gradient-descent identity: the squared distance of the update
`x - η • g` to a comparator `c` expands exactly. -/
theorem gradientDescentStep_sq_norm (x g c : E) (η : ℝ) :
    ‖x - η • g - c‖ ^ 2 = ‖x - c‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * ⟪g, x - c⟫_ℝ + η ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
  have heq : x - η • g - c = (x - c) - η • g := by abel
  rw [heq, norm_sub_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    mul_pow, sq_abs]
  rw [real_inner_comm g (x - c)]
  ring

/-- Projected one-step bound, set-scoped: if `c ∈ K` and `xn` is no farther
than the unprojected update `x - η • g` from every point of `K`, then its
squared distance to `c` is bounded by the one-step expansion.

The comparator set cannot be dropped: an ambient `∀ d` hypothesis would force
`xn = x - η • g` (take `d := x - η • g`), collapsing the projection to the
identity. -/
theorem projectedGradientDescentStep_sq_norm_le (x g : E) (η : ℝ) (K : Set E)
    (xn c : E) (hc : c ∈ K)
    (hproj : ∀ d ∈ K, ‖xn - d‖ ≤ ‖x - η • g - d‖) :
    ‖xn - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - c‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * ⟪g, x - c⟫_ℝ + η ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖xn - c‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hle : ‖xn - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - η • g - c‖ ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 (hproj c hc) 2
  rw [gradientDescentStep_sq_norm] at hle
  exact hle

Author: @toskua

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator

import Mathlib.Tactic.NoncommRing

/-!
# Bounded Hilbert-space Fredholm modules over an involutive algebra

This file gives the neutral bounded-operator carrier shared by Connes's
Fredholm modules and the Hilbert-space specialization of Kasparov cycles.  The
source algebra is purely algebraic: it is not assumed normed, complete,
separable, or a C-star algebra.  Its representation is the existing
`NonUnitalStarAlgHom` into bounded Hilbert-space operators.

The bundled unnormalized carrier uses the right-localized compact defects of
Higson--Roe and Blackadar.  The left-localized form printed by Connes is
strictly equivalent, by compact-ideal, composition, and adjoint laws; it is
not a second set of structure fields.  Normalized odd and even carriers store
only their literal exact equations and compact commutators.

No quotient class, index, Calkin unit, `KK` object, scalar Hilbert-module
dictionary, or source theorem is part of these definitions.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace HilbertFredholmModule

universe uA uH

/-- The representation and bounded operator underlying a Hilbert-space
Fredholm module.  There are deliberately no compactness conclusions in this
raw carrier. -/
structure Data (A : Type uA) (H : Type uH)
    [NonUnitalRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A]
    [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A]
    [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] where
  /-- The possibly nonunital involutive complex representation. -/
  representation : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)
  /-- The bounded cycle operator. -/
  operator : H →L[ℂ] H

variable {A : Type uA} {H : Type uH}
variable [NonUnitalRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A]
variable [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A]
variable [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The ordinary commutator of the cycle operator with a represented
coefficient.  Graded source algebras require a separate signed extension. -/
def Data.commutator (M : Data A H) (a : A) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  M.operator * M.representation a - M.representation a * M.operator

/-- The square defect `F² - 1`. -/
def Data.squareDefect (M : Data A H) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  M.operator * M.operator - 1

/-- The adjoint defect `F - F*`. -/
def Data.adjointDefect (M : Data A H) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  M.operator - star M.operator

/-- The right-localized compact-defect convention of Higson--Roe and
Blackadar. -/
def Data.IsRightFredholm (M : Data A H) : Prop :=
  (∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.commutator a)) ∧
    (∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.squareDefect * M.representation a)) ∧
    ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.adjointDefect * M.representation a)

/-- The left-localized compact-defect convention used in Connes's comparison
with normalized Fredholm modules. -/
def Data.IsLeftFredholm (M : Data A H) : Prop :=
  (∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.commutator a)) ∧
    (∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.representation a * M.squareDefect)) ∧
    ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.representation a * M.adjointDefect)

/-- An unnormalized bounded Hilbert-space Fredholm module, using one literal
set of right-localized compactness fields. -/
structure Module (A : Type uA) (H : Type uH)
    [NonUnitalRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A]
    [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A]
    [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    extends Data A H where
  commutator_compact : ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (toData.commutator a)
  square_compact_right :
    ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (toData.squareDefect * toData.representation a)
  adjoint_compact_right :
    ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (toData.adjointDefect * toData.representation a)

/-- Package a proved right-oriented defining predicate.  This is only the
constructor for the literal fields, not a selected Fredholm output. -/
def Data.toModule (M : Data A H) (hM : M.IsRightFredholm) : Module A H where
  toData := M
  commutator_compact := hM.1
  square_compact_right := hM.2.1
  adjoint_compact_right := hM.2.2

/-- The bundled fields are exactly the right-localized Fredholm predicate. -/
theorem Module.isRightFredholm (M : Module A H) : M.toData.IsRightFredholm :=
  ⟨M.commutator_compact, M.square_compact_right, M.adjoint_compact_right⟩

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem compact_mul_left (S T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) : IsCompactOperator (S * T) := by
  change IsCompactOperator (S.comp T)
  exact hT.clm_comp S

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem compact_mul_right (T S : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) : IsCompactOperator (T * S) := by
  change IsCompactOperator (T.comp S)
  exact hT.comp_clm S

private theorem squareDefect_commutator_identity (M : Data A H) (a : A) :
    M.squareDefect * M.representation a -
        M.representation a * M.squareDefect =
      M.operator * M.commutator a + M.commutator a * M.operator := by
  dsimp only [Data.squareDefect, Data.commutator]
  noncomm_ring

private theorem adjointDefect_commutator_identity (M : Data A H) (a : A) :
    M.adjointDefect * M.representation a -
        M.representation a * M.adjointDefect =
      M.commutator a + star (M.commutator (star a)) := by
  simp only [Data.adjointDefect, Data.commutator, map_star, star_sub,
    star_mul, star_star]
  noncomm_ring

private theorem squareDefect_difference_compact (M : Data A H)
    (hcomm : ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.commutator a)) (a : A) :
    IsCompactOperator
      (M.squareDefect * M.representation a -
        M.representation a * M.squareDefect) := by
  rw [squareDefect_commutator_identity]
  exact (compact_mul_left _ _ (hcomm a)).add
    (compact_mul_right _ _ (hcomm a))

private theorem adjointDefect_difference_compact (M : Data A H)
    (hcomm : ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (M.commutator a)) (a : A) :
    IsCompactOperator
      (M.adjointDefect * M.representation a -
        M.representation a * M.adjointDefect) := by
  have hstar : IsCompactOperator
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (M.commutator (star a))) :=
    (hcomm (star a)).adjoint
  have hstar' : IsCompactOperator
      (star (M.commutator (star a)) : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
    exact hstar
  rw [adjointDefect_commutator_identity]
  exact (hcomm a).add hstar'

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem compact_left_of_right_of_sub
    (right left : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hright : IsCompactOperator right)
    (hdiff : IsCompactOperator (right - left)) :
    IsCompactOperator left := by
  change IsCompactOperator (fun x => left x)
  have h := hright.sub hdiff
  change IsCompactOperator (fun x => right x - (right - left) x) at h
  have heq : (fun x => right x - (right - left) x) =
      (fun x => left x) := by
    funext x
    change right x - (right x - left x) = left x
    rw [sub_sub_cancel]
  rw [← heq]
  exact h

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem compact_right_of_left_of_sub
    (right left : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hleft : IsCompactOperator left)
    (hdiff : IsCompactOperator (right - left)) :
    IsCompactOperator right := by
  change IsCompactOperator (fun x => right x)
  have h := hdiff.add hleft
  change IsCompactOperator (fun x => (right - left) x + left x) at h
  have heq : (fun x => (right - left) x + left x) =
      (fun x => right x) := by
    funext x
    change (right x - left x) + left x = right x
    rw [sub_add_cancel]
  rw [← heq]
  exact h

/-- The right- and left-localized compact-defect conventions are equivalent.
Only the right convention is stored in `Module`. -/
theorem Data.isRightFredholm_iff_isLeftFredholm (M : Data A H) :
    M.IsRightFredholm ↔ M.IsLeftFredholm := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hcomm, hsquare, hadjoint⟩
    refine ⟨hcomm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a
      exact compact_left_of_right_of_sub _ _ (hsquare a)
        (squareDefect_difference_compact M hcomm a)
    · intro a
      exact compact_left_of_right_of_sub _ _ (hadjoint a)
        (adjointDefect_difference_compact M hcomm a)
  · rintro ⟨hcomm, hsquare, hadjoint⟩
    refine ⟨hcomm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a
      exact compact_right_of_left_of_sub _ _ (hsquare a)
        (squareDefect_difference_compact M hcomm a)
    · intro a
      exact compact_right_of_left_of_sub _ _ (hadjoint a)
        (adjointDefect_difference_compact M hcomm a)

/-- A right-localized square defect is also compact after localization on the
left. -/
theorem Module.square_compact_left (M : Module A H) (a : A) :
    IsCompactOperator (M.toData.representation a * M.toData.squareDefect) :=
  (M.toData.isRightFredholm_iff_isLeftFredholm.mp M.isRightFredholm).2.1 a

/-- A right-localized adjoint defect is also compact after localization on the
left. -/
theorem Module.adjoint_compact_left (M : Module A H) (a : A) :
    IsCompactOperator (M.toData.representation a * M.toData.adjointDefect) :=
  (M.toData.isRightFredholm_iff_isLeftFredholm.mp M.isRightFredholm).2.2 a

/-- The right-oriented bundled definition strictly implies Connes's
left-localized compact-defect convention. -/
theorem Module.isLeftFredholm (M : Module A H) : M.toData.IsLeftFredholm :=
  M.toData.isRightFredholm_iff_isLeftFredholm.mp M.isRightFredholm

/-- A normalized odd Fredholm module.  Compactness of the square and adjoint
defects is not requested because both defects are literally zero. -/
structure NormalizedOdd (A : Type uA) (H : Type uH)
    [NonUnitalRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A]
    [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A]
    [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    extends Data A H where
  commutator_compact : ∀ a : A, IsCompactOperator (toData.commutator a)
  operator_selfAdjoint : star toData.operator = toData.operator
  operator_square : toData.operator * toData.operator = 1

/-- A normalized odd module gives an unnormalized module without any selected
compactness output. -/
def NormalizedOdd.toModule (M : NormalizedOdd A H) : Module A H where
  toData := M.toData
  commutator_compact := M.commutator_compact
  square_compact_right := by
    intro a
    rw [Data.squareDefect, M.operator_square, sub_self, zero_mul]
    exact isCompactOperator_zero
  adjoint_compact_right := by
    intro a
    rw [Data.adjointDefect, M.operator_selfAdjoint, sub_self, zero_mul]
    exact isCompactOperator_zero

/-- A normalized even Fredholm module over an ungraded source algebra.  The
grading is stored as the literal selfadjoint involution of Connes IV.1. -/
structure NormalizedEven (A : Type uA) (H : Type uH)
    [NonUnitalRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A]
    [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A]
    [StarRing A] [StarModule ℂ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    extends NormalizedOdd A H where
  /-- The self-adjoint grading involution on the Hilbert space. -/
  grading : H →L[ℂ] H
  grading_selfAdjoint : star grading = grading
  grading_square : grading * grading = 1
  representation_even : ∀ a : A,
    grading * toNormalizedOdd.toData.representation a =
      toNormalizedOdd.toData.representation a * grading
  operator_odd :
    grading * toNormalizedOdd.toData.operator =
      -(toNormalizedOdd.toData.operator * grading)

/-- Forgetting the grading of a normalized even module gives the same strict
unnormalized Fredholm module as its normalized odd part. -/
def NormalizedEven.toModule (M : NormalizedEven A H) : Module A H :=
  M.toNormalizedOdd.toModule

end HilbertFredholmModule

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CompactSupport
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.PontryaginDual
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSeminorm.CompareExp

/-!
# Actual unitary character multiplication on the original Haar L2 carrier

A continuous unit-modulus character multiplies the same original Lp H 2
representatives. Its inverse is multiplication by the inverse character;
the original pointwise norm gives an actual unitary group homomorphism.
The character convention is Connes's positive multiplication chi(s)xi(s).
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology InnerProductSpace

namespace MeasureTheory
namespace HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G)
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- The actual original L2 operator multiplying by the continuous character at every coordinate. -/
def characterMultiplier (χ : PontryaginDual G) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ := by
  let φ : G → ℂ := fun s => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ)
  have hφcont : Continuous φ := continuous_subtype_val.comp (map_continuous χ)
  have hφ : MemLp φ ∞ μ := memLp_top_of_bound hφcont.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun s => (Circle.norm_coe (χ s)).le)
  have hF (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : MemLp (φ • (ξ : G → H)) 2 μ :=
    hφ.smul (Lp.memLp ξ) (p := ∞) (q := 2) (r := 2)
  let F (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : Lp H 2 μ := (hF ξ).toLp (φ • (ξ : G → H))
  have hFae (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : F ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s => φ s • ξ s := (hF ξ).coeFn_toLp
  let F₀ : Lp H 2 μ →ₗ[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    { toFun := F
      map_add' ξ η := by
        apply Lp.ext
        filter_upwards [hFae (ξ + η), hFae ξ, hFae η, Lp.coeFn_add ξ η,
          Lp.coeFn_add (F ξ) (F η)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅
        rw [h₁, h₅]
        change φ s • (ξ + η) s = F ξ s + F η s
        rw [h₂, h₃, h₄]
        change φ s • (ξ s + η s) = φ s • ξ s + φ s • η s
        exact smul_add _ _ _
      map_smul' c ξ := by
        apply Lp.ext
        filter_upwards [hFae (c • ξ), hFae ξ, Lp.coeFn_smul c ξ,
          Lp.coeFn_smul c (F ξ)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
        rw [RingHom.id_apply, h₁, h₄]
        change φ s • (c • ξ) s = c • F ξ s
        rw [h₂, h₃]
        change φ s • (c • ξ s) = c • (φ s • ξ s)
        exact smul_comm _ _ _ }
  have hbound (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : ‖F₀ ξ‖ ≤ 1 * ‖ξ‖ := by
    apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
    filter_upwards [hFae ξ] with s hs
    change ‖F ξ s‖ ≤ 1 * ‖ξ s‖
    rw [hs, norm_smul]
    change ‖((χ s : Circle) : ℂ)‖ * ‖ξ s‖ ≤ 1 * ‖ξ s‖
    rw [Circle.norm_coe]
  exact F₀.mkContinuous 1 hbound

/-- Character multiplication has its literal original coordinate values almost everywhere. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s := by
  let φ : G → ℂ := fun s => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ)
  have hφcont : Continuous φ := continuous_subtype_val.comp (map_continuous χ)
  have hφ : MemLp φ ∞ μ := memLp_top_of_bound hφcont.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun s => (Circle.norm_coe (χ s)).le)
  have hproduct : MemLp (φ • (ξ : G → H)) 2 μ :=
    hφ.smul (Lp.memLp ξ) (p := ∞) (q := 2) (r := 2)
  change hproduct.toLp (φ • (ξ : G → H)) =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => φ s • ξ s
  exact hproduct.coeFn_toLp

/-- Actual character multiplication preserves the original Haar L2 norm. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_norm (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    ‖characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ‖ = ‖ξ‖ := by
  have h : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ‖characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ s‖ = ‖ξ s‖ := by
    filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ ξ] with s hs
    rw [hs, norm_smul, Circle.norm_coe, one_mul]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le (h.mono fun s hs => hs.le)
  · exact Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le (h.mono fun s hs => hs.symm.le)

/-- The identity character is the identity operator on the same actual L2 space. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_one : characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (1 : PontryaginDual G) = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ (1 : PontryaginDual G) ξ] with s hs
  change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (1 : PontryaginDual G) ξ s = ξ s
  rw [hs, PontryaginDual.one_apply, Circle.coe_one, one_smul]

/-- Character products are actual composition products of their original L2 multipliers. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_mul (χ ψ : PontryaginDual G) :
    characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (χ * ψ) = characterMultiplier μ χ * characterMultiplier μ ψ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ (χ * ψ) ξ,
    characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ (characterMultiplier μ ψ ξ),
    characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ ψ ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (χ * ψ) ξ s =
    characterMultiplier μ χ (characterMultiplier μ ψ ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  change (((χ s * ψ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s) =
    ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • (((ψ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s)
  rw [Circle.coe_mul, mul_smul]

variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual character multiplication unitary, with inverse given by the inverse character. -/
def characterMultiplierUnitary (χ : PontryaginDual G) : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by
  let I : Lp H 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    { toLinearMap := (characterMultiplier μ χ).toLinearMap
      norm_map' := characterMultiplier_norm μ χ }
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective I := by
    intro ξ
    refine ⟨characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ, ?_⟩
    change ((characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ * characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ⁻¹) :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ξ = ξ
    rw [← characterMultiplier_mul, mul_inv_cancel, characterMultiplier_one]
    rfl
  exact Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm (LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective I hsurj)

/-- The actual character unitary retains the same original a.e. scalar multiplication formula. -/
theorem characterMultiplierUnitary_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s : G => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s := by
  change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ =ᵐ[μ] _
  exact characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ ξ

/-- The original character multipliers form their actual unitary group homomorphism. -/
def characterMultiplierUnitaryHom : PontryaginDual G →* unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) where
  toFun := characterMultiplierUnitary μ
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (1 : PontryaginDual G) = 1
    exact characterMultiplier_one μ
  map_mul' χ ψ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ (χ * ψ) =
      characterMultiplier μ χ * characterMultiplier μ ψ
    exact characterMultiplier_mul μ χ ψ

end

end HaarL2
end MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CharacterMultiplier
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.CovariantRepresentation
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Strong continuity of actual compact-open character multiplication

The original compact-open evaluation controls every compact-support L2
vector. The same character unitary norm and genuine compact-support density
extend its continuity to every vector, without countability or separability
of the original group or Hilbert space and without sigma-finiteness.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology CompactlySupported InnerProductSpace

namespace MeasureTheory
namespace HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual character multiplier has continuous vector orbits for the original compact-open dual topology. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_continuous (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ := by
  have hcompact (f : C_c(G, H)) :
      Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G =>
        characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) := by
    have heval : Continuous fun p : PontryaginDual G × G => ((p.1 p.2 : Circle) : ℂ) := by
      change Continuous (fun p : (G →ₜ* Circle) × G => ((p.1 p.2 : Circle) : ℂ))
      exact continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.eval continuous_snd)
    let F : PontryaginDual G → G → H := fun χ s => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • f s
    have hF : Continuous F.uncurry := heval.smul ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_snd)
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro χ₀
    let I : PontryaginDual G → ℝ := fun χ => ∫ s : G, ‖F χ s - F χ₀ s‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
    have hF₀ : Continuous (fun p : PontryaginDual G × G => F χ₀ p.2) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp (map_continuous χ₀)).comp continuous_snd).smul
        ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_snd)
    have hdiff : Continuous (fun p : PontryaginDual G × G => ‖F p.1 p.2 - F χ₀ p.2‖ ^ 2) :=
      (hF.sub hF₀).norm.pow 2
    have hsupp : ∀ χ s, χ ∈ (Set.univ : Set (PontryaginDual G)) → s ∉ tsupport f →
        ‖F χ s - F χ₀ s‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro χ s _ hs
      have hfs : f s = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs
      simp only [F, hfs, smul_zero, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
    have hI : ContinuousAt I χ₀ :=
      (continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support (μ := μ) f.hasCompactSupport
        hdiff.continuousOn hsupp).continuousAt Filter.univ_mem
    have hN (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
        dist (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f))
          (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) ^ 2 = I χ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      let ζ := characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) -
        characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)
      change ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = I χ
      calc
        ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = (RCLike.re (inner ℂ ζ ζ) : ℝ) :=
          InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) ζ
        _ = ∫ s : G, ‖ζ s‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
          rw [L2.inner_def]
          rw [← integral_re (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) ζ ζ)]
          exact integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun s =>
            (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (ζ s)).symm)
        _ = I χ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f))
              (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)),
            characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f),
            characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f),
            compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq μ f] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
          rw [h₁]
          change ‖characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) s -
            characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) s‖ ^ 2 = ‖F χ s - F χ₀ s‖ ^ 2
          rw [h₂, h₃, h₄]
    have hzero : I χ₀ = 0 := by
      simp only [I, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), integral_zero]
    have htendsto : Tendsto I (𝓝 χ₀) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [ContinuousAt, hzero] using hI
    rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    have hevent := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp htendsto) (ε ^ 2) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
    filter_upwards [hevent] with χ hχ
    have hsq : dist (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f))
        (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 := by
      rw [hN]
      exact (le_abs_self (I χ)).trans_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hχ)
    exact (sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg hε.le).mp hsq
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro χ₀
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hquarter : 0 < ε / 4 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨η, ⟨f, rfl⟩, hdist⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp (denseRange_compactSupportInclusion (H := H) μ ξ) (ε / 4) hquarter
  have hηcont : ContinuousAt (fun χ : PontryaginDual G =>
      characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) χ₀ := (hcompact f).continuousAt
  have hevent := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hηcont) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  have hisometry (χ : PontryaginDual G) (u v : Lp H 2 μ) :
      dist (characterMultiplier μ χ u) (characterMultiplier μ χ v) = dist u v :=
    (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ)).isometry.dist_eq u v
  filter_upwards [hevent] with χ hχ
  calc
    _ ≤ dist (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) +
      dist (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ ξ) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) +
      (dist (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f))
        (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) +
      dist (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ ξ)) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (dist_triangle _ _ _)
    _ = dist ξ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) +
      (dist (characterMultiplier μ χ (compactSupportInclusion μ f))
        (characterMultiplier μ χ₀ (compactSupportInclusion μ f)) +
      dist (compactSupportInclusion μ f) ξ) := by rw [hisometry, hisometry]
    _ < ε := by rw [dist_comm (compactSupportInclusion μ f) ξ]; linarith

/-- The actual compact-open dual-group representation by original character multipliers. -/
def characterMultiplierRepresentation :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation (PontryaginDual G) (Lp H 2 μ) where
  toMonoidHom := characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ
  continuous_orbit ξ := by
    change Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ
    exact characterMultiplier_continuous μ ξ

end

end HaarL2
end MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Measure.RadonProduct.Fubini
public import MathlibExt.Topology.Algebra.Group.DiagonalShear
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CompactSupport
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Integral

/-!
# The actual LCA Haar-square coordinate shear unitary

Reverse compact-support integration and the original Haar invariance prove
that `(s,t) ↦ (s*t⁻¹,t)` preserves the actual Borel Radon square measure.
Its original inverse `(r,t) ↦ (r*t,t)` then gives a literal linear isometry
equivalence on the full Hilbert-valued product L2 space. Both operator
directions retain their original a.e. coordinates and compact-support values.

The original LCA/LCH/Borel/regular-Haar hypotheses and independent Hilbert
universe are retained. H may be zero. No countability, s-finiteness,
supplied unitary or desired spatial model is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace MeasureTheory

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [CommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [T2Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The actual Borel measurable space of the original topological Haar square. -/
local instance instExactShearProductMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (G × G) := borel (G × G)
local instance instExactShearProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (G × G) := ⟨rfl⟩

namespace Measure

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The literal original difference-coordinate shear preserves the actual Borel Radon square. -/
theorem map_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd :
    Measure.map (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G) (radonProd μ μ) = radonProd μ μ := by
  let e := Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G
  change Measure.map e (radonProd μ μ) = radonProd μ μ
  let _ : (Measure.map e (radonProd μ μ)).Regular := Measure.Regular.map e
  apply Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported
  intro f
  rw [e.measurableEmbedding.integral_map]
  let F : C_c(G × G, ℝ) :=
    ⟨⟨fun z => f (e z), f.continuous.comp e.continuous⟩,
      f.hasCompactSupport.comp_homeomorph e⟩
  change (∫ z : G × G, F z ∂(radonProd μ μ)) =
    ∫ z : G × G, f z ∂(radonProd μ μ)
  rw [integral_radonProd_swap μ μ F, integral_radonProd_swap μ μ f]
  change (∫ t : G, ∫ s : G, f (s * t⁻¹, t) ∂μ ∂μ) =
    ∫ t : G, ∫ s : G, f (s, t) ∂μ ∂μ
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using
      integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun s : G => f (s, t)) t⁻¹

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual forward coordinate shear is measure preserving on the full Borel Radon square. -/
theorem measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd :
    MeasurePreserving (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G)
      (radonProd μ μ) (radonProd μ μ) :=
  ⟨(Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G).measurable,
    map_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd μ⟩

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original inverse coordinate shear is also measure preserving on the same actual carrier. -/
theorem measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_radonProd :
    MeasurePreserving (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G).symm
      (radonProd μ μ) (radonProd μ μ) :=
  MeasurePreserving.symm (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G).toMeasurableEquiv
    (measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd μ)

end Measure

namespace HaarL2

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual inverse-shear pullback and its literal forward-shear inverse on full H-valued Radon L2. -/
def diagonalShearIsometry :
    Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) := by
  let e := Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G
  let hE := Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd μ
  let hInv := Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_radonProd μ
  exact
    { toFun := Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.symm hInv
      invFun := Lp.compMeasurePreserving e hE
      left_inv ξ := by
        change Lp.compMeasurePreserving e hE (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.symm hInv ξ) = ξ
        apply Lp.ext
        have hQ : QuasiMeasurePreserving e (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) :=
          ⟨hE.measurable, by rw [hE.map_eq]⟩
        filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving
            (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.symm hInv ξ) hE,
          hQ.ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ hInv)] with z h₁ h₂
        exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (congrArg (fun w : G × G => ξ w) (e.symm_apply_apply z)))
      right_inv ξ := by
        change Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.symm hInv (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e hE ξ) = ξ
        apply Lp.ext
        have hQ : QuasiMeasurePreserving e.symm (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) :=
          ⟨hInv.measurable, by rw [hInv.map_eq]⟩
        filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving
            (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e hE ξ) hInv,
          hQ.ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ hE)] with z h₁ h₂
        exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (congrArg (fun w : G × G => ξ w) (e.apply_symm_apply z)))
      map_add' ξ η := (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.symm hInv).map_add ξ η
      map_smul' c ξ := (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗ ℂ e.symm hInv).map_smul c ξ
      norm_map' ξ := Lp.norm_compMeasurePreserving ξ hInv }

omit [CompleteSpace H] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual full L2 shear has the literal inverse-coordinate pullback DATA. -/
theorem diagonalShearIsometry_apply (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ ξ =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G).symm
        (Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_radonProd μ) ξ := rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The inverse full L2 shear has the literal forward-coordinate pullback DATA. -/
theorem diagonalShearIsometry_symm_apply (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ).symm ξ =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G)
        (Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd μ) ξ := rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every actual product-L2 vector has the original inverse-shear coordinates almost everywhere. -/
theorem diagonalShearIsometry_ae_eq (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
      fun z : G × G => ξ (z.1 * z.2, z.2) := by
  rw [diagonalShearIsometry_apply]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ
    (Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_radonProd μ)] with z hz
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_apply] using hz

omit [CompleteSpace H] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual inverse Hilbert operator has the original forward-shear coordinates a.e. -/
theorem diagonalShearIsometry_symm_ae_eq (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ).symm ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
      fun z : G × G => ξ (z.1 * z.2⁻¹, z.2) := by
  rw [diagonalShearIsometry_symm_apply]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ
    (Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_radonProd μ)] with z hz
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear_apply] using hz

omit [CompleteSpace H] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The Hilbert operator retains the original inverse-shear compact-support vector map. -/
theorem diagonalShearIsometry_apply_compactSupport (f : C_c(G × G, H)) :
    diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ
      (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ μ) f) =
        compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ μ)
          (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.diagonalShearPullback f) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  let e := Homeomorph.diagonalDifferenceShear G
  have hpres := Measure.measurePreserving_diagonalDifferenceShear_symm_radonProd μ
  have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving e.symm
      (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  have hinput := hquasi.ae_eq_comp (compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ μ) f)
  filter_upwards [diagonalShearIsometry_ae_eq μ
      (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ μ) f), hinput,
    compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ μ)
      (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.diagonalShearPullback f)] with z h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃.symm)

/-- The actual full H-valued Radon-square shear as a bounded unitary operator. -/
def diagonalShearUnitary :
    unitary (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :=
  Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm (diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The bounded shear operator is the same literal full-L2 linear isometry. -/
@[simp]
theorem diagonalShearUnitary_coe :
    (diagonalShearUnitary (H := H) μ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) =
        (diagonalShearIsometry (H := H) μ).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap :=
  rfl

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual bounded unitary retains the original inverse-shear coordinates on all vectors a.e. -/
theorem diagonalShearUnitary_ae_eq (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalShearUnitary (H := H) μ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
        fun z : G × G => ξ (z.1 * z.2, z.2) :=
  diagonalShearIsometry_ae_eq μ ξ

end HaarL2

end

end MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CompactSupport
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Measure.RadonProduct.CompactSupport
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearMap

/-!
# The actual compact-support tensor map into Borel Radon L2

The literal compact-support product is a complex bilinear map. Its actual
Lp inclusion gives an algebraic tensor map into the original Borel Radon
product L2 space. Compact-support complex integrals prove the full mixed
inner-product identity, including the imaginary part. Bilinearity then
preserves every finite tensor pairing and its norm, compared with the stock
tensor of the two original compact-support L2 inclusions.

No completed tensor equivalence, dense-range conclusion or coordinate shear
is selected here. Their full arbitrary-group source scope remains open.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

universe uX uY

namespace CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

section Components

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]

/-- The actual real component of a complex compact-support function. -/
def realPart (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) : C_c(X, ℝ) where
  toFun x := (f x).re
  continuous_toFun := Complex.continuous_re.comp f.continuous
  hasCompactSupport' := f.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := Complex.re) (by simp)

/-- The actual imaginary component of a complex compact-support function. -/
def imagPart (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) : C_c(X, ℝ) where
  toFun x := (f x).im
  continuous_toFun := Complex.continuous_im.comp f.continuous
  hasCompactSupport' := f.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := Complex.im) (by simp)

/-- The compact-support real component retains every original pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem realPart_apply (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (x : X) : realPart f x = (f x).re := rfl

/-- The compact-support imaginary component retains every original pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem imagPart_apply (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (x : X) : imagPart f x = (f x).im := rfl

/-- The actual compact-support scalar inner-product function, linear in the second factor. -/
def innerPair (f g : C_c(X, ℂ)) : C_c(X, ℂ) := star f * g

/-- The compact-support pairing is the original complex inner product at every point. -/
@[simp]
theorem innerPair_apply (f g : C_c(X, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    innerPair f g x = inner ℂ (f x) (g x) := by
  change star (f x) * g x = inner ℂ (f x) (g x)
  exact (RCLike.inner_apply' (f x) (g x)).symm

end Components

section BilinearProduct

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]

/-- The literal compact-support pure product as an actual complex bilinear map. -/
def mulProdBilinear : C_c(X, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(X × Y, ℂ) where
  toFun f :=
    { toFun g := mulProd f g
      map_add' g h := by
        apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
        rintro ⟨x, y⟩
        change f x * (g y + h y) = f x * g y + f x * h y
        exact mul_add _ _ _
      map_smul' c g := by
        apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
        rintro ⟨x, y⟩
        change f x * (c * g y) = c * (f x * g y)
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (f x) c, mul_assoc] }
  map_add' f h := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change (f x + h x) * g y = f x * g y + h x * g y
    exact add_mul _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change (c * f x) * g y = c * (f x * g y)
    exact mul_assoc _ _ _

/-- The bilinear constructor retains the exact compact-support pure product. -/
@[simp]
theorem mulProdBilinear_apply (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    mulProdBilinear f g = mulProd f g := rfl

/-- The real component of a pure product has the original real multiplication formula. -/
theorem realPart_mulProd (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    realPart (mulProd f g) = mulProd (realPart f) (realPart g) - mulProd (imagPart f) (imagPart g) := by
  ext z
  rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
  change (f x * g y).re = (f x).re * (g y).re - (f x).im * (g y).im
  exact Complex.mul_re _ _

/-- The imaginary component of a pure product has the original imaginary multiplication formula. -/
theorem imagPart_mulProd (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    imagPart (mulProd f g) = mulProd (realPart f) (imagPart g) + mulProd (imagPart f) (realPart g) := by
  ext z
  rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
  change (f x * g y).im = (f x).re * (g y).im + (f x).im * (g y).re
  exact Complex.mul_im _ _

end BilinearProduct

section ComponentIntegral

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]

/-- The compact-support real-component integral is the real part of the original complex integral. -/
theorem integral_realPart (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) :
    ∫ x : X, realPart f x ∂μ = (∫ x : X, f x ∂μ).re := integral_re f.integrable

/-- The compact-support imaginary-component integral is the imaginary part of the original complex integral. -/
theorem integral_imagPart (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) :
    ∫ x : X, imagPart f x ∂μ = (∫ x : X, f x ∂μ).im := integral_im f.integrable

end ComponentIntegral

end CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure

open CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν]

/-- The Borel measurable space of the literal product for compact-support complex integration. -/
local instance instComplexProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instComplexProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original Borel Radon integral of a complex compact-support pure product factors exactly. -/
theorem integral_mulProd_complex (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    ∫ z : X × Y, mulProd f g z ∂(radonProd μ ν) =
      (∫ x : X, f x ∂μ) * ∫ y : Y, g y ∂ν := by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [← integral_realPart (radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g), realPart_mulProd]
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sub_apply]
    rw [integral_sub (mulProd (realPart f) (realPart g)).integrable
      (mulProd (imagPart f) (imagPart g)).integrable]
    rw [integral_mulProd μ ν (realPart f) (realPart g),
      integral_mulProd μ ν (imagPart f) (imagPart g)]
    rw [integral_realPart μ f, integral_realPart ν g, integral_imagPart μ f, integral_imagPart ν g]
    exact (Complex.mul_re _ _).symm
  · rw [← integral_imagPart (radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g), imagPart_mulProd]
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
    rw [integral_add (mulProd (realPart f) (imagPart g)).integrable
      (mulProd (imagPart f) (realPart g)).integrable]
    rw [integral_mulProd μ ν (realPart f) (imagPart g),
      integral_mulProd μ ν (imagPart f) (realPart g)]
    rw [integral_realPart μ f, integral_imagPart ν g, integral_imagPart μ f, integral_realPart ν g]
    exact (Complex.mul_im _ _).symm

end MeasureTheory.Measure

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

open CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]

/-- The Borel measurable space of the literal product used by the original product L2 carrier. -/
local instance instProductL2BorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instProductL2BorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The computed compact-support bilinear map into the actual Borel Radon product L2 space. -/
def compactSupportProduct :
    C_c(X, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (mulProdBilinear (X := X) (Y := Y)).compr₂
    (compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) (Measure.radonProd μ ν))

/-- The bilinear L2 map is the literal compact-support product followed by the original inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactSupportProduct_apply (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactSupportProduct μ ν f g = compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g) := rfl

/-- The computed product L2 vector retains its literal factor values almost everywhere. -/
theorem compactSupportProduct_ae_eq (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactSupportProduct μ ν f g =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν] fun z => f z.1 * g z.2 :=
  compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g)

/-- The computed pure product has the exact product of the original factor L2 squared norms. -/
theorem norm_compactSupportProduct_sq (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactSupportProduct μ ν f g‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖compactSupportInclusion μ f‖ ^ 2 * ‖compactSupportInclusion ν g‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [compactSupportProduct_apply, norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq,
    norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq, norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq]
  exact Measure.integral_norm_sq_mulProd μ ν f g

/-- The actual compact-support pure products preserve the full complex mixed factor pairing. -/
theorem compactSupportProduct_inner
    (f f' : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g g' : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    inner ℂ (compactSupportProduct μ ν f g) (compactSupportProduct μ ν f' g') =
      inner ℂ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) (compactSupportInclusion μ f') *
        inner ℂ (compactSupportInclusion ν g) (compactSupportInclusion ν g') := by
  rw [compactSupportProduct_apply, compactSupportProduct_apply]
  calc
    inner ℂ (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g))
        (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f' g')) =
      ∫ z : X × Y, inner ℂ (mulProd f g z) (mulProd f' g' z) ∂(Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
      compactSupportInclusion_inner (Measure.radonProd μ ν) _ _
    _ = ∫ z : X × Y, mulProd (innerPair f f') (innerPair g g') z ∂(Measure.radonProd μ ν) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      refine Eventually.of_forall ?_
      rintro ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [mulProd_apply, innerPair_apply]
      simpa only [TensorProduct.inner_tmul] using
        (RCLike.inner_tmul_eq (f x) (g y) (f' x) (g' y)).symm
    _ = (∫ x : X, innerPair f f' x ∂μ) * ∫ y : Y, innerPair g g' y ∂ν :=
      Measure.integral_mulProd_complex μ ν (innerPair f f') (innerPair g g')
    _ = inner ℂ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) (compactSupportInclusion μ f') *
        inner ℂ (compactSupportInclusion ν g) (compactSupportInclusion ν g') := by
      rw [compactSupportInclusion_inner, compactSupportInclusion_inner]
      congr 1
      · exact integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun x => innerPair_apply f f' x)
      · exact integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun y => innerPair_apply g g' y)

/-- The literal algebraic tensor of the original two compact-support L2 inclusions. -/
def compactSupportFactorTensor :
    C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν) :=
  TensorProduct.map (compactSupportInclusion μ) (compactSupportInclusion ν)

/-- The algebraic tensor lift of the computed product L2 bilinear map. -/
def compactSupportTensorToLp :
    C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  TensorProduct.lift (compactSupportProduct μ ν)

/-- The actual algebraic lift has its literal compact-support pure-tensor value. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactSupportTensorToLp_tmul (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) =
      compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g) :=
  TensorProduct.lift.tmul (f' := compactSupportProduct μ ν) f g

/-- The actual algebraic pure-tensor value is the original pointwise product almost everywhere. -/
theorem compactSupportTensorToLp_tmul_ae (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν] fun z => f z.1 * g z.2 := by
  rw [compactSupportTensorToLp_tmul]
  exact compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (mulProd f g)

/-- Every finite compact-support tensor pairing agrees with its original stock factor-tensor pairing. -/
theorem compactSupportTensorToLp_inner (z w : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    inner ℂ (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z) (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν w) =
      inner ℂ (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z) (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν w) := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul f g =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul f' g' =>
      simp only [compactSupportTensorToLp_tmul, compactSupportFactorTensor,
        TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.inner_tmul]
      exact compactSupportProduct_inner μ ν f f' g g'
    | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, inner_add_right, hz, hw]
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, inner_add_left, hz, hw]

/-- Every finite compact-support tensor has the original stock factor-tensor norm. -/
theorem norm_compactSupportTensorToLp (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z‖ = ‖compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z‖ := by
  have hsq : ‖compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z‖ ^ 2 = ‖compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z‖ ^ 2 =
          RCLike.re (inner ℂ (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z) (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z)) :=
        InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) _
      _ = RCLike.re (inner ℂ (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z) (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z)) :=
        congrArg RCLike.re (compactSupportTensorToLp_inner μ ν z z)
      _ = ‖compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z‖ ^ 2 :=
        (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z)).symm
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z)),
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z))] using congrArg Real.sqrt hsq

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

end

/-!
# The full stock completed tensor embeds into the actual Borel Radon L2 space

The original compact-support tensor map descends through the kernel of its
computed factor-tensor inclusion to the normed range. Dense factor spans
then extend that map isometrically to the entire stock Hilbert tensor
completion. The kernel quotient, normed-range descent and extension are
the stock `LinearMap.extendOfIsometry` construction, supplied with the
proved density and original computed norm equality.

No product-L2 surjectivity or completed unitary is assumed or chosen.
The original source identification and coordinate shear remain obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct InnerProductSpace

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section
