section FactorCore

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]

/-- The actual stock factor-tensor inclusion into its original uniform completion. -/
def stockFactorTensorCompletionInclusion :
    (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν) →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) := by
  let _ : UniformContinuousConstSMul ℂ ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
    uniformContinuousConstSMul_of_continuousConstSMul ℂ ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.toComplₗᵢ

/-- The original compact-support factor tensor followed by the named stock completion inclusion. -/
def compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion :
    C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
  (stockFactorTensorCompletionInclusion μ ν).toLinearMap.comp (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν)

/-- The source completion map retains each literal original factor tensor. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_apply (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z =
      (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z :
        UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) := rfl

/-- The named stock completion inclusion preserves the original compact-support factor-tensor norm. -/
theorem norm_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z‖ = ‖compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z‖ :=
  (stockFactorTensorCompletionInclusion μ ν).norm_map (compactSupportFactorTensor μ ν z)

end FactorCore

section FullCompletion

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]

/-- The original compact-support factor tensors are dense in the entire stock completed Hilbert tensor. -/
theorem denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion :
    DenseRange (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν) := by
  let s : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ) := Set.range (compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) μ)
  let t : Set (Lp ℂ 2 ν) := Set.range (compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) ν)
  have hs : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ s : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
    intro ξ
    exact (closure_mono Submodule.subset_span) (denseRange_compactSupportInclusion μ ξ)
  have ht : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ t : Set (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) := by
    intro η
    exact (closure_mono Submodule.subset_span) (denseRange_compactSupportInclusion ν η)
  let P : Set (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
    {z | ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ t,
      z = (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))}
  have hP : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ P :
      Set (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))) :=
    TensorProduct.dense_span_completed_tmul s t hs ht
  have hSpan : Submodule.span ℂ P ≤ (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν).range := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x, ⟨f, rfl⟩, y, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g, ?_⟩
    rw [compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_apply, compactSupportFactorTensor, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  intro z
  exact (closure_mono hSpan) (hP z)

/-- The Borel measurable space of the literal topological product used by the full product L2 target. -/
local instance instFullTensorProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instFullTensorProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original stock normed additive group of the completed factor tensor, with a stable name. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) := inferInstance

/-- The exact stock completion normed-space value, captured before installing the named group. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedSpace :
    NormedSpace ℂ (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) where
  norm_smul_le := norm_smul_le

/-- The original stock normed additive group of the Borel Radon product Lp target. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def stockRadonProductLpNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := Lp.instNormedAddCommGroup

/-- The exact stock Lp normed-space value, captured before installing the named target group. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def stockRadonProductLpNormedSpace : NormedSpace ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := Lp.instNormedSpace

/-- Use the named original stock normed group in the extension's domain. -/
local instance instNamedCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
  stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup μ ν

/-- Use the matching stock scalar action and normed-space dictionary in the extension's domain. -/
local instance instNamedCompletedFactorTensorNormedSpace :
    NormedSpace ℂ (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
  stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedSpace μ ν

/-- Use the named original Lp normed group in the extension's target. -/
local instance instNamedRadonProductLpNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := stockRadonProductLpNormedAddCommGroup μ ν

/-- Use the matching stock scalar action and normed-space dictionary in the extension's target. -/
local instance instNamedRadonProductLpNormedSpace : NormedSpace ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :=
  stockRadonProductLpNormedSpace μ ν

/-- Use the exact stock domain group projection required directly by the normed extension factory. -/
local instance instFactoryCompletedFactorTensorSeminormedAddCommGroup :
    SeminormedAddCommGroup (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
  (stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup μ ν).toSeminormedAddCommGroup

/-- Use the exact stock target group projection in the extension and its agreement theorem. -/
local instance instFactoryRadonProductLpSeminormedAddCommGroup :
    SeminormedAddCommGroup (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :=
  (stockRadonProductLpNormedAddCommGroup μ ν).toSeminormedAddCommGroup

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
  [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular] in
/-- The norm topology used by the extension is the original stock completion topology. -/
theorem stockCompletedFactorTensorNormTopology_eq :
    @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
      (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
      (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
        (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
        (@SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
          (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
          (stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup μ ν).toSeminormedAddCommGroup)) =
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))).toTopologicalSpace := by
  let m : PseudoMetricSpace (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
    (stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup μ ν).toSeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
  have hUniform : m.toUniformSpace =
      UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) := by
    apply UniformSpace.ext
    exact (@PseudoMetricSpace.uniformity_dist _ m).trans
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformity_dist (α := (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))).symm
  exact congrArg (fun w : UniformSpace (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =>
    @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) w) hUniform

/-- The original factor-core density has the exact normed completion topology required by extension. -/
theorem denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_normed :
    @DenseRange (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
      (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
        (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
        (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
          (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
          (@SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
            (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
            (stockCompletedFactorTensorNormedAddCommGroup μ ν).toSeminormedAddCommGroup)))
      (C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν) := by
  rw [stockCompletedFactorTensorNormTopology_eq μ ν]
  exact denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν

/-- The actual finite product norm equals the original factor-completion norm. -/
theorem norm_compactSupportTensorToLp_completion (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z‖ = ‖compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z‖ :=
  (norm_compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z).trans (norm_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z).symm

/-- The actual computed product map satisfies the unit norm bound on its original factor completion. -/
theorem bound_compactSupportTensorToLp_completion :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ),
      ‖compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z‖ ≤ C * ‖compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z‖ := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  intro z
  exact (norm_compactSupportTensorToLp_completion μ ν z).le.trans_eq
    (one_mul ‖compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z‖).symm

/-- The actual stock continuous extension of the computed product map to the full completed factor tensor. -/
def radonProductTensorExtension :
    UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
      Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  LinearMap.extendOfNorm
    (𝕜 := ℂ) (𝕜₂ := ℂ)
    (E := C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ))
    (Eₗ := UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
    (F := Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))
    (compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν) (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν)

/-- The continuous extension retains each original algebraic compact-support tensor value. -/
theorem radonProductTensorExtension_apply_core (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorExtension μ ν (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z) =
      compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z := by
  -- Elaborate the stock specialization and its actual prerequisites separately.
  -- The resulting stock lemma application is checked against this goal and by the kernel.
  run_tac
    Lean.Elab.Tactic.withMainContext do
      let factorySyntax ← `(LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq
        (𝕜 := ℂ) (𝕜₂ := ℂ)
        (E := C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ))
        (Eₗ := UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
        (F := Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))
        (f := compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν)
        (e := compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν))
      let factory ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm factorySyntax none
      Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
      let factory ← Lean.instantiateMVars factory
      let density ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm
        (← `(denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_normed μ ν)) none
      Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
      let density ← Lean.instantiateMVars density
      Lean.Meta.checkApp factory density
      let proof := Lean.mkApp factory density
      let bound ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm
        (← `(bound_compactSupportTensorToLp_completion μ ν)) none
      Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
      let bound ← Lean.instantiateMVars bound
      Lean.Meta.checkApp proof bound
      let proof := Lean.mkApp proof bound
      let some vector := (← Lean.getLCtx).findDeclRev? (fun decl =>
        if decl.userName.eraseMacroScopes == `z then some (Lean.mkFVar decl.fvarId) else none)
        | throwError "The original source tensor z must be present in the theorem context"
      Lean.Meta.checkApp proof vector
      let proof ← Lean.instantiateMVars (Lean.mkApp proof vector)
      unless !proof.hasMVar && proof.getAppFn.isConstOf ``LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq do
        throwError "The core agreement must be the complete stock lemma application"
      let goal ← Lean.Elab.Tactic.getMainGoal
      unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq (← goal.getType) (← Lean.Meta.inferType proof)) do
        throwError "The stock agreement proof must have the original constructor goal type"
      goal.assign proof
      Lean.Elab.Tactic.replaceMainGoal []

/-- The actual continuous extension preserves the original stock completed tensor norm on every vector. -/
theorem norm_radonProductTensorExtension
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    ‖radonProductTensorExtension μ ν z‖ = ‖z‖ := by
  have hCore (x : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
      (hx : x ∈ Set.range (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν)) :
      ‖radonProductTensorExtension μ ν x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (congrArg norm (radonProductTensorExtension_apply_core μ ν t)).trans
      (norm_compactSupportTensorToLp_completion μ ν t)
  exact (denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν).induction hCore
    (isClosed_eq (radonProductTensorExtension μ ν).continuous.norm continuous_norm) z

/-- The computed isometric extension from the full stock completed factor tensor into Borel Radon L2. -/
def radonProductTensorEmbedding :
    UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) where
  toLinearMap := (radonProductTensorExtension μ ν).toLinearMap
  norm_map' := norm_radonProductTensorExtension μ ν

/-- The full extension has the original algebraic product L2 value on every compact-support source tensor. -/
theorem radonProductTensorEmbedding_apply_core (z : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν z) =
      compactSupportTensorToLp μ ν z :=
  radonProductTensorExtension_apply_core μ ν z

/-- The full completed tensor extension retains the original compact-support pure value. -/
@[simp]
theorem radonProductTensorEmbedding_tmul (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν
        (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =
      compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.mulProd f g) := by
  simpa only [compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_apply, compactSupportFactorTensor,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, compactSupportTensorToLp_tmul] using
    radonProductTensorEmbedding_apply_core μ ν (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g)

/-- The full completed tensor extension retains the literal compact-support pure formula almost everywhere. -/
theorem radonProductTensorEmbedding_tmul_ae (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν
        (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z => f z.1 * g z.2 := by
  rw [radonProductTensorEmbedding_tmul]
  exact compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.mulProd f g)

/-- The full stock completed tensor embedding preserves the original complex inner product on all vectors. -/
theorem radonProductTensorEmbedding_inner
    (z w : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    inner ℂ (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν z) (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν w) = inner ℂ z w :=
  (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν).inner_map_map z w

end FullCompletion

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Mixed
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Swap
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.RightTensorProduct

/-!
# The original H-first nested double tensor as full Borel product L2

Use the actual first tensor-to-Lp unitary, completed stock commutation,
the verified reversed mixed-product unitary and literal coordinate exchange.
Their composition retains the entire original H-first nested carrier and
all pure-vector values. Both Haar choices stay explicit; H may be zero.

This supplies the coordinate model required before the original partial
Fourier construction. It selects no normalized dual Haar or Fourier unitary
from a Source theorem. Terminal Plancherel and generator-transport proofs
remain wholly open.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory UniformSpace
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uX uY uH

section SingleMeasure

variable {X : Type uX} [MeasurableSpace X]
variable (μ : Measure X)
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The two actual one-measure tensor maps agree on their original exchanged pure vectors. -/
private theorem tensorToLpRight_tmul_eq (ξ : H) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    L2.tensorToLpRight μ
        ((ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      L2.tensorToLp μ
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H)) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  exact (L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae μ ξ f).trans (L2.tensorToLp_tmul_ae μ f ξ).symm

end SingleMeasure

section TensorCoordinates

variable {X : Type uX} [MeasurableSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual completed first tensor-to-Lp congruence has its original linear-map field. -/
private def radonProductHFirstCongruenceMap :
    Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
  (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ)
      (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))).toLinearMap

/-- The actual completed tensor commutation has its original linear-map field. -/
private def radonProductHFirstCommMap :
    Completion ((Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ)) :=
  (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.commIsometry ℂ (Lp H 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν))).toLinearMap

/-- The actual first congruence acts on the entire original completed first-factor vector. -/
private theorem radonProductHFirstCongruenceMap_tmul
    (z : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) :
    radonProductHFirstCongruenceMap (H := H) μ ν
        ((z ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
          Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =
      (((L2.tensorToLpRight μ z) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
        Completion ((Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) := by
  change (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ)
      (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 ν))))
    ((z ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
      Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.completion_apply_coe]
  rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
/-- The actual commutation map keeps the literal whole Lp vector and second scalar factor. -/
private theorem radonProductHFirstCommMap_tmul (f : Lp H 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) :
    radonProductHFirstCommMap (H := H) μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
          Completion ((Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =
      ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ)) :
        Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ))) := by
  change (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.commIsometry ℂ (Lp H 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))
    ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
      Completion ((Lp H 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.completion_apply_coe]
  simp only [TensorProduct.commIsometry_apply, TensorProduct.comm_tmul]

end TensorCoordinates

section Product

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original X-first product Borel measurable space. -/
local instance instHFirstXYMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instHFirstXYBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original Y-first product Borel measurable space. -/
local instance instHFirstYXMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Y × X) := borel (Y × X)
local instance instHFirstYXBorelSpace : BorelSpace (Y × X) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The entire original H-first nested double tensor is full H-valued Borel Radon product L2. -/
def radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary :
    Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (((LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
      (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ)
        (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))).trans
      (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
        (TensorProduct.commIsometry ℂ (Lp H 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν)))).trans
      (radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) ν μ)).trans
      (radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) ν μ)

/-- The original nested unitary selects its actual congruence, commutation, mixed and swap fields. -/
private theorem radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary_apply
    (z : Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν z =
      radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) ν μ
        (radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) ν μ
          (radonProductHFirstCommMap (H := H) μ ν (radonProductHFirstCongruenceMap (H := H) μ ν z))) := rfl

/-- Original whole scalar factors and the H vector retain the literal completed pure values. -/
theorem radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary_tmul (ξ : H) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) :
    radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((((ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) :
          Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =
      radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) ν μ
        (radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) ν μ
          ((((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
            Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) :
              Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] H))) := by
  rw [radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary_apply, radonProductHFirstCongruenceMap_tmul,
    radonProductHFirstCommMap_tmul, tensorToLpRight_tmul_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun v : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd ν μ) => radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) ν μ v)
    (radonProductMixedTensorUnitary_tmul ν μ g f ξ)

/-- Original compact scalar factors give their H-valued product in the original coordinate order a.e. -/
theorem radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary_compact_tmul_ae
    (ξ : H) (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((((ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion μ f) : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
          Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g)) :
            Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z : X × Y => (f z.1 * g z.2) • ξ := by
  rw [radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary_tmul]
  have hpres := Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd μ ν
  have hQ : QuasiMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : X × Y → Y × X)
      (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (Measure.radonProd ν μ) :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  let t : Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] H) :=
    ((((compactSupportInclusion ν g) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion μ f) :
      (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
        Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ)
  let v : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd ν μ) := radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) ν μ t
  have hpure : v =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd ν μ] fun z : Y × X => (g z.1 * f z.2) • ξ :=
    radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_compact_tmul_ae ν μ g f ξ
  filter_upwards [radonProductSwapIsometry_ae_eq ν μ v, hQ.ae_eq_comp hpure] with z h₁ h₂
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (by
    change (g z.2 * f z.1) • ξ = (f z.1 * g z.2) • ξ
    rw [mul_comm]))

/-- The original H-first double tensor reaches the same actual product compact-support completion. -/
def radonProductHFirstCompletionUnitary :
    Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      CompletionCore (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).trans
    (completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)).symm

/-- The original completion model has the literal full H-valued product Lp vector. -/
theorem radonProductHFirstCompletionUnitary_toLp
    (z : Completion ((Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)
        (radonProductHFirstCompletionUnitary (H := H) μ ν z) =
      radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν z :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

end Product

end

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Unitary
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.TensorProduct

/-!
# The actual scalar product tensor amplified by a Hilbert space

Tensor congruence amplifies the verified original scalar Radon product unitary
by the identity on H. Its actual forward and inverse completion maps give an
isometry equivalence, and the existing one-measure tensor-to-Lp comparison
then gives the full H-valued Borel Radon Lp space. H may be zero.

The source-side mapped model is the stock completion of the original full
scalar factor tensor tensored with H. No product unitary, norm certificate,
countability or s-finiteness assumption is supplied as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct InnerProductSpace

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uX uY uH

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual Borel measurable space of the original topological product. -/
local instance instHilbertProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instHilbertProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original full scalar factor tensor, amplified by H, is actual H-valued product Lp. -/
def radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary :
    UniformSpace.Completion
      ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) := by
  let e := TensorProduct.congrIsometry (radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν) (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H)
  let f := e.toLinearIsometry.completion
  let g := e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
  have hfg : f.toLinearMap.comp g.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change f (g z) = z
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
      (isClosed_eq (f.continuous.comp g.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
    intro z
    change e.toLinearIsometry.completion
        (e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
          (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H))
    rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe, LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg (fun z : (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H =>
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H)))
      (e.apply_symm_apply z)
  have hgf : g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change g (f z) = z
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
      (isClosed_eq (g.continuous.comp f.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
    intro z
    change e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
        (e.toLinearIsometry.completion
          (z : UniformSpace.Completion
            ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion
        ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H))
    rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe, LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg
      (fun z : (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H =>
        (z : UniformSpace.Completion
          ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)))
      (e.symm_apply_apply z)
  let E := LinearIsometryEquiv.ofLinearIsometry f g.toLinearMap hfg hgf
  exact E.trans (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν))

/-- The amplified constructor has the original stock tensor-congruence linear-map DATA. -/
theorem radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_toLinearMap :
    (radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν).toLinearMap =
      (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)).toLinearMap.comp
        ((TensorProduct.congrIsometry (radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν)
          (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H)).toLinearIsometry.completion).toLinearMap := rfl

/-- Every full scalar tensor vector amplified by ξ has its actual scalar-vector values a.e. -/
theorem radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_tmul_ae
    (t : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((t ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ :
          (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
            UniformSpace.Completion
              ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z => radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν t z • ξ := by
  change L2.tensorToLp (Measure.radonProd μ ν)
      ((TensorProduct.congrIsometry (radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν)
          (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H)).toLinearIsometry.completion
          ((t ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ :
            (UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
              UniformSpace.Completion
                ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν] _
  rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
  change L2.tensorToLp (Measure.radonProd μ ν)
      (((radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν t) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ :
        (Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
          UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν] _
  exact L2.tensorToLp_tmul_ae (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν t) ξ

/-- Original compact-support factor vectors and ξ retain their literal product values a.e. -/
theorem radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_compact_tmul_ae
    (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        (((((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) :
              UniformSpace.Completion
                ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z => (f z.1 * g z.2) • ξ := by
  filter_upwards [radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_tmul_ae μ ν
      (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
        (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
          UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ξ,
    radonProductTensorUnitary_tmul_ae μ ν f g] with z hvector hscalar
  exact hvector.trans (congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c • ξ) hscalar)

/-- The same amplified tensor is the original H-valued Haar-L2 compact-support completion model. -/
def radonProductHilbertCompletionUnitary :
    UniformSpace.Completion
      ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      CompletionCore (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν).trans
    (completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)).symm

/-- The mapped original completion model has the same actual H-valued product Lp vector. -/
theorem radonProductHilbertCompletionUnitary_toLp
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion
      ((UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
    completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)
        (radonProductHilbertCompletionUnitary (H := H) μ ν z) =
      radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν z :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

end

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.CompletionEquiv
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct.InsideCompletion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Hilbert

/-!
# The original mixed-factor H-valued Radon product tensor

Actual completions of stock tensor congruence and associativity, with the
proved inside-completion maps, give the original direct mixed carrier.
Its composition with the constructed H-valued product unitary retains
literal completed pure vectors, independent factor/H universes and H=0.
No product isometry, associator model or norm certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory UniformSpace
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section


universe uX uY uH

section MixedComparison

variable {X : Type uX} [MeasurableSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- The actual linear map of the inverse right inside-completion unitary. -/
private def radonProductMixedTensorRightMap :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :=
  (TensorProduct.completionRightTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
    (E := Lp ℂ 2 μ) (F := (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)).symm.toLinearMap

/-- The actual linear map of the inverse completed stock associator. -/
private def radonProductMixedTensorAssocMap :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion (((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) :=
  (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.assocIsometry ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν) H)).symm.toLinearMap

/-- The actual linear map of the forward left inside-completion unitary. -/
private def radonProductMixedTensorLeftMap :
    Completion (((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) :=
  (TensorProduct.completionLeftTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
    (E := (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) (F := H)).toLinearMap

/-- The actual inverse right completion map strips the original inner completion on pure tensors. -/
private theorem radonProductMixedTensorRightMap_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorRightMap μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
          ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
            (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) :
              Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)))) =
      ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
        Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) := by
  let R := TensorProduct.completionRightTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
    (E := Lp ℂ 2 μ) (F := (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)
  change R.symm _ = _
  apply R.injective
  rw [R.apply_symm_apply]
  symm
  change TensorProduct.completionRightTensorEmbedding (𝕜 := ℂ)
    ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
      Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) = _
  exact TensorProduct.completionRightTensorEmbedding_tmul f (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ)

/-- The actual completed associator inverse retains the original pure tensor association. -/
private theorem radonProductMixedTensorAssocMap_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorAssocMap μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
          Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =
      (((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
        Completion (((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H)) := by
  change (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.assocIsometry ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν) H)).symm
    ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
      Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.completion_symm_apply_coe]
  simp only [TensorProduct.assocIsometry_symm_apply, TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul]

/-- The actual left completion map inserts the original completed left pure tensor. -/
private theorem radonProductMixedTensorLeftMap_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorLeftMap μ ν
        (((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
          Completion (((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =
      ((((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
        Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) :
          Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) := by
  change TensorProduct.completionLeftTensorEmbedding (𝕜 := ℂ)
    (((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
      Completion (((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ⊗[ℂ] H)) = _
  exact TensorProduct.completionLeftTensorEmbedding_tmul (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g) ξ

variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual linear map of the completed right-factor scalar-vector congruence. -/
private def radonProductMixedTensorCongruenceMap :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) :=
  (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
      (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) ν).symm)).toLinearMap

/-- The actual congruence map retains the literal f tensor L2(g tensor ξ) pure vector. -/
private theorem radonProductMixedTensorCongruenceMap_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorCongruenceMap μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] L2.tensorToLp ν
          ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
            (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) =
      ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) :
            Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)))) := by
  change (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
    (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
      (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) ν).symm))
    ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] L2.tensorToLp ν
      ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
        (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.completion_apply_coe]
  change ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) ν).symm
      (L2.tensorToLp ν
        ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H))) :
            Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- Actual stock completion congruence and inside-completion associativity compare the original mixed tensor. -/
def radonProductMixedTensorComparison :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H) :=
  (((LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
      (TensorProduct.congrIsometry (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
        (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) ν).symm)).trans
      (TensorProduct.completionRightTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (E := Lp ℂ 2 μ) (F := (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)).symm).trans
      (LinearIsometryEquiv.completion
        (TensorProduct.assocIsometry ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν) H)).symm).trans
      (TensorProduct.completionLeftTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
        (E := (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) (F := H))

/-- The original comparison acts through its four actual completed linear-map fields. -/
private theorem radonProductMixedTensorComparison_apply
    (z : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) :
    radonProductMixedTensorComparison (H := H) μ ν z =
      radonProductMixedTensorLeftMap μ ν
        (radonProductMixedTensorAssocMap μ ν
          (radonProductMixedTensorRightMap μ ν (radonProductMixedTensorCongruenceMap μ ν z))) := rfl

/-- The actual mixed comparison retains literal full scalar-factor vectors and their completed pure tensor. -/
theorem radonProductMixedTensorComparison_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorComparison (H := H) μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] L2.tensorToLp ν
          ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
            (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) =
      ((((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
        Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) :
          Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) := by
  rw [radonProductMixedTensorComparison_apply, radonProductMixedTensorCongruenceMap_tmul,
    radonProductMixedTensorRightMap_tmul, radonProductMixedTensorAssocMap_tmul,
    radonProductMixedTensorLeftMap_tmul]

end MixedComparison

section OriginalProduct

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original Borel measurable space of the topological product. -/
local instance instMixedProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instMixedProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original direct mixed tensor is the full H-valued Borel Radon product Lp space. -/
def radonProductMixedTensorUnitary :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (radonProductMixedTensorComparison (H := H) μ ν).trans (radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν)

/-- The original mixed map has the literal stock completed-congruence/associator linear DATA. -/
theorem radonProductMixedTensorUnitary_toLinearMap :
    (radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).toLinearMap =
      (radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν).toLinearMap.comp
        ((TensorProduct.completionLeftTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (E := (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) (F := H)).toLinearMap.comp
          (((TensorProduct.assocIsometry ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν) H).symm.toLinearIsometry.completion).toLinearMap.comp
            ((TensorProduct.completionRightTensorUnitary (𝕜 := ℂ)
              (E := Lp ℂ 2 μ) (F := (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
              ((TensorProduct.congrIsometry (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
                (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) ν).symm).toLinearIsometry.completion).toLinearMap))) := rfl

/-- Literal full scalar-factor vectors and ξ retain the original completed pure tensor values. -/
theorem radonProductMixedTensorUnitary_tmul (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (g : Lp ℂ 2 ν) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] L2.tensorToLp ν
          ((g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) :
            (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) =
      radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] g : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
          Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ) :
            Completion ((Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ⊗[ℂ] H)) := by
  change radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary μ ν (radonProductMixedTensorComparison μ ν _) = _
  rw [radonProductMixedTensorComparison_tmul]

/-- Original compact-support scalar factors and ξ give their actual H-valued product a.e. -/
theorem radonProductMixedTensorUnitary_compact_tmul_ae
    (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) (ξ : H) :
    radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] L2.tensorToLp ν
          (((compactSupportInclusion ν g) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : (Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
            Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 ν) ⊗[ℂ] H)) : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) :
              Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z => (f z.1 * g z.2) • ξ := by
  rw [radonProductMixedTensorUnitary_tmul]
  exact radonProductTensorHilbertUnitary_compact_tmul_ae μ ν f g ξ

/-- The original direct mixed tensor maps into the actual H-valued compact-support completion model. -/
def radonProductMixedCompletionUnitary :
    Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      CompletionCore (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  (radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).trans
    (completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)).symm

/-- The mapped original completion model retains the actual full H-valued product Lp vector. -/
theorem radonProductMixedCompletionUnitary_toLp
    (z : Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp H 2 ν))) :
    completionToLp (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ ν)
        (radonProductMixedCompletionUnitary (H := H) μ ν z) =
      radonProductMixedTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν z :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

end OriginalProduct

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.TensorProduct
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Continuity
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-!
# Actual compact-support Lp-valued sections of the Borel product

A continuous compact-support product function determines its actual scalar
L2 section in the second coordinate. Uniform compact support makes the
section map continuous in the original Lp norm without countability or
sigma-finiteness. The resulting compact-support Hilbert-valued function has
the exact original iterated square integral. The existing one-measure tensor
unitary then gives a literal full factor-tensor representative of equal norm.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct Topology

noncomputable section

universe uX uY

namespace CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

section Sections

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]

/-- The literal compact-support complex section in the original second coordinate. -/
def sectionRightComplex (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) : C_c(Y, ℂ) where
  toFun y := F (x, y)
  continuous_toFun := F.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (F.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_snd)
    intro y hy
    exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxy => hy ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)

/-- The complex section retains each original pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem sectionRightComplex_apply (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    sectionRightComplex F x y = F (x, y) := rfl

variable [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (ν : Measure Y) [ν.Regular]

/-- The actual original L2 vector of a compact-support section. -/
def sectionRightLp (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) : Lp ℂ 2 ν :=
  HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x)

/-- Every section has its original pointwise values almost everywhere. -/
theorem sectionRightLp_ae_eq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    sectionRightLp ν F x =ᵐ[ν] fun y => F (x, y) :=
  HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq ν (sectionRightComplex F x)

/-- The section's squared L2 norm is its actual original square integral. -/
theorem norm_sectionRightLp_sq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    ‖sectionRightLp ν F x‖ ^ 2 = ∫ y : Y, ‖F (x, y)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν :=
  HaarL2.norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq ν (sectionRightComplex F x)

/-- Differences of sections have the actual integral squared-distance norm. -/
theorem norm_sectionRightLp_sub_sq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x x' : X) :
    ‖sectionRightLp ν F x - sectionRightLp ν F x'‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ y : Y, ‖F (x, y) - F (x', y)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν := by
  change ‖HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x) -
    HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x')‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [← map_sub, HaarL2.norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq]
  simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sub_apply, sectionRightComplex_apply]

/-- Uniform compact support makes the actual Lp-valued section map norm-continuous. -/
theorem continuous_sectionRightLp (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) : Continuous (sectionRightLp ν F) := by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro x₀
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hI : Continuous (fun x : X => ∫ y : Y, ‖F (x, y) - F (x₀, y)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) := by
    apply continuousOn_univ.mp
    apply continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support (F.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_snd)
    · rw [univ_prod_univ]
      have hanchor : Continuous (fun _ : X × Y => x₀) := continuous_const
      refine ((F.continuous.sub (F.continuous.comp
        (hanchor.prodMk continuous_snd))).norm.pow 2).continuousOn.congr ?_
      rintro ⟨x, y⟩ _
      rfl
    · intro x y _ hy
      have hx : F (x, y) = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxy => hy ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)
      have hx₀ : F (x₀, y) = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxy => hy ⟨(x₀, y), hxy, rfl⟩)
      simp only [hx, hx₀, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero]
  have hN : Continuous (fun x : X => ‖sectionRightLp ν F x - sectionRightLp ν F x₀‖) := by
    have hEq : (fun x : X => ‖sectionRightLp ν F x - sectionRightLp ν F x₀‖) =
        fun x : X => Real.sqrt (∫ y : Y, ‖F (x, y) - F (x₀, y)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) := by
      funext x
      rw [← norm_sectionRightLp_sub_sq,
        Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (sectionRightLp ν F x - sectionRightLp ν F x₀))]
    rw [hEq]
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hI
  simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using (hN.continuousAt (x := x₀)).tendsto

variable [T2Space X]

/-- The actual section map as an original compact-support Hilbert-valued function. -/
def sectionToLp (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) : C_c(X, Lp ℂ 2 ν) where
  toFun := sectionRightLp ν F
  continuous_toFun := continuous_sectionRightLp ν F
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (F.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_fst)
    intro x hx
    have hzero : sectionRightComplex F x = 0 := by
      apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
      intro y
      change F (x, y) = 0
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxy => hx ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)
    change HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x) = 0
    rw [hzero, map_zero]

/-- The compact-support section constructor retains its computed Lp section at every point. -/
@[simp]
theorem sectionToLp_apply (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    sectionToLp ν F x = sectionRightLp ν F x := rfl

/-- The actual compact-support section construction is complex linear. -/
def sectionToLpLinearMap : C_c(X × Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(X, Lp ℂ 2 ν) where
  toFun := sectionToLp ν
  map_add' F G := CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext (fun x => by
    change HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex (F + G) x) =
      HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x) +
        HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex G x)
    have hsection : sectionRightComplex (F + G) x =
        sectionRightComplex F x + sectionRightComplex G x := by
      apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
      intro y
      rfl
    rw [hsection, map_add])
  map_smul' c F := CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext (fun x => by
    change HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex (c • F) x) =
      c • HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex F x)
    have hsection : sectionRightComplex (c • F) x = c • sectionRightComplex F x := by
      apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
      intro y
      rfl
    rw [hsection, map_smul])

/-- A pure compact-support product has the original scalar-times-vector section. -/
theorem sectionRightLp_mulProd (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    sectionRightLp ν (mulProd f g) x = f x • HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν g := by
  change HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν (sectionRightComplex (mulProd f g) x) =
    f x • HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion ν g
  rw [← map_smul]
  congr 1

end Sections

end CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

open CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]

/-- The Borel measurable space of the literal product used by the section square-integral comparison. -/
local instance instSectionsProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instSectionsProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original Hilbert-valued L2 inclusion of the actual compact-support Lp-valued sections. -/
def productToIteratedLp : C_c(X × Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Lp (Lp ℂ 2 ν) 2 μ :=
  (compactSupportInclusion (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ).comp (sectionToLpLinearMap ν)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace X] [LocallyCompactSpace Y] in
/-- The iterated L2 construction has the original section values almost everywhere. -/
theorem productToIteratedLp_ae_eq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) :
    productToIteratedLp μ ν F =ᵐ[μ] sectionRightLp ν F := by
  change compactSupportInclusion (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ (sectionToLp ν F) =ᵐ[μ] sectionRightLp ν F
  filter_upwards [compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ (sectionToLp ν F)] with x hx
  simpa only [sectionToLp_apply] using hx

/-- The actual iterated section L2 norm has the original Borel product square integral. -/
theorem norm_productToIteratedLp_sq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖productToIteratedLp μ ν F‖ ^ 2 = ‖compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) F‖ ^ 2 := by
  change ‖compactSupportInclusion μ (sectionToLp ν F)‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq, norm_compactSupportInclusion_sq]
  calc
    (∫ x : X, ‖sectionToLp ν F x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ x : X, ∫ y : Y, ‖F (x, y)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun x => norm_sectionRightLp_sq ν F x)
    _ = ∫ z : X × Y, ‖F z‖ ^ 2 ∂(Measure.radonProd μ ν) := by
      simpa only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.normSq_apply] using
        (Measure.integral_radonProd μ ν (normSq F)).symm

/-- The actual full factor-tensor vector supplied by the proved one-measure Hilbert-valued tensor unitary. -/
def compactProductTensorRepresentative :
    C_c(X × Y, ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
  (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ).symm.toLinearMap.comp (productToIteratedLp μ ν)

/-- The full factor-tensor representative has the exact original product L2 squared norm. -/
theorem norm_compactProductTensorRepresentative_sq (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν F‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) F‖ ^ 2 := by
  change ‖(L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ).symm (productToIteratedLp μ ν F)‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  exact norm_productToIteratedLp_sq μ ν F

/-- The full factor-tensor representative preserves the original product L2 norm. -/
theorem norm_compactProductTensorRepresentative (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) :
    ‖compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν F‖ =
      ‖compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) F‖ := by
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν F)),
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) F))] using
    congrArg Real.sqrt (norm_compactProductTensorRepresentative_sq μ ν F)

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

end

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Measure.RadonProduct.Swap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic

/-!
# Actual coordinate exchange of the original Borel Radon product

The generic measure owner proves the original coordinate exchange of the
Borel Radon products. Literal measure-preserving pullbacks give the full
normed-space-valued L2 equivalence, including zero fibers and independent
factor universes. No inner product or completeness of H is required.

This is the coordinate field needed to identify the original H-first
nested double tensor with its full Borel product L2 model before partial
Fourier transport. It selects no normalized dual Haar measure or Fourier
unitary from a Source existence statement.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace MeasureTheory

noncomputable section

universe uX uY uH

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν]

/-- The original Borel measurable structure of the X-first topological product. -/
local instance instSwapXYMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instSwapXYBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original Borel measurable structure of the Y-first topological product. -/
local instance instSwapYXMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Y × X) := borel (Y × X)
local instance instSwapYXBorelSpace : BorelSpace (Y × X) := ⟨rfl⟩

namespace HaarL2

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]

/-- Actual inverse coordinate pullback exchanges the full H-valued Borel product L2 spaces. -/
def radonProductSwapIsometry :
    Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd ν μ) := by
  let hXY := Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd μ ν
  let hYX := Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd ν μ
  exact
    { toFun := Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y) hYX
      invFun := Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : X × Y → Y × X) hXY
      left_inv ξ := by
        apply Lp.ext
        have hQ : QuasiMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : X × Y → Y × X)
            (Measure.radonProd μ ν) (Measure.radonProd ν μ) :=
          ⟨hXY.measurable, by rw [hXY.map_eq]⟩
        filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving
            (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y) hYX ξ) hXY,
          hQ.ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ hYX)] with z h₁ h₂
        exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (congrArg (fun w : X × Y => ξ w) (Prod.swap_swap z)))
      right_inv ξ := by
        apply Lp.ext
        have hQ : QuasiMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y)
            (Measure.radonProd ν μ) (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
          ⟨hYX.measurable, by rw [hYX.map_eq]⟩
        filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving
            (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : X × Y → Y × X) hXY ξ) hYX,
          hQ.ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ hXY)] with z h₁ h₂
        exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (congrArg (fun w : Y × X => ξ w) (Prod.swap_swap z)))
      map_add' ξ η := (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y) hYX).map_add ξ η
      map_smul' c ξ := (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗ ℂ (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y) hYX).map_smul c ξ
      norm_map' ξ := Lp.norm_compMeasurePreserving ξ hYX }

/-- The actual coordinate L2 equivalence has its literal reversed-coordinate pullback DATA. -/
theorem radonProductSwapIsometry_apply (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) μ ν ξ =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : Y × X → X × Y)
        (Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd ν μ) ξ := rfl

/-- The actual inverse coordinate equivalence has the literal original-coordinate pullback DATA. -/
theorem radonProductSwapIsometry_symm_apply (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd ν μ)) :
    (radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : X × Y → Y × X)
        (Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd μ ν) ξ := rfl

/-- Every original product L2 vector retains its swapped coordinate values almost everywhere. -/
theorem radonProductSwapIsometry_ae_eq (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) μ ν ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd ν μ]
      fun z : Y × X => ξ (z.2, z.1) := by
  rw [radonProductSwapIsometry_apply]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ
    (Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd ν μ)] with z hz
  exact hz

/-- The actual inverse product L2 equivalence keeps the original swapped coordinate formula a.e. -/
theorem radonProductSwapIsometry_symm_ae_eq (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd ν μ)) :
    (radonProductSwapIsometry (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z : X × Y => ξ (z.2, z.1) := by
  rw [radonProductSwapIsometry_symm_apply]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving ξ
    (Measure.measurePreserving_prodSwap_radonProd μ ν)] with z hz
  exact hz

end HaarL2

end

end MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.RadonProduct.Sections

/-!
# The actual full scalar L2 tensor unitary for the Borel Radon product

Compact-support product functions have actual norm-preserving representatives
in the full stock factor tensor, obtained from their Lp-valued sections and
the proved one-measure tensor unitary. Dense original compact-support product
vectors extend these representatives isometrically to the entire product Lp.
The original pure formulas and dense factor tensors prove the inverse law,
so the computed forward embedding is genuinely surjective and gives the
strict full scalar product L2 unitary. No countability, s-finiteness, product
Borel equality, supplied norm identity or chosen output unitary is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CompactlySupported TensorProduct

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uX uY

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]

/-- The Borel measurable space of the literal product used by the actual full scalar L2 unitary. -/
local instance instUnitaryProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instUnitaryProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

omit [LocallyCompactSpace X] [LocallyCompactSpace Y] in
/-- The actual section representative of a compact-support pure product is the original full pure tensor. -/
theorem compactProductTensorRepresentative_mulProd (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.mulProd f g) =
      (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
        (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
          UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) := by
  apply (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := Lp ℂ 2 ν) μ).injective
  change (L2.tensorToLp μ)
      ((L2.tensorToLp μ).symm
        (productToIteratedLp μ ν (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.mulProd f g))) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [productToIteratedLp_ae_eq μ ν (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.mulProd f g),
    L2.tensorToLp_tmul_ae μ (compactSupportInclusion μ f) (compactSupportInclusion ν g),
    compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq μ f] with x hleft hright hf
  rw [hleft, hright, hf]
  exact CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sectionRightLp_mulProd ν f g x

/-- The computed isometric reverse map from the entire original Borel product L2 into the full stock tensor. -/
def radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding :
    Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
  (compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν).extendOfIsometry
    (e := compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) (Measure.radonProd μ ν))
    (denseRange_compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) (Measure.radonProd μ ν))
    (norm_compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν)

/-- The reverse extension retains every actual compact-support product L2 representative. -/
@[simp]
theorem radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding_apply_cc (F : C_c(X × Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν (compactSupportInclusion (Measure.radonProd μ ν) F) =
      compactProductTensorRepresentative μ ν F := by
  simp only [radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding, LinearMap.extendOfIsometry_eq]

/-- The computed reverse and forward isometries have their actual inverse law on the entire stock tensor. -/
theorem radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding_embedding
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν z) = z := by
  have hCore (t : C_c(X, ℂ) ⊗[ℂ] C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
      radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν
        (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν (compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν t)) =
      compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν t := by
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul f g =>
      rw [compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion_apply, compactSupportFactorTensor, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      rw [radonProductTensorEmbedding_tmul, radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding_apply_cc,
        compactProductTensorRepresentative_mulProd]
    | add t u ht hu => simp only [map_add, ht, hu]
  exact (denseRange_compactSupportFactorTensorCompletion μ ν).induction
    (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact hCore t)
    (isClosed_eq
      ((radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν).continuous.comp
        (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν).continuous) continuous_id) z

/-- The computed full tensor embedding is genuinely onto the entire original Borel product L2 space. -/
theorem surjective_radonProductTensorEmbedding :
    Function.Surjective (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν) := by
  intro ξ
  refine ⟨radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν ξ, ?_⟩
  apply (radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν).injective
  exact radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding_embedding μ ν (radonProductTensorInverseEmbedding μ ν ξ)

/-- The computed full tensor embedding has genuine dense range in the original product L2 space. -/
theorem denseRange_radonProductTensorEmbedding : DenseRange (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν) :=
  (surjective_radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν).denseRange

/-- The actual full scalar L2 tensor unitary for the original Borel Radon product. -/
def radonProductTensorUnitary :
    UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      Lp ℂ 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective (radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν)
    (surjective_radonProductTensorEmbedding μ ν)

/-- The actual product unitary retains the original compact-support pure values almost everywhere. -/
theorem radonProductTensorUnitary_tmul_ae (f : C_c(X, ℂ)) (g : C_c(Y, ℂ)) :
    radonProductTensorUnitary μ ν
        (((compactSupportInclusion μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (compactSupportInclusion ν g) :
          (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ ν]
      fun z => f z.1 * g z.2 :=
  radonProductTensorEmbedding_tmul_ae μ ν f g

end

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CharacterMultiplierContinuous
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct.CompletionAdjoint
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.RightTensorProduct

/-!
# Actual right-factor character unitaries on the original H-first tensor

The operator is the literal completed tensor of id_H and the original
scalar Haar character multiplier. Its pure a.e. values and completion
density give its actual L2 coordinates. Strong continuity is transferred
through the proved coordinates on the same stock tensor topology.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal TensorProduct Topology InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual right-factor scalar character operator has its original vector-valued L2 coordinates. -/
theorem characterMultiplierTensor_coordinates (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
    L2.tensorToLpRight μ
        (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
          (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z) =
      characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (L2.tensorToLpRight μ z) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
    (isClosed_eq
      (E.continuous.comp (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
        (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)).continuous)
      ((characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ).continuous.comp E.continuous)) ?_
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x f =>
    rw [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul]
    change E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x (characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ f),
      characterMultiplier_ae_eq (H := ℂ) μ χ f,
      characterMultiplier_ae_eq (H := H) μ χ (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))),
      L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x f] with s hleft hscalar hright hinput
    rw [hleft, hscalar, hright, hinput]
    change ((((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) * f s) • x) = ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • (f s • x)
    exact mul_smul _ _ _
  | add z w hz hw =>
    simpa only [UniformSpace.Completion.coe_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (fun x y => x + y) hz hw

/-- The actual strongly continuous character representation is id_H tensored with the scalar character unitary. -/
def characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation (PontryaginDual G)
      (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) := by
  have hOne : (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H := ContinuousLinearMap.one_def
  let F : (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) →⋆*
      (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
    { toFun := TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
      map_one' := TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_id_id ℂ H (Lp ℂ 2 μ)
      map_mul' := fun A B => by
        rw [← hOne]
        simpa only [one_mul] using TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_mul (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) 1 A B
      map_star' := fun A => by
        rw [← hOne]
        simpa only [star_one] using (TensorProduct.star_mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) A).symm }
  refine
    { toMonoidHom := (Unitary.map F).toMonoidHom.comp (characterMultiplierRepresentation (H := ℂ) μ).toMonoidHom
      continuous_orbit := ?_ }
  intro z
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  change Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z
  have htransport (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
          (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z =
        E.symm (characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (E z)) := by
    apply E.injective
    rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
    exact characterMultiplierTensor_coordinates μ χ z
  let m : PseudoMetricSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
    (inferInstance : SeminormedAddCommGroup
      (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))).toPseudoMetricSpace
  have hUniform : m.toUniformSpace = UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
    apply UniformSpace.ext
    exact (@PseudoMetricSpace.uniformity_dist _ m).trans
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformity_dist (α := H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))).symm
  have htop : m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace =
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))).toTopologicalSpace :=
    congrArg (fun w : UniformSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =>
      @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) w) hUniform
  have hc := E.symm.continuous.comp ((characterMultiplierRepresentation (H := H) μ).continuous_orbit (E z))
  change @Continuous (PontryaginDual G) (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) _
    m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
      (fun χ => E.symm (characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (E z))) at hc
  rw [htop] at hc
  simpa only [htransport] using hc

/-- Every original tensor character unitary keeps its literal right-factor operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation_apply (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
        (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  rfl

/-- The literal tensor character unitary is the original vector character unitary in actual L2 coordinates. -/
theorem characterMultiplierTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply, characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation_apply]
  exact (characterMultiplierTensor_coordinates μ χ (E.symm ξ)).trans
    (congrArg (characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ) (E.apply_symm_apply ξ))

end

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

Author: @toskua
