module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.Completion
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.TensorProduct

/-!
# The original scalar Haar L2 completion tensor

Tensor congruence extends the already proved scalar compact-support L2
comparison through the literal completed Hilbert tensor. The result identifies
this original tensor with actual Lp H 2, while retaining both source carriers.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal InnerProductSpace

namespace MeasureTheory.HaarL2

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [TopologicalSpace G] [R1Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G]
  [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The stock completed tensor of the original scalar Haar L2 completion is the actual vector L2 space. -/
def completionTensorToLp :
    UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ := by
  let e := TensorProduct.congrIsometry (completionToLp (H := ℂ) μ) (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H)
  let f := e.toLinearIsometry.completion
  let g := e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
  have hfg : f.toLinearMap.comp g.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change f (g z) = z
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
      (isClosed_eq (f.continuous.comp g.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
    intro z
    change e.toLinearIsometry.completion
        (e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
          (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))
    rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe, LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg (fun z : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H =>
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))) (e.apply_symm_apply z)
  have hgf : g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change g (f z) = z
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
      (isClosed_eq (g.continuous.comp f.continuous) continuous_id) ?_
    intro z
    change e.symm.toLinearIsometry.completion
        (e.toLinearIsometry.completion
          (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))
    rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe, LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg (fun z : (CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H =>
      (z : UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))) (e.symm_apply_apply z)
  let E := LinearIsometryEquiv.ofLinearIsometry f g.toLinearMap hfg hgf
  exact E.trans (L2.tensorToLp (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ)

/-- The original scalar square-integrable vector tensored with x has its exact pointwise formula. -/
theorem completionTensorToLp_tmul_ae (f : CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) (x : H) :
    completionTensorToLp μ ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x : (CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
        UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s => completionToLp (H := ℂ) μ f s • x := by
  change L2.tensorToLp μ
      ((TensorProduct.congrIsometry (completionToLp (H := ℂ) μ)
          (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H)).toLinearIsometry.completion
          ((f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x : (CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
            UniformSpace.Completion ((CompletionCore (H := ℂ) μ) ⊗[ℂ] H))) =ᵐ[μ] _
  rw [LinearIsometry.completion_apply_coe]
  change L2.tensorToLp μ
      (((completionToLp (H := ℂ) μ f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x : (Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H) :
        UniformSpace.Completion ((Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] H)) =ᵐ[μ] _
  exact L2.tensorToLp_tmul_ae μ (completionToLp (H := ℂ) μ f) x

end

end MeasureTheory.HaarL2

/-!
# The original left and right Haar representations in an abelian group

A locally compact commutative group has trivial modular character. The
actual normalized right action on Haar `L²(G,H)` is therefore exactly the
left action by the inverse element. This comparison supplies the original
regular-representation identification used in the abelian dual action and
Takai statements, on the same actual Haar carrier and all Hilbert universes.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable (G : Type uG) [CommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable (H : Type uH) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual abelian right regular unitary is the actual inverse left regular unitary. -/
theorem haarRightRegular_eq_haarLeftRegular_inv (g : G) :
    haarRightRegular G μ H g = haarLeftRegular G μ H g⁻¹ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [haarRightRegular_ae_eq G μ H g ξ,
    haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g⁻¹ ξ] with x hRight hLeft
  rw [hRight, hLeft]
  simp only [Measure.modularCharacter_eq_one_of_comm, NNReal.coe_one,
    Real.one_rpow, one_smul, inv_inv, mul_comm]

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularTensorRepresentation

/-!
# Exact original tensor Haar coordinates

The verified tensor Haar operator remains the actual id_H tensor scalar-Haar
operator. Its original pure a.e. formulas, Haar-preserving coordinate pullback
and source tensor/completion density give its exact vector-valued L2 coordinates.
This exposes the original representation's local coordinate argument for the
source crossed-product covariance, preserving that verified provider's bytes.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal Topology InnerProductSpace

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable (G : Type uG) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable (H : Type uH) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual original H-first Haar unitary has its exact vector-valued Haar coordinates. -/
theorem haarLeftRegularTensor_coordinates (g : G)
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
    L2.tensorToLpRight μ
        ((haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) z) =
      (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (L2.tensorToLpRight μ z) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  rw [haarLeftRegularTensor_apply]
  change E (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
      (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z) =
    (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (E z)
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
    (isClosed_eq
      (E.continuous.comp (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)).continuous)
      ((haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ).continuous.comp E.continuous)) ?_
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x f =>
    rw [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul]
    change E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) f) :
        H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
        (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))
    apply Lp.ext
    have hinput := L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x f
    have houtput := L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x
      ((haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) f)
    have hscalar := haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ ℂ g f
    have hvector := haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
      (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))
    have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
    have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
      ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
    have hcomposed := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinput
    filter_upwards [houtput, hscalar, hvector, hcomposed] with s hout hscalar hvector hin
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hin
    rw [hout, hscalar, hvector, hin]
  | add z w hz hw =>
    simpa only [UniformSpace.Completion.coe_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (fun x y => x + y) hz hw

/-- The same actual tensor Haar operator is exactly the original Haar operator under the verified coordinates. -/
theorem haarLeftRegularTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv (g : G) :
    (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply]
  exact (haarLeftRegularTensor_coordinates G μ H g (E.symm ξ)).trans
    (congrArg (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (E.apply_symm_apply ξ))

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.RightTensorProduct
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct.CompletionAdjoint
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularRepresentation

/-!
# The original H-first tensor Haar unitary representation

The operator value is the actual completed tensor of id_H and the scalar
Haar left regular operator. Its star-monoid laws give the actual unitary
group map. The computed tensor/L2 comparison transfers the original vector
orbit continuity onto this same tensor carrier.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal Topology InnerProductSpace

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable (G : Type uG) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable (H : Type uH) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original strongly continuous Haar group unitaries on the literal H-first Hilbert tensor. -/
def haarLeftRegularTensor :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  have hintertwine (g : G) (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
      E (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z) =
      (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (E z) := by
    refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
      (isClosed_eq
        (E.continuous.comp (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
          (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)).continuous)
        ((haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ).continuous.comp E.continuous)) ?_
    intro z
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x f =>
      rw [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul]
      change E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) f) :
          H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
        (haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
          (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))
      apply Lp.ext
      have hinput := L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x f
      have houtput := L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ x
        ((haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) f)
      have hscalar := haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ ℂ g f
      have hvector := haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
        (E ((x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))
      have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
      have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
        ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
      have hcomposed := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinput
      filter_upwards [houtput, hscalar, hvector, hcomposed] with s hout hscalar hvector hin
      simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hin
      rw [hout, hscalar, hvector, hin]
    | add z w hz hw =>
      simpa only [UniformSpace.Completion.coe_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (fun x y => x + y) hz hw
  let F : (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) →⋆*
      (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
    { toFun := TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
      map_one' := TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_id_id ℂ H (Lp ℂ 2 μ)
      map_mul' := fun x y => by
        simpa only [one_mul] using TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_mul (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) 1 x y
      map_star' := fun x => by
        simpa only [star_one] using (TensorProduct.star_mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) x).symm }
  refine
    { toMonoidHom := (Unitary.map F).toMonoidHom.comp (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ).toMonoidHom
      continuous_orbit := ?_ }
  intro z
  change Continuous fun g => TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z
  have htransport (g : G) : TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)
      (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) z =
      E.symm ((haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (E z)) := by
    apply E.injective
    rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hintertwine g z
  let m : PseudoMetricSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
    (inferInstance : SeminormedAddCommGroup
      (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))).toPseudoMetricSpace
  have hUniform : m.toUniformSpace = UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
    apply UniformSpace.ext
    exact (@PseudoMetricSpace.uniformity_dist _ m).trans
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformity_dist (α := H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))).symm
  have htop : m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace =
      (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))).toTopologicalSpace :=
    congrArg (fun w : UniformSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =>
      @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) w) hUniform
  have hcontinuous := E.symm.continuous.comp ((haarLeftRegular G μ H).continuous_orbit (E z))
  change @Continuous G (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) _
    m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
      (fun g => E.symm ((haarLeftRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (E z))) at hcontinuous
  rw [htop] at hcontinuous
  simpa only [htransport] using hcontinuous

/-- The original tensor Haar unitary is literally id_H tensored with the scalar Haar operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarLeftRegularTensor_apply (g : G) :
    (haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
        (haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  rfl

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.HaarRightTranslation
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.CovariantRepresentation

/-!
# Normalized right pullback for a regular Haar measure

The existing modular character gives the actual right-translation
pushforward factor. The normalized pullback acts on the original Haar
`L²` carrier and has the same norm as its input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- The prescribed modularly normalized right translate belongs to the same Haar `L²`. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_memLp (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    MemLp (fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * g)) 2 μ := by
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun x : G => x * g) μ
      (Measure.modularCharacter g • μ) :=
    ⟨measurable_id.mul_const g, Measure.map_right_mul_modular μ g⟩
  have hscaled := (Lp.memLp ξ).smul_measure_nnreal (c := Measure.modularCharacter g)
  exact (hscaled.comp_measurePreserving hpres).const_smul _

/-- The actual normalized right pullback on the original `L²` carrier. -/
def haarRightPullback (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : Lp H 2 μ :=
  (haarRightPullback_memLp μ g ξ).toLp
    (fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * g))

/-- The original Haar representatives have the exact modular right-translation formula. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    haarRightPullback μ g ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * g) :=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp (haarRightPullback_memLp μ g ξ)

/-- The exact modular weight makes right pullback norm preserving. -/
theorem norm_haarRightPullback (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    ‖haarRightPullback μ g ξ‖ = ‖ξ‖ := by
  let c : ℝ≥0 := Measure.modularCharacter g
  let r : ℝ := (c : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hcpos : 0 < c := Measure.modularCharacterFun_pos g
  have hcR : 0 < (c : ℝ) := hcpos
  have hrpos : 0 < r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hcR _
  have hweight : r * (c : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hcR]
    simp
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun x : G => x * g) μ (c • μ) :=
    ⟨measurable_id.mul_const g, Measure.map_right_mul_modular μ g⟩
  have hscaled := (Lp.memLp ξ).smul_measure_nnreal (c := c)
  change ‖(haarRightPullback_memLp μ g ξ).toLp
    (r • ((ξ : G → H) ∘ fun x : G => x * g))‖ = ‖ξ‖
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp, eLpNorm_const_smul,
    eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving hscaled.aestronglyMeasurable hpres,
    eLpNorm_smul_measure_of_ne_zero' hcpos.ne']
  simp only [ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, NNReal.coe_rpow, toReal_enorm]
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrpos, ← mul_assoc, hweight, one_mul]
  rfl

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRightRegularPullback
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.ModularCharacterContinuity
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.ContinuousMapDense
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.CompactApproximation
public import Mathlib.Topology.UrysohnsLemma
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Continuity
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# The unitary algebra of normalized Haar right translation

Normalized right pullback defines the actual unitary group homomorphism on
the original Haar `L²` carrier. All products and inverse laws follow at the
original almost-everywhere function representatives.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

private theorem haarL2_norm_sq
    {X : Type uG} [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X)
    {E : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (ζ : Lp E 2 ν) :
    ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : X, ‖ζ x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν := by
  calc
    ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = (RCLike.re (inner ℂ ζ ζ) : ℝ) :=
      InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) ζ
    _ = RCLike.re (∫ x : X, inner ℂ (ζ x) (ζ x) ∂ν) := rfl
    _ = ∫ x : X, (RCLike.re (inner ℂ (ζ x) (ζ x)) : ℝ) ∂ν :=
      (integral_re (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) ζ ζ)).symm
    _ = ∫ x : X, ‖ζ x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
        (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (ζ x)).symm)

private theorem compactIndicatorApprox
    {X : Type uG} [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (ν : Measure X) [ν.Regular]
    {E : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {p : ENNReal} (hp : p ≠ ⊤) {s : Set X} (hs : IsCompact s) (hsclosed : IsClosed s)
    (c : E) {ε : ENNReal} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : X → E, HasCompactSupport f ∧ Continuous f ∧ MemLp f p ν ∧
      eLpNorm (f - s.indicator (fun _ => c)) p ν ≤ ε := by
  exact MeasureTheory.compactIndicatorApprox ν hp hs hsclosed c hε

private theorem locallyCompactVectorApprox
    {X : Type uG} [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (ν : Measure X) [ν.Regular]
    {E : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {p : ENNReal} (hp : p ≠ ⊤) {f : X → E} (hf : MemLp f p ν)
    {ε : ENNReal} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : X → E, HasCompactSupport g ∧ eLpNorm (f - g) p ν ≤ ε ∧
      Continuous g ∧ MemLp g p ν := by
  exact MeasureTheory.locallyCompactVectorApprox ν hp hf hε

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G]

/-- The actual modular right weight respects group products. -/
theorem haarRightModularWeight_mul (g h : G) :
    (Measure.modularCharacter (g * h) : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        (Measure.modularCharacter h : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
  rw [map_mul, NNReal.coe_mul]
  exact Real.mul_rpow (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)

variable [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

private theorem rightQuasi (g : G) :
    QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun x : G => x * g) μ μ := by
  refine ⟨measurable_id.mul_const g, ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_right_mul_modular μ g]
  exact Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.smul_left Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl _

/-- Normalized right pullback preserves addition on the actual `L²` carrier. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_add (g : G) (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) :
    haarRightPullback μ g (ξ + η) = haarRightPullback μ g ξ + haarRightPullback μ g η := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hinput := (rightQuasi μ g).ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_add ξ η)
  have houtput := Lp.coeFn_add (haarRightPullback μ g ξ) (haarRightPullback μ g η)
  filter_upwards [haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g (ξ + η),
    haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g ξ, haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g η,
    hinput, houtput] with x h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply] at h₄ h₅
  rw [h₁, h₅, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  exact smul_add _ _ _

/-- Normalized right pullback preserves the original complex scalar action. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_smul (g : G) (c : ℂ) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    haarRightPullback μ g (c • ξ) = c • haarRightPullback μ g ξ := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hinput := (rightQuasi μ g).ae_eq_comp (Lp.coeFn_smul c ξ)
  have houtput := Lp.coeFn_smul c (haarRightPullback μ g ξ)
  filter_upwards [haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g (c • ξ),
    haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g ξ, hinput, houtput] with x h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply] at h₃ h₄
  rw [h₁, h₄, h₂, h₃]
  exact smul_comm _ c _

/-- The normalized identity right translation is the identity operator. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_one (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) : haarRightPullback μ (1 : G) ξ = ξ := by
  apply Lp.ext
  simpa only [map_one, NNReal.coe_one, Real.one_rpow, one_smul, mul_one] using
    haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ (1 : G) ξ

/-- Actual right pullbacks compose in the original group order. -/
theorem haarRightPullback_mul (g h : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    haarRightPullback μ (g * h) ξ = haarRightPullback μ g (haarRightPullback μ h ξ) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hinner := (rightQuasi μ g).ae_eq_comp (haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ h ξ)
  filter_upwards [haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ (g * h) ξ,
    haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g (haarRightPullback μ h ξ), hinner] with x h₁ h₂ h₃
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  calc
    _ = ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          (Measure.modularCharacter h : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹)) • ξ (x * (g * h)) := by
      rw [haarRightModularWeight_mul]
    _ = (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) •
          ((Measure.modularCharacter h : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * (g * h))) :=
      mul_smul _ _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_assoc]

/-- The actual modularly normalized right translation as a linear isometry equivalence. -/
def haarRightRegularIsometry (g : G) : Lp H 2 μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ where
  toFun := haarRightPullback μ g
  invFun := haarRightPullback μ g⁻¹
  left_inv ξ := by
    calc
      _ = haarRightPullback μ (g⁻¹ * g) ξ := (haarRightPullback_mul μ g⁻¹ g ξ).symm
      _ = ξ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel, haarRightPullback_one]
  right_inv ξ := by
    calc
      _ = haarRightPullback μ (g * g⁻¹) ξ := (haarRightPullback_mul μ g g⁻¹ ξ).symm
      _ = ξ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel, haarRightPullback_one]
  map_add' := haarRightPullback_add μ g
  map_smul' := haarRightPullback_smul μ g
  norm_map' := norm_haarRightPullback μ g

variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The genuine unitary group homomorphism of normalized Haar right translations. -/
def haarRightRegularUnitaryHom : G →* unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) where
  toFun g := Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm (haarRightRegularIsometry (H := H) μ g)
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    exact haarRightPullback_one μ ξ
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    exact haarRightPullback_mul μ g h ξ

/-- The actual unitary operator has the original prescribed Haar representatives. -/
theorem haarRightRegularUnitaryHom_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * g) :=
  haarRightPullback_ae_eq μ g ξ

private theorem haarRight_on_toLp_ae (g : G) (f : G → H) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val (hf.toLp f) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • f (x * g) := by
  have hinput := (rightQuasi μ g).ae_eq_comp (MemLp.coeFn_toLp hf)
  filter_upwards [haarRightRegularUnitaryHom_ae_eq μ g (hf.toLp f), hinput]
    with x h₁ h₂
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂]

private theorem continuous_haarRight_on_compact
    (f : G → H) (hfcont : Continuous f) (hfcomp : HasCompactSupport f)
    (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    Continuous (fun g : G =>
      (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val (hf.toLp f)) := by
  have hd : Continuous (fun g : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp Measure.continuous_modularCharacter
  have hw : Continuous (fun g : G =>
      (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹)) :=
    hd.rpow_const fun g => Or.inl (ne_of_gt
      (show (0 : ℝ) < (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) from
        Measure.modularCharacterFun_pos g))
  let F : G → G → H := fun g x =>
    (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • f (x * g)
  have hFcont : Continuous F.uncurry :=
    (hw.comp continuous_fst).smul
      (hfcont.comp (continuous_snd.mul continuous_fst))
  let η : Lp H 2 μ := hf.toLp f
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  obtain ⟨U, hUcompact, hUneigh⟩ := exists_compact_mem_nhds g₀
  have hg₀ : g₀ ∈ U := mem_of_mem_nhds hUneigh
  let K : Set G := (fun p : G × G => p.1 * p.2⁻¹) '' (tsupport f ×ˢ U)
  have hfK : IsCompact (tsupport f) := hfcomp
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (hfK.prod hUcompact).image (continuous_fst.mul continuous_snd.inv)
  have hFzero : ∀ g x : G, g ∈ U → x ∉ K → F g x = 0 := by
    intro g x hg hx
    have hfx : f (x * g) = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hx
      refine ⟨(x * g, g), ⟨subset_closure hne, hg⟩, ?_⟩
      change (x * g) * g⁻¹ = x
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    simp only [F, hfx, smul_zero]
  let I : G → ℝ := fun g => ∫ x : G, ‖F g x - F g₀ x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
  have hI : ContinuousAt I g₀ := by
    have hjoint : Continuous (fun p : G × G => ‖F p.1 p.2 - F g₀ p.2‖ ^ 2) :=
      (hFcont.sub (hFcont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd))).norm.pow 2
    have hsupp : ∀ g x : G, g ∈ U → x ∉ K → ‖F g x - F g₀ x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro g x hg hx
      simp only [hFzero g x hg hx, hFzero g₀ x hg₀ hx, sub_self, norm_zero,
        zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
    exact (continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support (μ := μ) hK
      hjoint.continuousOn hsupp).continuousAt hUneigh
  have hN (g : G) :
      dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
        ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η) ^ 2 = I g := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, haarL2_norm_sq μ]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub
        ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
        ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η),
      haarRight_on_toLp_ae μ g f hf, haarRight_on_toLp_ae μ g₀ f hf]
        with x hs h₁ h₂
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hs
    change ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η) x = F g x at h₁
    change ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η) x = F g₀ x at h₂
    rw [hs, h₁, h₂]
  have hIzero : I g₀ = 0 := by simp only [I, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide :
    (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), integral_zero]
  have hItendsto : Tendsto I (𝓝 g₀) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, hIzero] using hI
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hevent := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hItendsto) (ε ^ 2) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
  filter_upwards [hevent] with g hg
  have hsq :
      dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
        ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η) ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 := by
    rw [hN]
    exact (le_abs_self (I g)).trans_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hg)
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg hε.le).mp hsq

private theorem continuous_haarRight_orbit (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    Continuous (fun g : G => (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val ξ) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hquarter : 0 < ε / 4 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨f, hfcomp, happrox, hfcont, hf⟩ :=
    locallyCompactVectorApprox μ ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top (Lp.memLp ξ)
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hquarter).ne'
  let η : Lp H 2 μ := hf.toLp f
  have hed : edist ξ η = eLpNorm ((ξ : G → H) - f) 2 μ := by
    simpa only [Lp.toLp_coeFn] using
      (Lp.edist_toLp_toLp (ξ : G → H) f (Lp.memLp ξ) hf)
  have hdist : dist ξ η ≤ ε / 4 := by
    have h : ENNReal.ofReal (dist ξ η) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 4) := by
      rw [← edist_dist, hed]
      exact happrox
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hquarter.le).mp h
  have hηcont : ContinuousAt (fun g : G =>
      (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η) g₀ :=
    (continuous_haarRight_on_compact μ f hfcont hfcomp hf).continuousAt
  have hevent := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hηcont) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  have hisometry (g : G) (x y : Lp H 2 μ) :
      dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val x)
        ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val y) = dist x y :=
    (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv (haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g)).isometry.dist_eq x y
  filter_upwards [hevent] with g hg
  calc
    _ ≤ dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val ξ)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η) +
        dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val ξ) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val ξ)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η) +
        (dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η) +
        dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val ξ)) :=
      add_le_add
        (le_refl (dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val ξ)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)))
        (dist_triangle
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val ξ))
    _ = dist ξ η +
        (dist ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g).val η)
          ((haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ g₀).val η) + dist η ξ) := by
      rw [hisometry, hisometry]
    _ < ε := by rw [dist_comm η ξ]; linarith

variable (G H)

/-- The genuine strongly continuous normalized Haar right regular representation. -/
def haarRightRegular : StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G (Lp H 2 μ) where
  toMonoidHom := haarRightRegularUnitaryHom (H := H) μ
  continuous_orbit := by
    intro ξ
    exact continuous_haarRight_orbit μ ξ

/-- The complete right regular action has the original modular Haar formula. -/
theorem haarRightRegular_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    (haarRightRegular G μ H g : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x : G => (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • ξ (x * g) :=
  haarRightRegularUnitaryHom_ae_eq μ g ξ

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# Actual square-summable operator coefficients relative to a Hilbert basis

The carrier is the submodule of the original bounded operators whose actual
basis-vector images belong to stock lp K2. The coefficient, norm and inner
functions use this literal lp element. No independent completed operator
space, countable basis, norm comparison or basis-independence theorem is an
input. No new norm or completeness instance on the operator subtype is
asserted. These constructors serve the original Hilbert-Schmidt exercise
and trace-factorization statements, including arbitrary-cardinality bases
and zero Hilbert spaces.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace HilbertBasis

universe uI uH uK
variable {I : Type uI}
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]

/-- Original bounded operators with actual square-summable images of the given basis vectors. -/
def squareSummableOperators (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H) : Submodule ℂ (H →L[ℂ] K) where
  carrier := {T | Memℓp (fun i => T (b i)) 2}
  zero_mem' := by
    change Memℓp (fun _ : I => (0 : K)) 2
    exact zero_mem_ℓp'
  add_mem' := by
    intro T S hT hS
    change Memℓp (fun i => T (b i) + S (b i)) 2
    exact hT.add hS
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c T hT
    change Memℓp (fun i => c • T (b i)) 2
    exact hT.const_smul c

/-- The actual lp class consists of the original operator's values on the original basis. -/
def operatorCoefficients (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H) (T : squareSummableOperators (K := K) b) :
    lp (fun _ : I => K) 2 :=
  ⟨fun i => (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (b i), T.property⟩

/-- Each original coefficient retains its literal bounded-operator value. -/
theorem operatorCoefficients_apply (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H)
    (T : squareSummableOperators (K := K) b) (i : I) :
    operatorCoefficients b T i = (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (b i) := rfl

/-- The original coefficient assignment is linear on the actual square-summable submodule. -/
def operatorCoefficientsLinearMap (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H) :
    squareSummableOperators (K := K) b →ₗ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : I => K) 2 where
  toFun := operatorCoefficients b
  map_add' T S := by
    ext i
    rfl
  map_smul' c T := by
    ext i
    rfl

/-- The actual coefficient lp norm, without a new norm on the operator subtype. -/
def operatorCoefficientNorm (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H)
    (T : squareSummableOperators (K := K) b) : ℝ :=
  ‖operatorCoefficients b T‖

/-- The actual coefficient lp inner product on two original square-summable operators. -/
def operatorCoefficientInner (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H)
    (S T : squareSummableOperators (K := K) b) : ℂ :=
  inner ℂ (operatorCoefficients b S) (operatorCoefficients b T)

/-- The same original scalar and operator combination retains its actual coefficient class. -/
theorem operatorCoefficientsLinearMap_apply (b : HilbertBasis I ℂ H)
    (T : squareSummableOperators (K := K) b) :
    operatorCoefficientsLinearMap b T = operatorCoefficients b T := rfl

end HilbertBasis

end

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.FiniteRange
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Trace
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator.FiniteRankClosure
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.FiniteRank
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint.OneSided

/-!
# Actual bounded finite-rank carriers and range trace

The original bounded finite-rank submodule specializes the scalar-general
canonical ContinuousLinearMap.finiteRankOperator, formerly used by Conway
Functional Analysis VI.3. Trace is stock finite-dimensional trace on the actual range,
with the original operator restricted to that range. The finite-rank inner
and square-root functions record the printed scalar formulas; no Hilbert
space/norm/completeness instance is selected from their source theorem.
On a complete Hilbert domain the carrier is exactly the existing rank-one
span, via the explicit equality below. The more general normed-space carrier
supports range trace and composition without requiring an inner product.
All proofs here are necessary constructor/value or carrier-identification facts.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

universe uH uK uL

section NormedSpaces
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℂ K]
variable {L : Type uL} [NormedAddCommGroup L] [NormedSpace ℂ L]

/-- Composing the actual finite-rank operator on the left retains its literal finite-rank value. -/
def finiteRankComposeLeft (R : K →L[ℂ] L) (T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) :
    finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := L) :=
  ⟨R.comp T.val, by
    apply (mem_finiteRankOperator _).2
    change (R.toLinearMap.comp T.val.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
    exact ((mem_finiteRankOperator T.val).1 T.property).comp_left R.toLinearMap⟩

/-- The composed finite-rank subtype has the same original bounded operator. -/
theorem finiteRankComposeLeft_coe (R : K →L[ℂ] L) (T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) :
    (finiteRankComposeLeft R T : H →L[ℂ] L) = R.comp T.val := rfl

/-- The genuine finite-dimensional trace on the actual operator range. -/
def finiteRankRangeTrace (T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := H)) : ℂ :=
  LinearMap.trace ℂ T.val.range
    (T.val.toLinearMap.rangeRestrict.domRestrict T.val.range)

end NormedSpaces

section HilbertSpaces
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

omit [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- On complete Hilbert domains the actual finite-range carrier is the existing rank-one span.
This identifies the original finite-rank trace DATA with the canonical compact-operator API. -/
theorem finiteRankOperator_eq_finiteRankSubmodule :
    finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K) =
      InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K) := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro T hT
    let : IsNoetherian ℂ T.range :=
      ((mem_finiteRankOperator T).1 hT).hasNoetherianRange
    let : FiniteDimensional ℂ T.range := inferInstance
    let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (Module.finrank ℂ T.range)) ℂ T.range :=
      stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ T.range
    have hProjection : T.range.starProjection =
        ∑ i, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i : K) (b i : K) :=
      b.starProjection_eq_sum_rankOne
    have hFactor : T.range.starProjection.comp T = T := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      exact T.range.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hSum : T = ∑ i, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i : K)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource T) (b i : K)) := by
      calc
        T = T.range.starProjection.comp T := hFactor.symm
        _ = (∑ i, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i : K) (b i : K)).comp T :=
          congrArg (fun P : K →L[ℂ] K => P.comp T) hProjection
        _ = ∑ i, (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i : K) (b i : K)).comp T := by
          ext x
          simp
        _ = ∑ i, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i : K)
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource T) (b i : K)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _hi
          ext x
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply]
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource_inner_left]
    rw [hSum]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      InnerProductSpace.rankOne_mem_finiteRankSubmodule (b i : K)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource T) (b i : K))
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    apply (mem_finiteRankOperator _).2
    change (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange
    have hSpan : (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ x).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange :=
      LinearMap.HasFiniteRange.of_finite_dom
    have hRank : (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
      rw [InnerProductSpace.rankOne_def', ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp]
      exact hSpan.comp_right (innerSL ℂ y).toLinearMap
    exact hRank

omit [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- The printed finite-rank scalar inner product is the actual trace of adjoint S composed with T.
-/
def finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner (S T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) : ℂ :=
  finiteRankRangeTrace (finiteRankComposeLeft (ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource S.val) T)

omit [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- The printed square-root of the diagonal trace, with no assumed norm law or completed model. -/
def finiteRankHilbertSchmidtNorm (T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner T T).re

omit [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- The finite-rank inner function retains the original adjoint/product trace exactly. -/
theorem finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner_def (S T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) :
    finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner S T =
      finiteRankRangeTrace (finiteRankComposeLeft (ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource S.val) T) := rfl

/-- On two complete Hilbert spaces the generalized trace formula is the original adjoint formula. -/
theorem finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner_eq_trace_adjoint
    (S T : finiteRankOperator (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) :
    finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner S T =
      finiteRankRangeTrace (finiteRankComposeLeft S.val.adjoint T) := by
  rw [finiteRankHilbertSchmidtInner_def,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource_eq_adjoint]

end HilbertSpaces

end ContinuousLinearMap

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Topology.Algebra.Module.Matrix
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint.OneSided
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

/-!
# Rectangular adjoints of operator-valued matrices

The adjoint of the public PiLp column action is the column action of the
transpose of the entry adjoints, with the same finite-product inner
products. The one-sided law requires completeness only of the source
stage. The usual adjoint facade law is a separate both-complete corollary.

No matrix-action copy, new matrix norm or infinite-square-summable carrier
is introduced. Square complete-H specializations supply star compatibility;
CStarMatrix norm/isometry and spatial identifications are separate results.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

universe uScalar uRow uColumn uSource uTarget

variable {𝕜 : Type uScalar} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable {m : Type uRow} {n : Type uColumn}
variable {E : Type uSource} {F : Type uTarget}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F]

namespace Matrix

/-- The one-sided adjoint of the rectangular column action is the action of
the transpose of its entry adjoints. The target need not be complete. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_adjointOfCompleteSource [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (M : Matrix m n (E →L[𝕜] F)) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M) =
      toPiLpContinuousLinearMap
        ((M.map fun T : E →L[𝕜] F =>
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource T).transpose) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply ext_inner_right 𝕜
  intro v
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource_inner_left,
    PiLp.inner_apply, toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    transpose_apply, map_apply, sum_inner, inner_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

variable [CompleteSpace F]

/-- The usual both-complete adjoint facade is the action of the transpose of
the entry adjoints. No target-completeness weakening of that facade is made. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_adjoint [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (M : Matrix m n (E →L[𝕜] F)) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M) =
      toPiLpContinuousLinearMap
        ((M.map fun T : E →L[𝕜] F => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T).transpose) := by
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjointOfCompleteSource_eq_adjoint] using
    (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_adjointOfCompleteSource M)

end Matrix

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Matrix.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Operator matrices on the finite Hilbert product

The existing column action and coordinate recovery form the actual star-algebra
equivalence on finite PiLp products. Its raw algebraic version uses RCLike scalars;
the CStarMatrix norm/isometry statements are complex-only and use the coefficient's
computed spectral order. No norm is transported from ordinary Matrix.

Empty index types and zero Hilbert spaces are allowed. No Hilbert tensor,
compact-quotient, entrywise-normality or source classification is asserted here.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

universe uScalar uIndex uHilbert

namespace Matrix

variable {𝕜 : Type uScalar} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable {n : Type uIndex} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
variable {H : Type uHilbert} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
variable [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The existing finite column action and coordinate recovery, as a star-algebra
equivalence. Operator multiplication is composition, in the original order. -/
def piLpStarAlgEquiv :
    Matrix n n (H →L[𝕜] H) ≃⋆ₐ[𝕜]
      ((PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) →L[𝕜] (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))) :=
  { Matrix.piLpContinuousLinearMapEquiv (R := 𝕜) (m := n) (n := n) (E := H) (F := H) with
    map_add' := by
      intro M N
      change toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (M + N) =
        toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M + toPiLpContinuousLinearMap N
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      simp only [toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply, Matrix.add_apply, _root_.add_apply,
        PiLp.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    map_mul' := by
      intro M N
      change toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (M * N) =
        toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M * toPiLpContinuousLinearMap N
      exact toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_mul M N
    map_star' := by
      intro M
      change toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (star M) = star (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M)
      have hStar :
          (M.map fun T : H →L[𝕜] H => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T).transpose = star M := by
        apply Matrix.ext
        intro i j
        rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.star_apply]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint (M j i)).symm
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_adjoint M, hStar]
    map_smul' := by
      intro c M
      change toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (c • M) = c • toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      simp only [toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
        PiLp.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum] }

/-- The bundled map retains the literal column-sum value. -/
@[simp]
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_apply (M : Matrix n n (H →L[𝕜] H))
    (v : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) (i : n) :
    piLpStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n) (H := H) M v i = ∑ j : n, M i j (v j) := by
  change toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M v i = _
  exact toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply M v i

/-- The inverse coefficients are the existing coordinate injection/projection maps. -/
@[simp]
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_symm_apply_entry
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H) →L[𝕜] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))
    (i j : n) (x : H) :
    (piLpStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n) (H := H)).symm T i j x = T (PiLp.single 2 j x) i := by
  change ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix T i j x = _
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix_apply T i j x

end Matrix

namespace CStarMatrix

variable {n : Type uIndex} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
variable {H : Type uHilbert} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
variable [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual C-star operator-matrix equivalence on the finite Hilbert product.
The type-copy transport is algebraic; the norm comparison is proved separately. -/
def piLpStarAlgEquiv :
    CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      ((PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) →L[ℂ] (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))) :=
  (CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (A := H →L[ℂ] H)).symm.trans
    (Matrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := n) (H := H))

/-- The C-star copy acts by the same actual operator column sum. -/
@[simp]
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_apply (X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (v : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) (i : n) :
    piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X v i = ∑ j : n, X i j (v j) := by
  change Matrix.toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm X) v i = _
  exact Matrix.toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm X) v i

/-- The inverse has the literal recovered continuous-linear coefficient maps. -/
@[simp]
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_symm_apply_entry
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H) →L[ℂ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))
    (i j : n) (x : H) :
    (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).symm T i j x = T (PiLp.single 2 j x) i := by
  change ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix T i j x = _
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix_apply T i j x

/-- The constructed equivalence preserves the actual C-star/Hilbert operator metric. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_isometry :
    letI : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    Isometry (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)) := by
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let e := piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom e.injective

/-- The norm here is the CStarMatrix operator norm, not a plain matrix row norm. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_norm_map :
    letI : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    ∀ X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H),
      ‖piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X‖ = ‖X‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let e := piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  exact fun X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H) =>
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom e.injective X

end CStarMatrix

end

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Matrix.CStarAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.Matrix
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Finite Hilbert operator matrices modulo compact operators

The actual column-action star equivalence identifies compact finite blocks with
matrices of compact coefficients. The entrywise Calkin projection has exactly
this closed star ideal as its kernel. Descending coordinate recovery through the
existing compact-operator quotient gives the actual Calkin algebra of the finite
Hilbert product as the C-star matrix algebra over the coefficient Calkin algebra.

The canonical quotient carriers and norms are retained. Empty finite indices and
zero Hilbert spaces are allowed; no basis, absorption, nontriviality or norm-one
assumption is made. No Hilbert tensor or source classification is asserted.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe uIndex uHilbert

variable {n : Type uIndex} [Fintype n]
variable {H : Type uHilbert} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
variable [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

namespace CStarMatrix

/-- The actual Calkin projection applied to every operator coefficient. -/
def calkinMap :
    CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      CStarMatrix n n (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
  mapₙₐ (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- Each entry is the class of the original continuous linear operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem calkinMap_apply_entry (X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H)) (i j : n) :
    calkinMap (n := n) (H := H) X i j = CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (X i j) :=
  rfl

/-- Finite matrices of actual Calkin classes have actual operator representatives. -/
theorem calkinMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)) := by
  classical
  intro X
  have hLift (i j : n) :
      ∃ T : H →L[ℂ] H, CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T = X i j :=
    CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (X i j)
  choose M hM using hLift
  refine ⟨CStarMatrix.ofMatrix M, ?_⟩
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  change CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (M i j) = X i j
  exact hM i j

/-- A matrix has zero symbol exactly when every actual entry is compact. -/
theorem calkinMap_eq_zero_iff (X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    calkinMap (n := n) (H := H) X = 0 ↔ ∀ i j : n, IsCompactOperator (X i j) := by
  constructor
  · intro hX i j
    have hEntry := congrArg (fun Y : CStarMatrix n n (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) => Y i j) hX
    have hZero : CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (X i j) = 0 := by
      simpa only [calkinMap_apply_entry, CStarMatrix.zero_apply] using hEntry
    exact (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) (X i j)).mp hZero
  · intro hEntries
    apply CStarMatrix.ext
    intro i j
    exact (calkinMap_apply_entry X i j).trans
      ((CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) (X i j)).mpr (hEntries i j))

section HilbertBlock

variable [DecidableEq n]

/-- Compactness of the actual finite Hilbert block is exactly entrywise compactness. -/
theorem isCompactOperator_piLpStarAlgEquiv_iff
    (X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    IsCompactOperator (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X) ↔
      ∀ i j : n, IsCompactOperator (X i j) := by
  have hAction : piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X =
      Matrix.toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm X) := rfl
  rw [hAction]
  simpa only [CStarMatrix.ofMatrix_symm_apply] using
    (Matrix.isCompactOperator_toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_iff
      (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm X))

/-- The actual closed compact-block ideal, pulled back along the Hilbert equivalence. -/
def compactOperatorIdeal :
    letI : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    ClosedStarIdeal (CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.comap
    (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)))

/-- Membership in the actual closed matrix ideal is the literal compact-entry predicate. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_compactOperatorIdeal :
    letI : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    ∀ X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H),
      X ∈ compactOperatorIdeal (n := n) (H := H) ↔
        ∀ i j : n, IsCompactOperator (X i j) := by
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  change ∀ X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H),
    IsCompactOperator (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X) ↔
      ∀ i j : n, IsCompactOperator (X i j)
  exact fun X => isCompactOperator_piLpStarAlgEquiv_iff X

/-- The genuine entrywise projection kernel is the actual closed compact-block ideal. -/
theorem ker_calkinMap :
    letI : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    letI : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    ClosedStarIdeal.ker (calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)) =
      compactOperatorIdeal (n := n) (H := H) := by
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  apply ClosedStarIdeal.ext
  intro X
  rw [ClosedStarIdeal.mem_ker, mem_compactOperatorIdeal]
  exact calkinMap_eq_zero_iff X

end HilbertBlock

end CStarMatrix

namespace CalkinAlgebra

variable [DecidableEq n]

open scoped NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient in
/-- Coordinate recovery followed by entrywise classes, on the existing Calkin quotient. -/
def piLpMap :
    CalkinAlgebra ℂ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      CStarMatrix n n (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := by
  let J := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))
  let : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  let e := CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  let f : (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H) →L[ℂ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      CStarMatrix n n (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
    (CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)).comp e.symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  have hJ : ∀ T ∈ J.carrier, f T = 0 := by
    intro T hT
    have hCompact : IsCompactOperator T := hT
    change CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H) (e.symm T) = 0
    apply (CStarMatrix.calkinMap_eq_zero_iff (e.symm T)).mpr
    intro i j
    change IsCompactOperator (ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix T i j)
    exact hCompact.toPiLpMatrix i j
  let induced := NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.lift J.carrier f hJ
  exact
    { toFun := fun q => induced q
      map_zero' := map_zero induced
      map_add' := map_add induced
      map_mul' := map_mul induced
      map_smul' := map_smul induced
      map_star' := map_star induced }

/-- On an actual operator representative, the quotient map is the literal recovered symbol. -/
@[simp]
theorem piLpMap_classStarMap
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H) →L[ℂ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) :
    piLpMap (n := n) (H := H) (classStarMap (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) T) =
      CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)
        ((CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).symm T) :=
  rfl

/-- The induced map is genuinely bijective, using actual compactness and
quotient representatives. -/
theorem piLpMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (piLpMap (n := n) (H := H)) := by
  let e := CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  let p := CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)
  let q := classStarMap (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) x
    obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) y
    have hImage : p (e.symm T) = p (e.symm S) := by
      simpa only [piLpMap_classStarMap] using hxy
    have hZero : p (e.symm (T - S)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, hImage, sub_self]
    have hEntries : ∀ i j : n, IsCompactOperator ((e.symm (T - S)) i j) :=
      (CStarMatrix.calkinMap_eq_zero_iff (e.symm (T - S))).mp hZero
    have hBlock : IsCompactOperator (e (e.symm (T - S))) :=
      (CStarMatrix.isCompactOperator_piLpStarAlgEquiv_iff (e.symm (T - S))).mpr hEntries
    have hCompact : IsCompactOperator (T - S) := by
      simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hBlock
    have hClass : q (T - S) = 0 :=
      (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) (T - S)).mpr hCompact
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [map_sub] using hClass)
  · intro X
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := CStarMatrix.calkinMap_surjective X
    refine ⟨q (e M), ?_⟩
    calc
      piLpMap (n := n) (H := H) (q (e M)) = p (e.symm (e M)) :=
        piLpMap_classStarMap (e M)
      _ = p M := congrArg (fun Y => p Y) (e.symm_apply_apply M)
      _ = X := hM

/-- The actual Calkin algebra of the finite Hilbert product, as an
operator-matrix Calkin algebra. -/
def piLpStarAlgEquiv :
    CalkinAlgebra ℂ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      CStarMatrix n n (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
  StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (piLpMap (n := n) (H := H)) piLpMap_bijective

/-- The equivalence retains the actual operator representative and recovered entry classes. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_classStarMap
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H) →L[ℂ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) :
    piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
        (classStarMap (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) T) =
      CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)
        ((CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).symm T) :=
  piLpMap_classStarMap T

/-- On an entrywise operator representative, the inverse is the class of its
actual Hilbert block. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_symm_calkinMap (X : CStarMatrix n n (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).symm
        (CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H) X) =
      classStarMap (H := PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H))
        (CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) X) := by
  let e := CStarMatrix.piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  let p := CStarMatrix.calkinMap (n := n) (H := H)
  apply (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)).symm_apply_eq.mpr
  rw [piLpStarAlgEquiv_classStarMap]
  exact (congrArg (fun Y => p Y) (e.symm_apply_apply X)).symm

/-- The quotient bridge preserves the actual canonical Calkin and CStarMatrix metrics. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_isometry :
    letI : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    Isometry (piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)) := by
  let : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let e := piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom e.injective

/-- No quotient norm is replaced: this is the actual matrix operator norm of the image. -/
theorem piLpStarAlgEquiv_norm_map :
    letI : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    ∀ x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)),
      ‖piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H) x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let e := piLpStarAlgEquiv (n := n) (H := H)
  exact fun x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => H)) =>
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map e.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom e.injective x

end CalkinAlgebra

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Operator.FiniteCoordinateCorner
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space

import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Operator.FiniteCoordinateExpansion
import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator.BasisApproximation
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Finset

/-!
# Initial-segment coefficient corners and compact density

For a genuine natural-number Hilbert basis, the literal finite matrix of
operator coefficients maps to the corresponding finite projection sandwich.
The finite identity applies to every bounded operator, including empty
coordinates. Positive-size corner images are dense only in the actual compact
ideal, using the existing operator-norm compact-sandwich convergence.

Completeness is derived from the basis representation before constructing the
compact C-star target. No new projection, norm, raw limit or completion is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology

namespace HilbertBasis

universe uH

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- The literal target-row/source-column coefficient matrix maps to the actual
initial-segment sandwich of an arbitrary bounded operator. Empty size is legal;
compactness and separate ambient completeness are not assumptions. -/
theorem compactCorner_coefficients
    (b : HilbertBasis ℕ ℂ H) (N : ℕ) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    letI : CompleteSpace H := b.repr.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace;
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ;
    let J := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H);
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra J.carrier := J.carrierCStarAlgebra;
    let v : Fin N → H := fun i => b i.val;
    let hv : Orthonormal ℂ v :=
      b.orthonormal.comp (fun i : Fin N => i.val)
        (fun _ _ h => Fin.ext h);
    let X : CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
      CStarMatrix.ofMatrix
        (fun i j : Fin N => inner ℂ (b i.val) (T (b j.val)));
    (hv.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N)).comp
        (T.comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N))) := by
  classical
  let : CompleteSpace H := b.repr.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  let J := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra J.carrier := J.carrierCStarAlgebra
  let v : Fin N → H := fun i => b i.val
  let hv : Orthonormal ℂ v :=
    b.orthonormal.comp (fun i : Fin N => i.val)
      (fun _ _ h => Fin.ext h)
  let X : CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix
      (fun i j : Fin N => inner ℂ (b i.val) (T (b j.val)))
  let c : ℕ → ℕ → (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    fun i j => inner ℂ (b i) (T (b j)) •
      InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i) (b j)
  change (hv.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) =
    (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N)).comp
      (T.comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N)))
  have hX (i j : Fin N) :
      X i j = inner ℂ (b i.val) (T (b j.val)) := rfl
  have hCorner :
      (hv.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, c i.val j.val := by
    rw [hv.compactCorner_coe]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _hj
    change X i j • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i.val) (b j.val) =
      inner ℂ (b i.val) (T (b j.val)) •
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (b i.val) (b j.val)
    rw [hX]
  have hSum :
      (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, c i.val j.val) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c i j := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j : Fin N, c i j.val :=
        (Finset.sum_range (n := N)
          (fun i : ℕ => ∑ j : Fin N, c i j.val)).symm
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        exact (Finset.sum_range (n := N) (fun j : ℕ => c i j)).symm
  have hProj :
      (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N)).comp
          (T.comp (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range N))) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c i j :=
    HilbertBasis.proj_comp_proj_eq_sum_rankOne b b T
      (Finset.range N) (Finset.range N)
  exact hCorner.trans (hSum.trans hProj.symm)

/-- The positive initial-segment corner images are dense in the existing
compact closed star ideal with its inherited operator norm. The basis derives
completeness; no density or convergence statement is supplied by the caller. -/
theorem dense_iUnion_range_compactCorner
    (b : HilbertBasis ℕ ℂ H) :
    letI : CompleteSpace H := b.repr.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace;
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ;
    let J := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H);
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra J.carrier := J.carrierCStarAlgebra;
    let hv : ∀ n : ℕ, Orthonormal ℂ
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => b i.val) :=
      fun n => b.orthonormal.comp (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => i.val)
        (fun _ _ h => Fin.ext h);
    let σ : ∀ n : ℕ, CStarMatrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ
        →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] J.carrier :=
      fun n => (hv n).compactCorner;
    Dense (⋃ n : ℕ, Set.range (σ n)) := by
  classical
  let : CompleteSpace H := b.repr.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  let J := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra J.carrier := J.carrierCStarAlgebra
  let hv : ∀ n : ℕ, Orthonormal ℂ
      (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => b i.val) :=
    fun n => b.orthonormal.comp (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => i.val)
      (fun _ _ h => Fin.ext h)
  let σ : ∀ n : ℕ, CStarMatrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ
      →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] J.carrier :=
    fun n => (hv n).compactCorner
  change ∀ T : J.carrier, T ∈ closure (⋃ n : ℕ, Set.range (σ n))
  intro T
  have hT : IsCompactOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    (mem_compactEndomorphismIdeal (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H)
      (T : H →L[ℂ] H)).mp T.property
  let X (N : ℕ) : CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix
      (fun i j : Fin N => inner ℂ (b i.val) ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) (b j.val)))
  let a : ℕ → J.carrier := fun n => σ n (X (n + 1))
  have hA (n : ℕ) :
      (a n : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range (n + 1))).comp
          ((T : H →L[ℂ] H).comp
            (b.toUnconditionalSchauderBasis.proj (Finset.range (n + 1)))) :=
    compactCorner_coefficients b (n + 1) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
  have hRange : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Finset.range (n + 1)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_finset_range.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hDiagonal :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n + 1), Finset.range (n + 1)))
        atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_diagonal.comp hRange
  have hLimitOp :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (a n : H →L[ℂ] H)) atTop
        (𝓝 (T : H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_
      ((HilbertBasis.tendsto_compact_sandwich b b hT).comp hDiagonal)
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n : ℕ => by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using (hA n).symm)
  have hLimit : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 T) := tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr hLimitOp
  have hMember (n : ℕ) : a n ∈ ⋃ m : ℕ, Set.range (σ m) :=
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, X (n + 1), rfl⟩
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto hLimit (Eventually.of_forall hMember)

end HilbertBasis

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Operator.HilbertAmplification
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix.CuntzFold

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Positive finite matrix folds of the actual Hilbert Calkin algebra

The frame comes from actual basis-coordinate DATA, not a supplied fold/model.
The existing classStarMap carries both computed Cuntz laws to the same Calkin
carrier, and the existing general Cuntz fold supplies the matrix equivalence.
This is a fixed-H precursor, not the general stable-B/spatial identification
or an Ext/K₁ pairing/descent theorem. The finite index is genuinely positive.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace CalkinAlgebra

universe uI uH

variable {ι : Type uI} {H : Type uH}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual quotient coordinate family satisfies every finite Gram relation. -/
theorem finiteClassFamily_orthogonal (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) (i j : Fin N) :
    star (classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i)) *
        classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  let q := classStarMap (H := H)
  calc
    _ = q (star (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i) *
        HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N j) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_star]
    _ = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [(HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily_relations b e N).1 i j]
      split_ifs <;> simp only [map_one, map_zero]

/-- The actual quotient coordinate ranges partition the Calkin unit. -/
theorem finiteClassFamily_partition (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    (∑ i : Fin N,
      classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i) *
        star (classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i))) = 1 := by
  let q := classStarMap (H := H)
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin N, q (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i *
        star (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [map_mul, map_star]
    _ = q (∑ i : Fin N, HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i *
        star (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i)) := (map_sum q _ _).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [(HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily_relations b e N).2, map_one]

/-- The actual positive matrix identification from the computed coordinate family. -/
def finiteMatrixFold (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H :=
  CuntzFamily.fold ℂ
    (fun i => classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i))
    (finiteClassFamily_orthogonal b e N) (finiteClassFamily_partition b e N)

/-- Literal ordered sum for the constructed quotient fold. -/
theorem finiteMatrixFold_apply (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+)
    (X : CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)) :
    finiteMatrixFold b e N X =
      ∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N,
        classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i) *
          X i j *
          star (classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N j)) :=
  CuntzFamily.fold_apply ℂ _ _ _ X

/-- The inverse has the actual adjoint/class/operator sandwich entries. -/
theorem finiteMatrixFold_symm_apply_entry (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) (z : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) (i j : Fin N) :
    (finiteMatrixFold b e N).symm z i j =
      star (classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i)) *
        z * classStarMap (H := H) (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N j) :=
  CuntzFamily.fold_symm_apply_entry ℂ _ _ _ z i j

/-- Quotienting the actual ordered upstairs sum agrees with the constructed matrix fold. -/
theorem finiteMatrixFold_ofMatrix_classes (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) (X : Fin N → Fin N → (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    finiteMatrixFold b e N
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => classStarMap (H := H) (X i j))) =
      classStarMap (H := H)
        (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N,
          HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N i * X i j *
            star (HilbertAmplification.finiteFamily b e N j)) := by
  rw [finiteMatrixFold_apply]
  have hEntry (i j : Fin N) :
      (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => classStarMap (H := H) (X i j)) :
        CStarMatrix (Fin N) (Fin N) (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)) i j =
          classStarMap (H := H) (X i j) := rfl
  simp only [hEntry, map_sum, map_mul, map_star]

/-- The fold uses the actual operator metric under the coefficient's computed spectral order. -/
theorem finiteMatrixFold_isometry (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    letI : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _;
    letI : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _;
    Isometry (finiteMatrixFold b e N) := by
  let : PartialOrder (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry (finiteMatrixFold b e N)
    (finiteMatrixFold b e N).injective

end CalkinAlgebra

Author: @toskua
