module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix.Padding
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator.FiniteRankClosure
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

/-!
# Compact matrix corners of finite orthonormal families

The corner acts by the literal column-ordered sum of rank-one operators.
Its target is the existing compact closed star ideal, with the inherited
operator norm. Entry recovery proves injectivity, hence the complex C-star
isometry theorem applies. Matrix identity maps to a finite orthogonal
projection, not generally to the ambient identity.

The finite index and complete complex Hilbert space have independent
universes. Empty families and zero Hilbert spaces are allowed; neither a
spanning assumption nor nontriviality or a norm-one-class hypothesis is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Orthonormal

universe uIndex uHilbert

variable {m : Type uIndex} [Fintype m]
variable {H : Type uHilbert} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H]
variable {β : m → H}

/-- The nonunital complex matrix corner associated to a finite orthonormal
family, valued in the actual compact-operator closed star ideal. -/
def compactCorner (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) :
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra;
    CStarMatrix m m ℂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier := by
  classical
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra
  let T (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
    ∑ i, ∑ j, X i j • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (β i) (β j)
  have hApply (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) (z : H) :
      T X z = ∑ i, (∑ j, X i j * inner ℂ (β j) z) • β i := by
    simp only [T, sum_apply, smul_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,
      smul_smul, Finset.sum_smul]
  have hInner (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) (z : H) (i : m) :
      inner ℂ (β i) (T X z) = ∑ j, X i j * inner ℂ (β j) z := by
    rw [hApply]
    exact hβ.inner_right_fintype (fun k => ∑ j, X k j * inner ℂ (β j) z) i
  let ρ : CStarMatrix m m ℂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    { toFun := T
      map_zero' := by
        simp only [T, CStarMatrix.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      map_add' := by
        intro X Y
        simp only [T, CStarMatrix.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c X
        simp only [T, CStarMatrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul,
          Finset.smul_sum, MonoidHom.id_apply]
      map_mul' := by
        intro X Y
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro z
        change T (X * Y) z = T X (T Y z)
        rw [hApply, hApply]
        simp_rw [hInner]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        apply congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c • β i)
        simp_rw [CStarMatrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      map_star' := by
        intro X
        change (∑ i, ∑ j, (star X) i j • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (β i) (β j)) =
          star (∑ i, ∑ j, X i j • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (β i) (β j))
        simp only [CStarMatrix.star_apply, star_sum, star_smul,
          ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, InnerProductSpace.adjoint_rankOne]
        exact Finset.sum_comm }
  refine ρ.codRestrict (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier ?_
  intro X
  have hFinite : T X ∈
      InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := H) := by
    dsimp only [T]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _hi =>
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _hj =>
        Submodule.smul_mem _ (X i j)
          (InnerProductSpace.rankOne_mem_finiteRankSubmodule (β i) (β j))
  change T X ∈ compactEndomorphismIdeal (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H)
  exact (mem_compactEndomorphismIdeal (T X)).2
    (InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule_isCompactOperator hFinite)

/-- Included into bounded operators, the corner is exactly the bundled
finite rank-one sum. -/
theorem compactCorner_coe (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) :
    (hβ.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, X i j • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (β i) (β j) :=
  rfl

/-- The corner has the literal column action on an arbitrary vector. -/
theorem compactCorner_apply (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) (z : H) :
    (hβ.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) z =
      ∑ i, (∑ j, X i j * inner ℂ (β j) z) • β i := by
  rw [hβ.compactCorner_coe]
  simp only [sum_apply, smul_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,
    smul_smul, Finset.sum_smul]

/-- Acting on the `j`th family vector recovers the full `j`th column. -/
theorem compactCorner_basis (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) (j : m) :
    (hβ.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) (β j) = ∑ i, X i j • β i := by
  classical
  rw [hβ.compactCorner_apply]
  simp [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hβ]

/-- The inner product is linear in its second argument: this recovers `X i j`,
not its complex conjugate. -/
theorem compactCorner_inner (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) (i j : m) :
    inner ℂ (β i) ((hβ.compactCorner X : H →L[ℂ] H) (β j)) = X i j := by
  rw [hβ.compactCorner_basis]
  exact hβ.inner_right_fintype (fun k => X k j) i

/-- A finite orthonormal family gives an injective matrix corner without
requiring that the family span the Hilbert space. -/
theorem compactCorner_injective (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) :
    Function.Injective hβ.compactCorner := by
  intro X Y hXY
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  have hEntry := congrArg
    (fun T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier =>
      inner ℂ (β i) ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) (β j))) hXY
  simpa only [hβ.compactCorner_inner] using hEntry

/-- The actual C-star matrix metric agrees with the inherited compact-operator
metric under the injective corner. -/
theorem compactCorner_isometry (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) :
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra;
    Isometry hβ.compactCorner := by
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry hβ.compactCorner hβ.compactCorner_injective

/-- Norm preservation uses the existing complex C-star homomorphism theorem,
with no alternative matrix or compact-operator norm. -/
theorem compactCorner_norm (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) (X : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) :
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
        (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra;
    ‖hβ.compactCorner X‖ = ‖X‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map hβ.compactCorner hβ.compactCorner_injective X

/-- Matrix identity becomes the finite orthogonal projection onto the family,
not generally the identity operator on the whole Hilbert space. -/
theorem compactCorner_one [DecidableEq m] (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) :
    (hβ.compactCorner (1 : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      ∑ i, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (β i) (β i) := by
  rw [hβ.compactCorner_coe]
  simp [CStarMatrix.one_apply]

/-- The included image of matrix identity is a genuine star projection. -/
theorem compactCorner_one_isStarProjection [DecidableEq m] (hβ : Orthonormal ℂ β) :
    IsStarProjection (hβ.compactCorner (1 : CStarMatrix m m ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  ((IsStarProjection.one (CStarMatrix m m ℂ)).map hβ.compactCorner).map
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier)

/-- Top-left zero padding is compatible with restriction of the same
orthonormal family along the actual finite index embedding. -/
theorem compactCorner_zeroExtend {r s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ s) {γ : Fin s → H}
    (hγ : Orthonormal ℂ γ) (X : CStarMatrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) :
    hγ.compactCorner (CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X) =
      (hγ.comp (Fin.castLE h)
        (fun _i _j hij => Fin.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin s => k.val) hij))).compactCorner X := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [compactCorner_coe, compactCorner_coe]
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  have hTailRow (i : Fin d) :
      (∑ j : Fin (r + d),
        CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (Fin.natAdd r i) j •
          InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (γ (Fin.natAdd r i)) (γ j)) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _hj
    have hi : ¬(Fin.natAdd r i).val < r :=
      Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_add_right r i.val)
    simp only [CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry, hi, ↓reduceDIte, zero_smul]
  rw [Fin.sum_trunc _ hTailRow]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  have hTailCol (j : Fin d) :
      CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (Fin.castAdd d i) (Fin.natAdd r j) •
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (γ (Fin.castAdd d i)) (γ (Fin.natAdd r j)) = 0 := by
    have hi : (Fin.castAdd d i).val < r := i.isLt
    have hj : ¬(Fin.natAdd r j).val < r :=
      Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_add_right r j.val)
    simp only [CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry, hi, hj, ↓reduceDIte, zero_smul]
  rw [Fin.sum_trunc _ hTailCol]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  have hiCast : Fin.castAdd d i = Fin.castLE h i := Fin.ext rfl
  have hjCast : Fin.castAdd d j = Fin.castLE h j := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [hiCast, hjCast]
  have hRetained : CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (Fin.castLE h i) (Fin.castLE h j) =
      X i j := by
    simp only [CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry, Fin.val_castLE,
      i.isLt, j.isLt, ↓reduceDIte]
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using congrArg
    (fun c : ℂ => c • InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (γ (Fin.castLE h i)) (γ (Fin.castLE h j)))
    hRetained

end Orthonormal

end

end

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.LpEquiv
public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.CuntzFamily.Finite

import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Positive finite amplification from actual Hilbert coordinates

An actual Hilbert basis and a bijection Fin2×ι≃ι determine coordinate
isometries, both binary Cuntz laws and the computed positive finite family.
The countable coordinates of a Hilbert basis are genuine square-summable lp;
only the finite outer sum uses PiLp. The existing norms and metrics are reused.
No frame, totality, fold or desired output law is supplied by the caller.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators InnerProduct lp

namespace HilbertAmplification

universe u𝕜 uI uH

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable {ι : Type uI} {H : Type uH}

/-- The actual singleton inclusion at an embedded coefficient index. -/
def coefficientFiber [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι) (j : ι) :
    𝕜 →ₗᵢ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 where
  __ := lp.lsingle (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j)
  norm_map' z := lp.norm_single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) (p := 2) (by norm_num) (f j) z

/-- Distinct embedded singleton coordinates are orthogonal. -/
theorem coefficientFiber_orthogonal [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι) :
    OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun _ : ι => 𝕜) (coefficientFiber f) := by
  intro i j hij z w
  change inner 𝕜 (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f i) z)
    (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j) w) = 0
  rw [lp.inner_single_left,
    lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j) w (f.injective.ne hij)]
  exact inner_zero_right _

/-- The native orthogonal sum of the embedded scalar coefficients. -/
def coefficientEmbedding [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι) :
    lp (fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 →ₗᵢ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 :=
  (coefficientFiber_orthogonal f).linearIsometry

/-- A singleton coefficient has its literal embedded-coordinate value. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientEmbedding_single [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι) (j : ι) (z : 𝕜) :
    coefficientEmbedding f (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z) =
      lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j) z :=
  (coefficientFiber_orthogonal (𝕜 := 𝕜) f).linearIsometry_apply_single (i := j) z

variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H]

/-- Scalar singleton coefficients represent the corresponding scalar basis multiple. -/
private theorem repr_symm_single_smul [DecidableEq ι] (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (j : ι) (z : 𝕜) :
    b.repr.symm (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z) = z • b j := by
  have h : lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z =
      z • lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j (1 : 𝕜) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
      lp.single_smul (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z (1 : 𝕜)
  rw [h, map_smul, b.repr_symm_single]

/-- The actual basis-coordinate inclusion associated to an index injection. -/
def coordinateEmbedding (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (f : ι ↪ ι) :
    H →ₗᵢ[𝕜] H := by
  classical
  exact b.repr.symm.toLinearIsometry.comp
    ((coefficientEmbedding f).comp b.repr.toLinearIsometry)

/-- Coordinate inclusion sends each actual basis vector to the indexed vector. -/
@[simp]
theorem coordinateEmbedding_basis (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (f : ι ↪ ι) (j : ι) :
    coordinateEmbedding b f (b j) = b (f j) := by
  classical
  change b.repr.symm (coefficientEmbedding f (b.repr (b j))) = b (f j)
  rw [b.repr_self, coefficientEmbedding_single, b.repr_symm_single]

/-- Basis transport preserves the literal singleton coefficients. -/
theorem coordinateEmbedding_repr_symm_single [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (f : ι ↪ ι) (j : ι) (z : 𝕜) :
    coordinateEmbedding b f (b.repr.symm (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z)) =
      b.repr.symm (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j) z) := by
  rw [repr_symm_single_smul, map_smul, coordinateEmbedding_basis,
    ← repr_symm_single_smul b (f j) z]

/-- With the identity basis the coordinate embedding is the native coefficient embedding. -/
theorem coordinateEmbedding_ofRepr_refl [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι) :
    coordinateEmbedding (HilbertBasis.ofRepr (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)) f =
      coefficientEmbedding f := by
  apply LinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap_injective
  apply lp.ext_continuousLinearMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) (p := 2) (by norm_num)
  intro j
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  exact (coordinateEmbedding_repr_symm_single
    (HilbertBasis.ofRepr (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)) f j z).trans
    (coefficientEmbedding_single f j z).symm

variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- In basis coordinates the adjoint selects the original embedded coefficient. -/
theorem coordinateEmbedding_adjoint_repr (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (f : ι ↪ ι)
    (x : H) (j : ι) :
    b.repr ((coordinateEmbedding b f).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint x) j =
      b.repr x (f j) := by
  rw [b.repr_apply_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, coordinateEmbedding_basis,
    ← b.repr_apply_apply]

/-- The coefficient adjoint extracts exactly the embedded coordinate. -/
theorem coefficientEmbedding_adjoint_apply [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι)
    (x : lp (fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2) (j : ι) :
    ((coefficientEmbedding f).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint x) j = x (f j) := by
  have h := coordinateEmbedding_adjoint_repr
    (HilbertBasis.ofRepr (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)) f x j
  rw [coordinateEmbedding_ofRepr_refl] at h
  exact h

/-- The coefficient adjoint returns a singleton from its embedded position. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientEmbedding_adjoint_single_image [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι)
    (j : ι) (z : 𝕜) :
    (coefficientEmbedding f).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
        (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 (f j) z) =
      lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 j z := by
  ext k
  rw [coefficientEmbedding_adjoint_apply]
  simp only [lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, f.injective.eq_iff]

/-- The coefficient adjoint kills a singleton outside the embedded range. -/
theorem coefficientEmbedding_adjoint_single_off [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι ↪ ι)
    (k : ι) (z : 𝕜) (hk : ∀ j, f j ≠ k) :
    (coefficientEmbedding f).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
        (lp.single (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 k z) = 0 := by
  ext j
  rw [coefficientEmbedding_adjoint_apply]
  simpa only [lp.coeFn_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using
    lp.single_apply_ne (E := fun _ : ι => 𝕜) 2 k z (hk j)

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
/-- The two coordinate inclusions determined by the actual index bijection. -/
def binaryEmbedding (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι)
    (i : Fin 2) : H →ₗᵢ[𝕜] H :=
  coordinateEmbedding b
    ⟨fun j => e (i, j), fun _j _k h => congrArg Prod.snd (e.injective h)⟩

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
/-- Literal basis action of the binary coordinate inclusions. -/
@[simp]
theorem binaryEmbedding_basis (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (i : Fin 2) (j : ι) :
    binaryEmbedding b e i (b j) = b (e (i, j)) :=
  coordinateEmbedding_basis b _ j

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem basis_inner_ext (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) {x y : H}
    (h : ∀ j, inner 𝕜 (b j) x = inner 𝕜 (b j) y) : x = y := by
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext j
  simpa only [b.repr_apply_apply] using h j

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
private theorem basis_map_ext (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) {A B : H →L[𝕜] H}
    (h : ∀ j, A (b j) = B (b j)) : A = B := by
  have hd : Dense (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range b) : Set H) :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr b.dense_span
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on hd
  rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact h j

/-- The adjoint selects the corresponding binary coordinate and kills the other. -/
theorem binaryEmbedding_adjoint_basis (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (i j : Fin 2) (m : ι) :
    (binaryEmbedding b e i).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (b (e (j, m))) =
      if i = j then b m else 0 := by
  classical
  apply basis_inner_ext b
  intro k
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, binaryEmbedding_basis]
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal]
    simp only [e.injective.eq_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hij, inner_zero_right]
    simp only [e.injective.eq_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, hij, false_and, ite_false]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in
/-- The literal binary operators, with no separately supplied frame data. -/
def binaryFamily (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) :
    Fin 2 → (H →L[𝕜] H) :=
  fun i => (binaryEmbedding b e i).toContinuousLinearMap

/-- The actual binary operators have both diagonal and off-diagonal Gram laws. -/
theorem binaryFamily_orthogonal (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (i j : Fin 2) :
    star (binaryFamily b e i) * binaryFamily b e j =
      if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  apply basis_map_ext b
  intro m
  change (binaryEmbedding b e i).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (binaryEmbedding b e j (b m)) =
    (if i = j then (1 : H →L[𝕜] H) else 0) (b m)
  rw [binaryEmbedding_basis, binaryEmbedding_adjoint_basis]
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij]

/-- The ranges of the two actual inclusions partition the whole Hilbert space. -/
theorem binaryFamily_partition (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) :
    binaryFamily b e 0 * star (binaryFamily b e 0) +
      binaryFamily b e 1 * star (binaryFamily b e 1) = 1 := by
  apply basis_map_ext b
  intro m
  obtain ⟨⟨j, k⟩, rfl⟩ := e.surjective m
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [binaryFamily, mul_apply_eq_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
      binaryEmbedding_adjoint_basis, binaryEmbedding_basis]

/-- The existing constructive positive-family algorithm on the actual binary operators. -/
def finiteFamily (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι)
    (N : ℕ+) : Fin N → (H →L[𝕜] H) :=
  CuntzFamily.ofBinaryPositive (binaryFamily b e) N

/-- Both finite Cuntz laws follow from the computed binary coordinates. -/
theorem finiteFamily_relations (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    (∀ i j : Fin N,
      star (finiteFamily b e N i) * finiteFamily b e N j =
        if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∑ i : Fin N, finiteFamily b e N i * star (finiteFamily b e N i)) = 1 :=
  CuntzFamily.ofBinaryPositive_relations (binaryFamily b e)
    (binaryFamily_orthogonal b e) (binaryFamily_partition b e) N

/-- Each computed positive-family operator is a genuine bundled linear isometry. -/
def finiteEmbedding (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι)
    (N : ℕ+) (i : Fin N) : H →ₗᵢ[𝕜] H where
  toLinearMap := (finiteFamily b e N i).toLinearMap
  norm_map' := by
    have h : star (finiteFamily b e N i) * finiteFamily b e N i = 1 :=
      ((finiteFamily_relations b e N).1 i i).trans (ite_eq_left rfl)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] at h
    exact (finiteFamily b e N i).norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self.mpr h

/-- Bundling does not alter the actual finite operator action. -/
theorem finiteEmbedding_apply (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) (i : Fin N) (x : H) :
    finiteEmbedding b e N i x = finiteFamily b e N i x :=
  rfl

/-- The computed finite embeddings are an orthogonal, total Hilbert sum. -/
theorem finiteFamily_isHilbertSum (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    IsHilbertSum 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin N => H) (finiteEmbedding b e N) := by
  classical
  refine IsHilbertSum.mk ?_ ?_
  · intro i j hij x y
    have hzero : star (finiteFamily b e N i) * finiteFamily b e N j = 0 := by
      simpa only [ite_eq_right hij] using (finiteFamily_relations b e N).1 i j
    change inner 𝕜 (finiteFamily b e N i x) (finiteFamily b e N j y) = 0
    calc
      _ = inner 𝕜 x
          ((finiteFamily b e N i).adjoint (finiteFamily b e N j y)) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right _ _ _).symm
      _ = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[𝕜] H => T y) hzero
        change (finiteFamily b e N i).adjoint (finiteFamily b e N j y) = 0 at h
        rw [h, inner_zero_right]
  · intro x _
    apply (Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _)
    have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[𝕜] H => T x) (finiteFamily_relations b e N).2
    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin N,
        finiteFamily b e N i (star (finiteFamily b e N i) x)) = x := by
      simpa only [_root_.sum_apply, mul_apply_eq_comp, one_apply_eq_self] using h
    rw [← hsum]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i
      ⟨star (finiteFamily b e N i) x, rfl⟩

/-- The actual positive finite Hilbert amplification, with the stock finite l² norm. -/
def finiteAmplification (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H) (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin N => H) ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] H :=
  (lpPiLpₗᵢ (fun _ : Fin N => H) 𝕜 (p := 2)).symm.trans
    (finiteFamily_isHilbertSum b e N).linearIsometryEquiv.symm

/-- Amplification is the literal finite ordered sum of the computed operators. -/
theorem finiteAmplification_apply (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 H)
    (e : (Fin 2 × ι) ≃ ι) (N : ℕ+) (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin N => H)) :
    finiteAmplification b e N x = ∑ i : Fin N, finiteFamily b e N i (x i) := by
  change (finiteFamily_isHilbertSum b e N).linearIsometryEquiv.symm
    ((lpPiLpₗᵢ (fun _ : Fin N => H) 𝕜 (p := 2)).symm x) = _
  rw [IsHilbertSum.linearIsometryEquiv_symm_apply, tsum_fintype]
  rfl

end HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.OperatorUltraweak.Topology
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Subalgebra.Lattice

/-!
# Infimum algebra for the actual operator ultraweak topology

The raw algebra is the infimum of all ultraweak closed subalgebras
containing the actual operator set. No algebra-existence or trace-dual
output is chosen. Containment, closedness, and leastness follow from the
actual infimum. Original source comparison theorems remain terminal statements.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
namespace OperatorUltraweak

/-- The actual infimum of ultraweak closed subalgebras containing the original operator set. -/
def algebraGenerated {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Subalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  sInf {A : Subalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) | S ⊆ (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∧
    IsClosedSet (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))}

/-- Every original generator belongs to the actual generated algebra. -/
theorem subset_algebraGenerated {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : S ⊆ (algebraGenerated S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  intro T hT
  exact Algebra.mem_sInf.mpr fun A hA => hA.1 hT

/-- The actual generated algebra is closed in the coefficient-induced ultraweak topology. -/
theorem isClosedSet_algebraGenerated {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : IsClosedSet (algebraGenerated S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  let : TopologicalSpace (H →L[ℂ] H) := topology H
  change IsClosed (algebraGenerated S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  rw [algebraGenerated, Algebra.coe_sInf]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun A => isClosed_iInter fun hA => hA.2

/-- Any ultraweak closed algebra containing the generators contains the generated algebra. -/
theorem algebraGenerated_le {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) (A : Subalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hS : S ⊆ (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) (hA : IsClosedSet (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) :
    algebraGenerated S ≤ A :=
  sInf_le ⟨hS, hA⟩

end OperatorUltraweak

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpHolder
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.LinearMap

/-!
# Actual square-summable rank-one operator coefficients

The two original square-summable vector sequences define the actual
absolutely convergent sum of matrix coefficients. Diagonal operator action
on l-two and its computed norm bound make that sum a bounded complex-linear
functional of the actual operator. No trace-class duality, topology model,
norm certificate, nontriviality or separability input is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OperatorUltraweak
universe u
variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- Actual square-summable vector sequences, including the zero Hilbert space. -/
abbrev VectorSequence (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] := lp (fun _ : ℕ => H) 2

/-- The actual bounded operator acts on every source vector coordinate. -/
def diagonal (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : VectorSequence H →L[ℂ] VectorSequence H :=
  lp.mapCLM 2 (fun _ : ℕ => T) (norm_nonneg T) (fun _ => le_rfl)

/-- The diagonal operator has exactly the actual original coordinate values. -/
theorem diagonal_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (x : VectorSequence H) (n : ℕ) :
    diagonal T x n = T (x n) := rfl

/-- The diagonal action has the source operator's genuine norm bound. -/
theorem diagonal_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : ‖diagonal T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ :=
  lp.norm_mapCLM_le 2 (fun _ : ℕ => T) (norm_nonneg T) (fun _ => le_rfl)

/-- Coordinate action on a fixed square-summable source vector is additive in the actual operator. -/
theorem action_add (x : VectorSequence H) (T U : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    diagonal (T + U) x = diagonal T x + diagonal U x := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change (T + U) (x n) = T (x n) + U (x n)
  rfl

/-- Coordinate action preserves the actual complex scalar action on operators. -/
theorem action_smul (x : VectorSequence H) (c : ℂ) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    diagonal (c • T) x = c • diagonal T x := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext n
  change (c • T) (x n) = c • T (x n)
  rfl

/-- The fixed-sequence operator action has its computed finite norm bound. -/
theorem action_norm_le (x : VectorSequence H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖diagonal T x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖T‖ := by
  have h := ((diagonal T).le_opNorm x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (diagonal_norm_le T) (norm_nonneg x))
  exact h.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

/-- The actual complex-linear map from bounded operators to their action on one source l-two vector. -/
def action (x : VectorSequence H) : (H →L[ℂ] H) →L[ℂ] VectorSequence H :=
  ({ toFun := fun T => diagonal T x
     map_add' := action_add x
     map_smul' := action_smul x } : (H →L[ℂ] H) →ₗ[ℂ] VectorSequence H).mkContinuous
    ‖x‖ (action_norm_le x)

/-- The bounded action map retains every actual source coordinate. -/
theorem action_apply (x : VectorSequence H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (n : ℕ) :
    action x T n = T (x n) := rfl

/-- The original rank-one coefficient sum is an actual bounded complex-linear operator functional. -/
def coefficient (x y : VectorSequence H) : (H →L[ℂ] H) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  (innerSL ℂ y).comp (action x)

/-- The actual infinite matrix-coefficient series is summable, rather than a chosen trace model. -/
theorem coefficient_summable (x y : VectorSequence H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ⟪y n, T (x n)⟫_ℂ) := by
  simpa only [diagonal_apply] using (lp.summable_inner y (diagonal T x))

/-- The actual bounded functional equals the full original rank-one matrix-coefficient series. -/
theorem coefficient_apply (x y : VectorSequence H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    coefficient x y T = ∑' n : ℕ, ⟪y n, T (x n)⟫_ℂ := by
  change ⟪y, diagonal T x⟫_ℂ = _
  exact (lp.inner_eq_tsum y (diagonal T x)).trans (tsum_congr (fun n => rfl))

/-- The infinite-sum coefficient has the genuine finite source norm bound. -/
theorem coefficient_bound (x y : VectorSequence H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖coefficient x y T‖ ≤ ‖y‖ * ‖x‖ * ‖T‖ := by
  change ‖⟪y, diagonal T x⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ _
  exact (norm_inner_le_norm y (diagonal T x)).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (action_norm_le x T) (norm_nonneg y)).trans_eq (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm)

end OperatorUltraweak

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.OperatorUltraweak.Coefficients
public import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions

/-!
# Actual initial operator ultraweak topology

All actual square-summable rank-one coefficient functionals define the
initial topology on bounded operators. Each coefficient is a genuine
convergent bounded complex-linear functional from the previous owner.
This definition uses every such vector pair, including zero and
nonseparable Hilbert spaces. It does not substitute WOT or choose an
unproved trace-dual equivalence. Source least-closed algebra and rational
closure comparison assertions remain whole terminal statements.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open scoped Topology
namespace OperatorUltraweak
universe u v
variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

/-- Actual evaluation of every original square-summable rank-one coefficient on an operator. -/
def evaluation (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : (VectorSequence H × VectorSequence H) → ℂ :=
  fun p => coefficient p.1 p.2 T

/-- Full actual infinite-series value of the coefficient evaluation map. -/
theorem evaluation_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (x y : VectorSequence H) :
    evaluation T (x, y) = ∑' n : ℕ, inner ℂ (y n) (T (x n)) := coefficient_apply x y T

/-- The actual initial topology induced by all square-summable rank-one operator coefficients. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def topology (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] :
    TopologicalSpace (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  TopologicalSpace.induced (evaluation (H := H)) inferInstance

/-- Actual ultraweak closedness, retaining the original raw bounded-operator carrier. -/
def IsClosedSet (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop :=
  @IsClosed (H →L[ℂ] H) (topology H) S

/-- Actual source ultraweak convergence, with every source filter and limit kept explicit. -/
def Tendsto {I : Type*} (T : I → (H →L[ℂ] H)) (l : Filter I) (U : H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto T l (@nhds (H →L[ℂ] H) (topology H) U)

/-- Convergence in the actual ultraweak topology is equivalent to convergence
of every genuine square-summable coefficient, for every filter and limit. -/
theorem tendsto_iff {I : Type v} (T : I → H →L[ℂ] H) (l : Filter I) (U : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    OperatorUltraweak.Tendsto T l U ↔
      ∀ x y : VectorSequence H,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun i => coefficient x y (T i)) l (𝓝 (coefficient x y U)) := by
  rw [OperatorUltraweak.Tendsto, topology, nhds_induced,
    Filter.tendsto_comap_iff, tendsto_pi_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact h (x, y)
  · intro h p
    exact h p.1 p.2

/-- Every fixed actual coefficient evaluation is continuous for the defining
ultraweak topology, without any complete-space or trace-dual assumption. -/
theorem continuous_coefficient (x y : VectorSequence H) :
    @Continuous (H →L[ℂ] H) ℂ (topology H) inferInstance (coefficient x y) := by
  letI : TopologicalSpace (H →L[ℂ] H) := topology H
  have he : Continuous (evaluation (H := H)) := continuous_induced_dom
  exact (continuous_apply (x, y)).comp he

/-- Actual closure in the initial ultraweak topology, without a selected closed-subalgebra model. -/
def closure (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  @_root_.closure (H →L[ℂ] H) (topology H) S

end OperatorUltraweak

/-
  Author: @toskua
-/

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Projection
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Positive
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Submodule
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.Basic

import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.StarProjection.FiniteSum

/-!
# Projection-valued measures on Hilbert spaces

A projection-valued measure (`ProjectionValuedMeasure`) assigns an orthogonal
projection to every measurable set, sends the empty set to zero and the whole
space to one, turns intersections into products, and is countably additive in
the strong operator topology.  Strong additivity is represented directly by
pointwise norm-convergent `HasSum` statements.

The bundle is defined on all sets, following Mathlib's `VectorMeasure`
convention that nonmeasurable sets are canonically sent to zero.  It does not
extend `VectorMeasure X (H →L[ℂ] H)`, since that would incorrectly require
operator-norm countable additivity.  For a fixed vector `h`, however,
`E.applyVectorMeasure h` is a genuine `H`-valued vector measure; this derived
adapter lets the ordinary finite-union and complement API be reused without
strengthening the PVM laws.

The basic API uses Mathlib's canonical `IsStarProjection`.  It includes
measurable-set extensionality, projection/order/complement laws, disjoint
orthogonality and finite additivity, and the strong-sum semantics of a
countable orthogonal family of projections.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProduct InnerProductSpace Topology

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {X : Type u} {H : Type v}
variable [MeasurableSpace X]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- A projection-valued measure with pointwise-norm (strong-operator)
countable additivity. Nonmeasurable sets are canonically assigned zero. -/
@[ext]
structure ProjectionValuedMeasure (X : Type u) (H : Type v)
    [MeasurableSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] where
  /-- The projection assigned to a set. -/
  toFun : Set X → H →L[ℂ] H
  /-- Nonmeasurable sets are assigned zero. -/
  not_measurable' : ∀ {s : Set X}, ¬ MeasurableSet s → toFun s = 0
  /-- Every measurable value is an orthogonal projection. -/
  projection' : ∀ s : Set X, MeasurableSet s → IsStarProjection (toFun s)
  /-- The empty set is assigned zero. -/
  empty' : toFun ∅ = 0
  /-- The whole space is assigned the identity. -/
  univ' : toFun Set.univ = 1
  /-- Intersections are sent to products. -/
  inter' : ∀ s : Set X, MeasurableSet s → ∀ t : Set X, MeasurableSet t →
    toFun (s ∩ t) = toFun s * toFun t
  /-- Countable additivity in the strong operator topology. -/
  m_iUnion' : ∀ (s : ℕ → Set X), (∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) →
    (Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (s i) (s j)) → ∀ h : H,
      HasSum (fun n ↦ toFun (s n) h) (toFun (⋃ n, s n) h)

namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

instance : CoeFun (ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (fun _ ↦ Set X → H →L[ℂ] H) where
  coe E := E.toFun

@[simp]
theorem not_measurable (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s : Set X}
    (hs : ¬ MeasurableSet s) : E s = 0 :=
  E.not_measurable' hs

/-- Every value of a PVM is a star projection; a nonmeasurable set has value
zero. -/
theorem isStarProjection (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : Set X) :
    IsStarProjection (E s) := by
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · exact E.projection' s hs
  · rw [E.not_measurable hs]
    exact IsStarProjection.zero _

theorem projection (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : Set X)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : IsStarProjection (E s) :=
  E.projection' s hs

@[simp]
theorem empty (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) : E ∅ = 0 :=
  E.empty'

@[simp]
theorem univ (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) : E Set.univ = 1 :=
  E.univ'

theorem inter (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (t : Set X) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    E (s ∩ t) = E s * E t :=
  E.inter' s hs t ht

theorem m_iUnion (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : ℕ → Set X)
    (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n))
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (s i) (s j)) (h : H) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ E (s n) h) (E (⋃ n, s n) h) :=
  E.m_iUnion' s hs hdisj h

/-- Two PVMs agreeing on measurable sets are equal. -/
theorem ext_measurable {E F : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H}
    (h : ∀ s : Set X, MeasurableSet s → E s = F s) : E = F := by
  apply ProjectionValuedMeasure.ext
  funext s
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · exact h s hs
  · rw [E.not_measurable hs, F.not_measurable hs]

/-- Evaluation of a PVM on one vector is an ordinary vector measure. This is
a derived pointwise adapter, not an operator-valued vector measure. -/
def applyVectorMeasure (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (h : H) :
    VectorMeasure X H where
  measureOf' s := E s h
  empty' := by simp
  not_measurable' := by
    intro s hs
    rw [E.not_measurable hs]
    rfl
  m_iUnion' := by
    intro s hs hdisj
    exact E.m_iUnion s hs hdisj h

@[simp]
theorem applyVectorMeasure_apply (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (h : H) (s : Set X) :
    E.applyVectorMeasure h s = E s h :=
  rfl

/-- A PVM is finitely additive on disjoint measurable sets. -/
theorem union (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s t : Set X}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hdisj : Disjoint s t) :
    E (s ∪ t) = E s + E t := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  exact (E.applyVectorMeasure h).of_union hdisj hs ht

/-- The projection of a measurable complement is `1 - E s`. -/
theorem compl (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    E sᶜ = 1 - E s := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  simpa only [applyVectorMeasure_apply, E.univ, one_apply_eq_self, sub_apply] using
    (VectorMeasure.of_compl (v := E.applyVectorMeasure h) hs)

/-- Projections of disjoint measurable sets multiply to zero. -/
theorem mul_eq_zero_of_disjoint (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s t : Set X}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hdisj : Disjoint s t) :
    E s * E t = 0 := by
  rw [← E.inter s hs t ht, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hdisj, E.empty]

/-- Projections of disjoint measurable sets have orthogonal images. -/
theorem inner_apply_eq_zero_of_disjoint (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s t : Set X}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hdisj : Disjoint s t)
    (x y : H) :
    ⟪E s x, E t y⟫_ℂ = 0 := by
  calc
    ⟪E s x, E t y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, ((E s)†) (E t y)⟫_ℂ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (E s) x (E t y)).symm
    _ = ⟪x, (E s * E t) y⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
        (E.projection s hs).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]
      rfl
    _ = 0 := by rw [E.mul_eq_zero_of_disjoint hs ht hdisj]; simp

/-- The PVM is monotone on measurable sets in the canonical projection order. -/
theorem mono (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {s t : Set X}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    E s ≤ E t := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.le_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsPositive.of_isStarProjection
  apply (E.projection s hs).sub_of_mul_eq_left (E.projection t ht)
  rw [← E.inter s hs t ht, Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hst]

/-- A finite union of pairwise-disjoint measurable sets is sent to the finite
sum of its projections. -/
theorem biUnion_finset (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {I : Type*}
    (u : Finset I) (s : I → Set X)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ u, MeasurableSet (s i))
    (hdisj : (u : Set I).PairwiseDisjoint s) :
    E (⋃ i ∈ u, s i) = ∑ i ∈ u, E (s i) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  calc
    E (⋃ i ∈ u, s i) h = ∑ i ∈ u, E (s i) h :=
      (E.applyVectorMeasure h).of_biUnion_finset hdisj hs
    _ = (∑ i ∈ u, E (s i)) h := by simp

/-- The point-mass PVM at `x`: a measurable set containing `x` is assigned
the identity projection and every other set is assigned zero. -/
noncomputable def dirac (x : X) : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H := by
  classical
  refine
    { toFun := fun s ↦ if MeasurableSet s then if x ∈ s then 1 else 0 else 0
      not_measurable' := ?_
      projection' := ?_
      empty' := by simp
      univ' := by simp
      inter' := ?_
      m_iUnion' := ?_ }
  · intro s hs
    simp [hs]
  · intro s hs
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · simp [hs, hxs, IsStarProjection.one]
    · simp [hs, hxs, IsStarProjection.zero]
  · intro s hs t ht
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> by_cases hxt : x ∈ t <;>
      simp [hs, ht, hxs, hxt]
  · intro s hs hdisj h
    have hu : MeasurableSet (⋃ n, s n) := MeasurableSet.iUnion hs
    by_cases hx : ∃ k, x ∈ s k
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx
      have hmem (n : ℕ) : x ∈ s n ↔ n = k := by
        constructor
        · intro hn
          by_contra hnk
          exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj hnk) hn hk
        · intro hnk
          simpa [hnk] using hk
      have hxu : x ∈ ⋃ n, s n := Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem k hk
      simp_rw [hs, ite_true, hmem]
      have hop (n : ℕ) :
          (if n = k then (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) else 0) h = if n = k then h else 0 := by
        split_ifs <;> simp
      simp_rw [hop]
      simpa [hu, hxu] using (hasSum_ite_eq k h)
    · have hn (n : ℕ) : x ∉ s n := fun hxn ↦ hx ⟨n, hxn⟩
      have hnu : x ∉ ⋃ n, s n := by simp [hn]
      simp [hs, hu, hn, hnu, zero_apply]

@[simp]
theorem dirac_apply_of_mem (x : X) {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hxs : x ∈ s) :
    dirac (H := H) x s = 1 := by
  simp [dirac, hs, hxs]

@[simp]
theorem dirac_apply_of_not_mem (x : X) {s : Set X} (hxs : x ∉ s) :
    dirac (H := H) x s = 0 := by
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s <;> simp [dirac, hs, hxs]

/-! ## Strong sums of orthogonal projections -/

private def projectionPartialSum (P : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H) (u : Finset ℕ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  ∑ i ∈ u, P i

private theorem projectionPartialSum_isStarProjection
    (P : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : ∀ i, IsStarProjection (P i))
    (horth : Pairwise fun i j ↦ P i * P j = 0) (u : Finset ℕ) :
    IsStarProjection (projectionPartialSum P u) := by
  change IsStarProjection (∑ i ∈ u, P i)
  exact IsStarProjection.finset_sum_of_pairwise_mul_eq_zero u P
    (fun i _ => hP i) (fun i _ j _ hij => horth hij)

private theorem projectionPartialSum_mul_of_subset
    (P : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : ∀ i, IsStarProjection (P i))
    (horth : Pairwise fun i j ↦ P i * P j = 0)
    {u v : Finset ℕ} (huv : u ⊆ v) :
    projectionPartialSum P v * projectionPartialSum P u = projectionPartialSum P u := by
  classical
  rw [projectionPartialSum, projectionPartialSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · exact (hP i).isIdempotentElem.eq
  · intro j hj hji
    exact horth hji
  · intro hin
    exact (hin (huv hi)).elim

/-- Conway IX.1.5: a countable pairwise-orthogonal family of projections sums
strongly to the projection onto the closed supremum of their ranges. -/
theorem exists_hasSum_of_pairwise_orthogonal
    (P : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : ∀ i, IsStarProjection (P i))
    (horth : Pairwise fun i j ↦ P i * P j = 0) :
    ∃ Q : H →L[ℂ] H, IsStarProjection Q ∧
      (∀ h : H, HasSum (fun i ↦ P i h) (Q h)) ∧
      LinearMap.range Q.toLinearMap =
        (⨆ i, LinearMap.range (P i).toLinearMap).topologicalClosure := by
  classical
  let R : Finset ℕ → Submodule ℂ H := fun u ↦
    LinearMap.range (projectionPartialSum P u).toLinearMap
  have hQ (u : Finset ℕ) : IsStarProjection (projectionPartialSum P u) :=
    projectionPartialSum_isStarProjection P hP horth u
  have projectionPartialSum_apply (u : Finset ℕ) (x : H) :
      projectionPartialSum P u x = ∑ i ∈ u, P i x := by
    change ((↑(∑ i ∈ u, P i) : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) x) = ∑ i ∈ u, P i x
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
  have projectionPartialSum_toLinearMap_apply (u : Finset ℕ) (x : H) :
      (projectionPartialSum P u).toLinearMap x = ∑ i ∈ u, P i x :=
    projectionPartialSum_apply u x
  let hR (u : Finset ℕ) : (R u).HasOrthogonalProjection := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.hasOrthogonalProjection_range
      (hQ u).isIdempotentElem
  have hprojection (u : Finset ℕ) :
      (R u).starProjection = projectionPartialSum P u := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsStarProjection.ext (isStarProjection_starProjection) (hQ u)
    rw [Submodule.range_starProjection]
  have hRmono : Monotone R := by
    intro u v huv
    rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨projectionPartialSum P u x, ?_⟩
    have hmul := projectionPartialSum_mul_of_subset P hP horth huv
    change projectionPartialSum P v (projectionPartialSum P u x) = projectionPartialSum P u x
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, hmul]
  have hRsup : ⨆ u, R u = ⨆ i, LinearMap.range (P i).toLinearMap := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup_le ?_
      intro u
      rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [projectionPartialSum_toLinearMap_apply]
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i hi
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x)
    · refine iSup_le ?_
      intro i y hy
      apply Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ({i} : Finset ℕ)
      simpa only [R, projectionPartialSum, Finset.sum_singleton] using hy
  let U : Submodule ℂ H :=
    (⨆ i, LinearMap.range (P i).toLinearMap).topologicalClosure
  let : CompleteSpace U := by
    dsimp only [U]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure.completeSpace _
  let : U.HasOrthogonalProjection := by
    infer_instance
  let Q : H →L[ℂ] H := U.starProjection
  refine ⟨Q, isStarProjection_starProjection, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have ht := Submodule.starProjection_tendsto_closure_iSup R hRmono h
    rw [hRsup] at ht
    simp_rw [hprojection, projectionPartialSum_apply] at ht
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun u : Finset ℕ ↦ ∑ i ∈ u, P i h) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Q h))
    simpa only [Q, U] using ht
  · exact Submodule.range_starProjection U

end ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureSesquilinearity
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureDiagonal
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Real
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-!
# Computed normal-CFC coefficient form and its Cauchy--Schwarz bound

Only the actual normal T,hT, original vectors and measurable set are inputs.
Sesquilinearity and the same computed positive diagonal Riesz measure supply
the form, Hermitian symmetry and positivity. The stock Core Cauchy--Schwarz
lemma is used with an explicit structure value; no Core norm/space instance
is installed and the original H norm remains fixed. These strict facts serve
the bounded coefficient operator E(s), resolutionOfIdentity and BFC DATA.
No provided form/positivity/bound/PVM or desired-output premise is introduced.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual coefficient form: first argument h is conjugate-linear;
second argument g is linear, with value mu(g,h)(s). -/
def normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) : H →ₗ⋆[ℂ] H →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun h :=
    { toFun g := (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s
      map_add' := by
        intro g₁ g₂
        rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_add_left]
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c g
        rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_smul_left]
        rfl }
  map_add' := by
    intro h₁ h₂
    ext g
    change (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (h₁ + h₂) : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s = _
    rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_add_right]
    rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro c h
    ext g
    change (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (c • h) : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s =
      star c • (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s
    rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_smul_right]
    rfl

/-- Every form value is the same computed regular complex coefficient value. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (h g : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s h g =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s := rfl

private theorem coefficient_diagonal_im_zero (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (x : H) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s x x).im = 0 := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply, normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply T hT x s hs]
  exact Complex.ofReal_im _

private theorem coefficient_form_hermitian (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (x y : H) :
    star (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s y x) =
      normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s x y := by
  let L := normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s
  have hx : (L x x).im = 0 := coefficient_diagonal_im_zero T hT s hs x
  have hy : (L y y).im = 0 := coefficient_diagonal_im_zero T hT s hs y
  have hadd : L (x + y) (x + y) = L x x + L x y + L y x + L y y := by
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    ring
  have hphase : L (x + Complex.I • y) (x + Complex.I • y) =
      L x x + Complex.I * L x y - Complex.I * L y x + L y y := by
    have hleft (a b z : H) : L (a + b) z = L a z + L b z :=
      congrArg (fun f : H →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ => f z) (L.map_add a b)
    have hright (z a b : H) : L z (a + b) = L z a + L z b := (L z).map_add a b
    have hsmulLeft (c : ℂ) (a z : H) : L (c • a) z = star c * L a z := by
      have heq := congrArg (fun f : H →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ => f z) (L.map_smulₛₗ c a)
      simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply, starRingEnd_apply, smul_eq_mul] using heq
    have hsmulRight (c : ℂ) (z a : H) : L z (c • a) = c * L z a := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using (L z).map_smul c a
    rw [hleft, hright, hright, hsmulRight, hsmulLeft, hsmulRight, hsmulLeft]
    simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_I]
    ring_nf
    rw [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  have him := coefficient_diagonal_im_zero T hT s hs (x + y)
  change (L (x + y) (x + y)).im = 0 at him
  rw [hadd] at him
  simp only [Complex.add_im, hx, hy, zero_add, add_zero] at him
  have hre := coefficient_diagonal_im_zero T hT s hs (x + Complex.I • y)
  change (L (x + Complex.I • y) (x + Complex.I • y)).im = 0 at hre
  rw [hphase] at hre
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
    zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add, add_zero, hx, hy] at hre
  change star (L y x) = L x y
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re]
    linarith
  · simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im]
    linarith

/-- The same actual measurable coefficient values satisfy Hermitian symmetry. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_conj_symm (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s =
      star ((normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT h g : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s) := by
  exact (coefficient_form_hermitian T hT s hs h g).symm

private theorem coefficient_diagonal_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (x : H) :
    0 ≤ (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s x x).re := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply, normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply T hT x s hs]
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using
    (measureReal_nonneg (μ := normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT x) (s := s))

/-- Cauchy--Schwarz for the actual computed coefficient measure, using
the same positive diagonal masses on the measurable set. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cauchySchwarz (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ‖(normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real s * (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT h).real s := by
  let L := normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s
  let core : PreInnerProductSpace.Core ℂ H :=
    { inner := fun x y => L x y
      conj_inner_symm x y := coefficient_form_hermitian T hT s hs x y
      re_inner_nonneg x := coefficient_diagonal_nonneg T hT s hs x
      add_left x y z := by
        change L (x + y) z = L x z + L y z
        rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      smul_left x y c := by
        change L (c • x) y = star c * L x y
        rw [map_smulₛₗ, LinearMap.smul_apply]
        rfl }
  have hcs := @_root_.InnerProductSpace.Core.inner_mul_inner_self_le ℂ H _ _ _ core h g
  change ‖L h g‖ * ‖L g h‖ ≤ (L h h).re * (L g g).re at hcs
  have hnorm : ‖L g h‖ = ‖L h g‖ := by
    rw [← norm_star (L g h)]
    exact congrArg norm (coefficient_form_hermitian T hT s hs h g)
  rw [hnorm] at hcs
  simpa only [L, normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply T hT h s hs,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply T hT g s hs,
    Complex.ofReal_re, pow_two, mul_comm] using hcs

/-- The actual positive diagonal set mass is bounded by its original full mass. -/
private theorem diagonal_mass_le_norm_sq (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) :
    (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real s ≤ ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
  calc
    (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real s ≤
        (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real univ :=
      measureReal_mono (μ := normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g) (subset_univ s)
        (measure_ne_top (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g) univ)
    _ = ‖g‖ ^ 2 := normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_real_univ T hT g

/-- The exact coefficient operator bound from the same computed measures
and original Hilbert norms, with no supplied bound or form. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_norm_apply_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ‖(normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖h‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg g) (norm_nonneg h))).mp
  calc
    ‖(normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real s * (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT h).real s :=
      normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cauchySchwarz T hT g h s hs
    _ ≤ ‖g‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul (diagonal_mass_le_norm_sq T hT g s) (diagonal_mass_le_norm_sq T hT h s)
        (measureReal_nonneg (μ := normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT h) (s := s)) (sq_nonneg ‖g‖)
    _ = (‖g‖ * ‖h‖) ^ 2 := by ring

/-- Constant-one form bound in the exact orientation needed by mkContinuous₂. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_norm_apply_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (h g : H) :
    ‖normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s h g‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) * ‖h‖ * ‖g‖ := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply]
  have hbound := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_norm_apply_le T hT g h s hs
  calc
    ‖(normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s‖ ≤
        ‖g‖ * ‖h‖ := hbound
    _ = (1 : ℝ) * ‖h‖ * ‖g‖ := by ring

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.Complex

/-!
# Strict scalar Riesz coefficients of the actual normal-operator CFC

These defining values serve the missing canonical normal-operator PVM
constructor required by Murphy resolutionOfIdentity. The coefficient
functional is built from the actual continuous functional calculus, ordinary
operator evaluation and innerSL; the representing regular complex measure
comes from the existing strict complex Riesz map. No spectral PVM, correctness
certificate, chosen representation or terminal source theorem is an input.
This module constructs scalar coefficients only; projection/intersection and
strong countable-additivity proofs are still required to bundle a PVM.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original normal CFC matrix-coefficient functional, with the same
orientation as scalarMeasure g h: f maps to inner h ((cfcHom hT f) g). -/
def normalCFCCoefficientFunctional (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H) :
    C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  (innerSL ℂ h).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H g).comp
    { toLinearMap := (cfcHom (R := ℂ) hT).toAlgHom.toLinearMap
      cont := cfcHom_continuous (R := ℂ) hT })

/-- The coefficient uses the actual stock CFC and original Hilbert inner product. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g h f = ⟪h, cfcHom hT f g⟫_ℂ := rfl

/-- The existing strict complex-Riesz constructor supplies the actual regular
measure of this same CFC coefficient; it is not yet a projection-valued measure. -/
def normalCFCCoefficientMeasure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H) :
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.RegularComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T) :=
  MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexRieszMeasure (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g h)

/-- The original regular coefficient measure represents every continuous CFC value. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h) f =
      ⟪h, cfcHom hT f g⟫_ℂ := by
  have hRiesz := MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure
    (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g h)
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℂ C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ) => L f) hRiesz
  change MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h) f =
    normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g h f at hvalue
  exact hvalue.trans (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply T hT g h f)

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureCoefficients

/-!
# Actual continuous-CFC product identities for the regular coefficient measures

These strict identities serve the PVM intersection/projection construction
required by resolutionOfIdentity and Borel defining DATA. The continuous
integrands and original vectors are actual inputs; only cfcHom multiplication,
star and the existing adjoint identity are used. The actual regular measures
are identified by strict complex-Riesz uniqueness. No supplied PVM, weighted-
measure correctness, bound, form or output certificate is assumed. The
original complete H and normal T are retained, including zero H/empty spectrum.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Acting on the first vector by the actual continuous CFC multiplies the continuous integrand. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_mul_left (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT f g) h) q =
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h) (q * f) := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents, normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents, map_mul]
  rfl

/-- The original CFC star moves the continuous factor to the second coefficient vector. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_star_mul_right (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (cfcHom hT (star f) h)) q =
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h) (q * f) := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents, normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents, map_star]
  change ⟪(cfcHom hT f).adjoint h, cfcHom hT q g⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪h, cfcHom hT (q * f) g⟫_ℂ
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, mul_comm q f, map_mul]
  rfl

/-- Acting on the second vector inserts the conjugate continuous integrand. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_mul_right (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (cfcHom hT f h)) q =
    MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h) (q * star f) := by
  simpa only [star_star] using
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_star_mul_right T hT g h (star f) q

/-- Riesz uniqueness gives equality of the same actual regular complex coefficient measures. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_balance (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT f g) h =
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (cfcHom hT (star f) h) := by
  apply MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_injective
  ext q
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_mul_left, normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_star_mul_right]

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureCoefficients
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.CompactReal
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Positive
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

/-!
# Positive diagonal measures of the actual normal CFC coefficients

The actual normal T and original vector g determine a positive finite regular
measure on the original spectrum. Its complexification is the same strict
complex-Riesz diagonal coefficient, and its mass is the original squared
Hilbert norm. These facts serve the missing canonical PVM/resolutionOfIdentity
constructor and BFC DATA; no positivity, mass, regularity, representation or
PVM/output certificate is an input. The numbered source spectral proofs stay open.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace ENNReal

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The real restriction of the actual original diagonal CFC functional. -/
def normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    StrongDual ℝ C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ) :=
  complexDualRealRestriction (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g g)

/-- It is the real part of the same original CFC coefficient. -/
theorem normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) :
    normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g f =
      (⟪g, cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f) g⟫_ℂ).re := rfl

private theorem real_cfc_isSelfAdjoint (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) : IsSelfAdjoint (cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f)) := by
  have hs : star (realContinuousMapCLM f) = realContinuousMapCLM f := by
    ext x
    simp only [ContinuousMap.star_apply, realContinuousMapCLM_apply, Complex.star_def,
      Complex.conj_ofReal]
  change star (cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f)) = cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f)
  rw [← map_star, hs]

/-- A real-valued continuous input gives a real diagonal coefficient. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_diagonal_im_eq_zero (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g g (realContinuousMapCLM f)).im = 0 := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply]
  simpa only [RCLike.im_eq_complex_im, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe] using
    (real_cfc_isSelfAdjoint T hT f).isSymmetric.im_inner_self_apply g

private theorem real_cfc_isPositive (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    (cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f)).IsPositive := by
  let r : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ) := ⟨fun x => Real.sqrt (f x), Real.continuous_sqrt.comp f.continuous⟩
  let q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ) := realContinuousMapCLM r
  have hfactor : star q * q = realContinuousMapCLM f := by
    ext x
    simp only [q, ContinuousMap.mul_apply, ContinuousMap.star_apply, realContinuousMapCLM_apply]
    change star (Real.sqrt (f x) : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt (f x) : ℂ) = (f x : ℂ)
    have hr : star (Real.sqrt (f x) : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt (f x) : ℂ) := by simp
    rw [hr, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    exact congrArg Complex.ofReal (Real.mul_self_sqrt (ContinuousMap.le_def.mp hf x))
  let Q : H →L[ℂ] H := cfcHom hT q
  have hQ : (star Q * Q).IsPositive := by
    change (Q.adjoint.comp Q).IsPositive
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_adjoint_comp_self Q
  have heq : cfcHom hT (realContinuousMapCLM f) = star Q * Q := by
    rw [← hfactor, map_mul, map_star]
  rw [heq]
  exact hQ

/-- Positivity follows from the actual CFC square-root factor and Gram positivity. -/
theorem normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    0 ≤ normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g f := by
  rw [normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional_apply]
  simpa only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using
    (real_cfc_isPositive T hT f hf).re_inner_nonneg_right g

/-- The actual positive compact-real functional, with proved order compatibility. -/
def normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ where
  toPositiveLinearMap :=
    { toLinearMap := (normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g).toLinearMap
      monotone' := by
        intro f k hfk
        have h := normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional_nonneg T hT g (k - f) (sub_nonneg.mpr hfk)
        rw [map_sub] at h
        exact sub_nonneg.mp h }
  cont := (normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g).cont

/-- Its value is still the original real diagonal coefficient. -/
theorem normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) :
    normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional T hT g f = normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g f := rfl

/-- Positive compact-real Riesz representation computes the original diagonal measure. -/
def normalCFCDiagonalMeasure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    Measure (spectrum ℂ T) :=
  continuousRieszMeasure (normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional T hT g)

/-- This exact positive Riesz measure is finite. -/
instance normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_finite (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g) :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_finite (normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional T hT g)

/-- This exact positive Riesz measure is regular. -/
instance normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_regular (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).Regular :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_regular (normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional T hT g)

/-- The positive measure represents every original continuous real diagonal value. -/
theorem normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_represents (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂(normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g) = normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g f :=
  integral_continuousRieszMeasure (normalCFCDiagonalPositiveFunctional T hT g) f

/-- The mass is the original squared vector norm, including zero H/empty spectrum. -/
theorem normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_real_univ (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    (normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real univ = ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [normalCFCDiagonalMeasure, continuousRieszMeasure_real_univ]
  change normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g 1 = ‖g‖ ^ 2
  rw [normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional_apply]
  have h1 : realContinuousMapCLM (1 : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℝ)) = 1 := by
    ext x
    simp only [realContinuousMapCLM_apply, ContinuousMap.one_apply, Complex.ofReal_one]
  rw [h1, map_one]
  simpa only [_root_.one_apply_eq_self, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] using
    inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) g

private def diagonalRegularSignedMeasure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    RegularSignedMeasure (spectrum ℂ T) :=
  ⟨(normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).toSignedMeasure, by
    change (((normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).toSignedMeasure).totalVariation).Regular
    rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation, Measure.variation_toSignedMeasure]
    exact normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_regular T hT g⟩

private theorem signed_diagonal_represents (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual (diagonalRegularSignedMeasure T hT g) =
      normalCFCDiagonalRealFunctional T hT g := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  rw [RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_apply]
  change (∫ᵛ x, f x ∂<•(normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).toSignedMeasure) = _
  rw [_root_.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure]
  exact normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_represents T hT g f

/-- The complex-Riesz diagonal is exactly the complexification of the computed positive measure. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g : H) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g g : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) =
      ((normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).toSignedMeasure).toComplexMeasure 0 := by
  let L := normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g g
  have hre : signedRieszMeasure (complexDualRealRestriction L) =
      diagonalRegularSignedMeasure T hT g :=
    signedRieszMeasure_unique _ _ (signed_diagonal_represents T hT g)
  have him : complexDualImagRestriction L = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    change (normalCFCCoefficientFunctional T hT g g (realContinuousMapCLM f)).im = 0
    exact normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_diagonal_im_eq_zero T hT g f
  have hz : signedRieszMeasure (complexDualImagRestriction L) = 0 := by
    rw [him]
    simpa only [signedIntegralEquiv_symm_apply] using
      (signedIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).symm.map_zero
  change SignedMeasure.toComplexMeasure
    (signedRieszMeasure (complexDualRealRestriction L) : SignedMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
    (signedRieszMeasure (complexDualImagRestriction L) : SignedMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) = _
  rw [hre, hz]
  rfl


/-- Every measurable diagonal coefficient value is the computed positive mass. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g g : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s =
      ((normalCFCDiagonalMeasure T hT g).real s : ℂ) := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal, SignedMeasure.toComplexMeasure_apply]
  simp only [Measure.toSignedMeasure_apply_measurable hs, _root_.zero_apply]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]

/-- The complex diagonal mass is the original squared vector norm. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_univ (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g g : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) univ =
      (‖g‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_diagonal_apply T hT g univ MeasurableSet.univ,
    normalCFCDiagonalMeasure_real_univ]

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.Complex

/-!
# Continuous indicator limits through the actual complex integral

This strict dominated-convergence bridge serves the computed coefficient
intersection/projection laws required by resolutionOfIdentity and Borel DATA.
The approximation inputs are ordinary continuous functions with their actual
pointwise bound and almost-everywhere limit. No operator, projector, PVM,
representation or correctness output is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped Topology
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uX

/-- A bounded continuous indicator approximation passes through every bounded
measurable multiplier and the original complex measure integral. -/
theorem continuousIndicator_complexIntegral_mul_tendsto {X : Type uX}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X) (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (F : ℕ → C(X, ℂ)) (hF : ∀ n x, ‖F n x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂mu.variation,
      Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) x)))
    (q : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    Tendsto (fun n => complexIntegral mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) * q))
      atTop (𝓝 (complexIntegral mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator s hs * q))) := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure mu.variation := ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation mu
  change Tendsto
    (fun n => ∫ᵛ x, (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) * q) x
      ∂[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ; mu]) atTop
    (𝓝 (∫ᵛ x, (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator s hs * q) x
      ∂[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ; mu]))
  apply _root_.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun _ => ‖q‖)
  · intro n
    exact (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) * q).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact integrable_const ‖q‖
  · intro n
    apply Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    change ‖F n x * q x‖ ≤ ‖q‖
    calc
      ‖F n x * q x‖ = ‖F n x‖ * ‖q x‖ := norm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖q‖ :=
        mul_le_mul (hF n x) (q.norm_apply_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg (q x)) zero_le_one
      _ = ‖q‖ := one_mul _
  · filter_upwards [hlim] with x hx
    change Tendsto (fun n => F n x * q x) atTop
      (𝓝 ((BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator s hs) x * q x))
    rw [BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator_apply]
    exact hx.mul_const (q x)

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
