module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureOperators
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureContinuousProducts

/-!
# Computed coefficient operators commute with the actual continuous CFC

The coefficient identity and actual regular-measure balancing identify both
matrix coefficients. The stock Hilbert adjoint identity moves the CFC star
back to the operator side. Nonmeasurable sets use the computed zero value.
This serves the projection/intersection fields of the resolutionOfIdentity
constructor and its Borel-functional-calculus DATA. No selfadjointness,
commutant, PVM or correctness premise is supplied; terminal source proofs
remain open. The original complete H and spectrum, including their zero and
empty cases, are unchanged.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Every computed coefficient operator commutes with every actual continuous CFC value. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_commute_cfc (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    Commute (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s) (cfcHom hT f) := by
  classical
  change normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s * cfcHom hT f =
    cfcHom hT f * normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro g
    apply ext_inner_left ℂ
    intro h
    change ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s (cfcHom hT f g)⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪h, cfcHom hT f (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g)⟫_ℂ
    calc
      ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s (cfcHom hT f g)⟫_ℂ =
          (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT f g) h :
            ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s :=
        normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs (cfcHom hT f g) h
      _ = (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (cfcHom hT (star f) h) :
            ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s :=
        congrArg (fun mu : MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.RegularComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T) =>
          (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s)
          (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_balance T hT g h f)
      _ = ⟪cfcHom hT (star f) h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g⟫_ℂ :=
        (normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs g (cfcHom hT (star f) h)).symm
      _ = ⟪h, cfcHom hT f (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g)⟫_ℂ := by
        rw [map_star]
        change ⟪(cfcHom hT f).adjoint h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g⟫_ℂ =
          ⟪h, cfcHom hT f (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g)⟫_ℂ
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (cfcHom hT f)
          (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g) h
  · rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable T hT s hs, zero_mul, mul_zero]

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureOperators
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureCoefficientBounds

/-!
# Actual coefficient operator: selfadjointness and empty/full normalization

These laws refer only to the exact computed normalCFCCoefficientOperator.
Coefficient Hermitian symmetry supplies selfadjointness. Actual complex
measure values at empty and one, together with CFCmap_one, identify the
empty/full operator values. They serve three required canonical PVM fields
and resolutionOfIdentity/BFC; no idempotence, intersection, strong additivity
or completed PVM is claimed. Numbered textbook theorem proofs remain open.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProductSpace ComplexConjugate
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original continuous unit evaluates the actual coefficient measure to inner h g. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_univ (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) univ = ⟪h, g⟫_ℂ := by
  let mu := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h
  have h1 : BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (1 : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) =
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst univ MeasurableSet.univ 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    funext x
    simp [BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap_apply,
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply]
  have hi : complexIntegralDual mu (1 : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) =
      (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) univ := by
    rw [complexIntegralDual_apply, h1, complexIntegral_indicatorConst, one_mul]
  have hr := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents T hT g h (1 : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ))
  change complexIntegralDual mu 1 = _ at hr
  rw [hi, map_one] at hr
  simpa only [one_apply_eq_self] using hr

/-- Every actual coefficient operator is selfadjoint, also for nonmeasurable sets. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_isSelfAdjoint (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) : IsSelfAdjoint (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s) := by
  classical
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
    intro x y
    calc
      ⟪normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s x, y⟫_ℂ =
          star ⟪y, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s x⟫_ℂ :=
        (inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s x) y).symm
      _ = star ((normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT x y : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s) := by
        rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs x y]
      _ = (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT y x : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s :=
        (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_conj_symm T hT y x s hs).symm
      _ = ⟪x, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s y⟫_ℂ :=
        (normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs y x).symm
  · rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable T hT s hs]
    exact IsSelfAdjoint.zero (H →L[ℂ] H)

/-- The actual empty measure gives the actual zero coefficient operator. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_empty (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) :
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT ∅ = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT ∅ MeasurableSet.empty g h,
    VectorMeasure.empty]
  simp

/-- The actual continuous-one coefficient measure gives identity on the original H. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_univ (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) :
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT univ = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT univ MeasurableSet.univ g h,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_univ]
  rfl

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureCoefficientBounds
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Dual
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear

/-!
# Actual bounded coefficient operators of a normal CFC

The original normal T and its computed complex coefficient measures determine
an operator on the same original H for every measurable spectrum set. The
norm bound comes from the proved coefficient Cauchy--Schwarz estimate, and
Hilbert Riesz representation gives its exact coefficient identity. All
nonmeasurable sets are zero. These objects serve resolutionOfIdentity/BFC;
projection, intersection and strong countable-additivity fields remain
separate required proofs. No PVM, form, bound or output certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProductSpace ComplexConjugate
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The same computed coefficient form, norm-bundled from its actual derived bound. -/
def normalCFCCoefficientBilin (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) : H →L⋆[ℂ] H →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s).mkContinuous₂ 1 (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_norm_apply_le T hT s hs)

/-- The continuous form has the original matrix coefficient, with anti-linear h first. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientBilin_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (h g : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs h g =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientBilin, LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_apply]

/-- The norm of the actual continuous coefficient form is at most one. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientBilin_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ‖normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs‖ ≤ 1 :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear T hT s) zero_le_one
    (normalCFCCoefficientFormLinear_norm_apply_le T hT s hs)

private theorem rieszCoefficientOperator_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ‖_root_.InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin (normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs)‖ ≤ 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro h
  change ‖(_root_.InnerProductSpace.toDual ℂ H).symm
    (normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs h)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖h‖
  rw [(_root_.InnerProductSpace.toDual ℂ H).symm.norm_map]
  exact ((normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs).le_opNorm h).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (normalCFCCoefficientBilin_norm_le T hT s hs) (norm_nonneg h))

/-- The coefficient operator is Riesz representation's adjoint on the same original H;
nonmeasurable spectrum sets are canonically zero. -/
def normalCFCCoefficientOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) : H →L[ℂ] H := by
  classical
  exact if hs : MeasurableSet s then
    (_root_.InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin
      (normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs)).adjoint
  else 0

/-- The measurable value is that same computed Riesz-Hilbert operator. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_of_measurable (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s =
      (_root_.InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin
        (normalCFCCoefficientBilin T hT s hs)).adjoint := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator, dite_eq_left hs]

/-- The all-set convention uses zero exactly when the original set is nonmeasurable. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : ¬ MeasurableSet s) :
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s = 0 := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator, dite_eq_right hs]

/-- Exact original coefficient identity; no projection or PVM law is assumed. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (g h : H) :
    ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s g⟫_ℂ =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s := by
  rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_of_measurable T hT s hs,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
    _root_.InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientBilin_apply]

/-- The actual bounded operator has norm at most one, including zero H/empty spectrum. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) : ‖normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s‖ ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_of_measurable T hT s hs, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    exact rieszCoefficientOperator_norm_le T hT s hs
  · rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable T hT s hs, norm_zero]
    exact zero_le_one

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureIndicatorIntegration
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureOperatorCommutation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureOperatorLaws
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.ContinuousIndicatorApproximation
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarProjection

/-!
# Actual projection and intersection laws for the computed CFC coefficients

Bounded continuous indicators converge almost everywhere for sums of the
actual regular coefficient variations. The original complex integral passes
these limits by dominated convergence. Continuous-CFC product identities and
computed-operator commutation then identify mu(E(t)g,h)(s) with mu(g,h)(s∩t).
The actual operator intersection, idempotence and star-projection laws follow
on the same original H and spectrum. No desired projector/PVM, representation,
correctness, norm model or additional H/spectrum premise is supplied.
These are constructor prerequisites for resolutionOfIdentity and its Borel
DATA. Numbered textbook terminal theorem bodies remain wholly open.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace Topology
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uX uH

private theorem existsContinuousComplexIndicator {X : Type uX}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [NormalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    (mu : Measure X) [mu.WeaklyRegular] [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∃ F : ℕ → C(X, ℂ), (∀ n x, ‖F n x‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂mu, Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) x)) := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _, hlim⟩ := exists_continuous_indicator_l2_ae mu s hs
  let F : ℕ → C(X, ℂ) := fun n =>
    ⟨fun x => (f n x : ℂ), Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (f n).continuous⟩
  refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n x
    change ‖(f n x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hf n x).1]
    exact (hf n x).2
  · filter_upwards [hlim] with x hx
    change Tendsto (fun n => (f n x : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) x))
    have hcast : Tendsto (fun n => Complex.ofReal (f n x)) atTop
        (𝓝 (Complex.ofReal (s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x))) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (s.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x)).comp hx
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hxs, Complex.ofReal_one] using hcast
    · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxs, Complex.ofReal_zero] using hcast

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual continuous functional of mu(E(t)g,h) is the t-value of mu(cfc(q)g,h). -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_operator_continuousIntegral
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H)
    (t : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    complexIntegralDual
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h) q =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT q g) h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) t := by
  have heq : normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t (cfcHom hT q g) =
      cfcHom hT q (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) :=
    congrArg (fun A : H →L[ℂ] H => A g) (normalCFCCoefficientOperator_commute_cfc T hT t q).eq
  calc
    complexIntegralDual
        (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h) q =
        ⟪h, cfcHom hT q (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g)⟫_ℂ :=
      normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h q
    _ = ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t (cfcHom hT q g)⟫_ℂ :=
      congrArg (fun x : H => ⟪h, x⟫_ℂ) heq.symm
    _ = (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT q g) h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) t :=
      normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT t ht (cfcHom hT q g) h

/-- The same actual coefficient measure inserts a continuous CFC factor on a measurable set. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_setIntegral
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H)
    (q : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) (t : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT q g) h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) t =
      complexIntegral (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator t ht * BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap q) := by
  let mu := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h
  let nu := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (cfcHom hT q g) h
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation _
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation _
  let : (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation.Regular := mu.property
  let : (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation.Regular := nu.property
  let lam := (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation +
    (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation
  let : lam.Regular := Measure.Regular.add_of_finite _ _
  let : IsFiniteMeasure lam := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hlim⟩ := existsContinuousComplexIndicator lam t ht
  have hnu_le : (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation ≤ lam :=
    Measure.le_add_right le_rfl
  have hmu_le : (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation ≤ lam :=
    Measure.le_add_left le_rfl
  have hnu := continuousIndicator_complexIntegral_mul_tendsto
    (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) t ht F hF (hlim.filter_mono (ae_mono hnu_le)) 1
  have hmu := continuousIndicator_complexIntegral_mul_tendsto
    (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) t ht F hF (hlim.filter_mono (ae_mono hmu_le))
    (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap q)
  simp only [mul_one, complexIntegral_indicator] at hnu
  have heq (n : ℕ) :
      complexIntegral (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n)) =
      complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap q) := by
    have hprod := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_mul_left T hT g h q (F n)
    change complexIntegralDual nu (F n) = complexIntegralDual mu (F n * q) at hprod
    rw [complexIntegralDual_apply, complexIntegralDual_apply] at hprod
    have hm : BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n * q) =
        BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap q :=
      map_mul (BoundedMeasurableFunction.continuousMapStarAlgHom (X := spectrum ℂ T)) (F n) q
    rw [hm] at hprod
    exact hprod
  have hsame :
      (fun n => complexIntegral (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n))) =
      (fun n => complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap q)) := funext heq
  rw [hsame] at hnu
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hnu hmu

/-- Acting by the computed E(t) restricts the same actual regular coefficient values. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_operator_inter
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (t : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h :
      ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) (s ∩ t) := by
  let mu := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h
  let nu := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation _
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation _
  let : (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation.Regular := mu.property
  let : (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation.Regular := nu.property
  let lam := (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation +
    (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation
  let : lam.Regular := Measure.Regular.add_of_finite _ _
  let : IsFiniteMeasure lam := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hlim⟩ := existsContinuousComplexIndicator lam s hs
  have hnu_le : (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation ≤ lam :=
    Measure.le_add_right le_rfl
  have hmu_le : (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)).variation ≤ lam :=
    Measure.le_add_left le_rfl
  have hnu := continuousIndicator_complexIntegral_mul_tendsto
    (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s hs F hF (hlim.filter_mono (ae_mono hnu_le)) 1
  have hmu := continuousIndicator_complexIntegral_mul_tendsto
    (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s hs F hF (hlim.filter_mono (ae_mono hmu_le))
    (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator t ht)
  simp only [mul_one, complexIntegral_indicator] at hnu
  rw [← BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator_inter s t hs ht, complexIntegral_indicator] at hmu
  have heq (n : ℕ) :
      complexIntegral (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n)) =
      complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator t ht) := by
    have htest := normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_operator_continuousIntegral T hT g h t ht (F n)
    rw [normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_cfc_setIntegral T hT g h (F n) t ht,
      complexIntegralDual_apply] at htest
    exact htest.trans (congrArg (complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)))
      (mul_comm (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator t ht)
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n))))
  have hsame :
      (fun n => complexIntegral (nu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n))) =
      (fun n => complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T))
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (F n) *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator t ht)) := funext heq
  rw [hsame] at hnu
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hnu hmu

/-- Products of the computed measurable values are the computed intersection value. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_mul_inter
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (t : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s * normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t =
      normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s ∩ t) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  change ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g)⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s ∩ t) g⟫_ℂ
  calc
    ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g)⟫_ℂ =
        (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h :
          ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) s :=
      normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT t g) h
    _ = (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) (s ∩ t) :=
      normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_operator_inter T hT g h s hs t ht
    _ = ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s ∩ t) g⟫_ℂ :=
      (normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT (s ∩ t) (hs.inter ht) g h).symm

/-- Every computed value is idempotent; nonmeasurable values are the actual zero. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_idempotent
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) :
    IsIdempotentElem (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s) := by
  classical
  change normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s * normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s =
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · simpa only [Set.inter_self] using normalCFCCoefficientOperator_mul_inter T hT s hs s hs
  · rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable T hT s hs, zero_mul]

/-- These same actual coefficient operators are canonical star projections. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_isStarProjection
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) :
    IsStarProjection (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s) :=
  ⟨normalCFCCoefficientOperator_idempotent T hT s,
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator_isSelfAdjoint T hT s⟩
